1 Glossary
S. No. Terms Definition
1 LEI LEI is an acronym for Legal Entity 
Identifier. The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is 
a 20-character, alpha-numeric code based 
on the ISO 17442 standard developed by 
the International Organisation for 
Standardization (ISO). It connects to key 
reference information that enables clear 
and unique identification of legal entities 
participating in financial transactions.
2 Lite participants The participants of the organisations that 
have been included in OSTTRA 
Documentation Centre database but do not 
have direct access to the services of OSTTRA 
Documentation Centre. Hence, the Lite 
participants' activities such as Approval 
and Rejection take place through the 
respective emails.
3 Online participants The participants of the organisations that 
have been included in OSTTRA 
Documentation Centre database and have 
direct access to the services of OSTTRA 
Documentation Centre.
4 Organisation An organisation included in the OSTTRA 
Documentation Centre database from the 
Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation 
(GLEIF) database.
5 Tenor The time duration after which the validity of 
a traded document in Foreign Exchange 
(FX) expires.

2 Introduction
OSTTRA Documentation Centre (ODC) is an online repository of the digital versions of the documents. It incorporates 
different aspects of document creation by the onboarded users and organisations, through its multiple features and 
workflows. OSTTRA Documentation Centre also supports multiples operations on the different versions of a digital 
document and thus provides a complete solution for online document creation, approval, maintenance, and termination. 

### Page 9
8 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
3 User Profile Management
To login to OSTTRA Documentation Centre (ODC), enter your registered email id and password in the login page.
OSTTRA Documentation Centre (ODC) provides profile management options to its users. A logged in user can: 
 View the corresponding profile information along with mapped legal entities and organisation types.
 View support email and contact phone numbers.
3.1 User Profile Information
A logged in user's profile can be accessed to view information such as the user's name, email, contact number, and 
mapped legal entities and organisations.
To view the logged in user's profile information
1. Click the encircled initial of the logged in user's first name or the drop-down at the top-right corner of the homepage. 
The View Profile option appears in the pop-up menu.
2. Click View Profile. The Help & Settings page appears with already selected Profile details option. The logged in 
user's profile information, such as name, email, contact number, and mapped legal entities, is visible.


### Page 10
9 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
3.2 Help and Support
The Help & Support section displays the support email address.
In Help & Settings, click Help & Support to view the available support information.

4 Static Data Management
Static data, such as Approval Groups and Approval Matrix, is required for the daily operations of OSTTRA Documentation 
Centre. Such data helps to create new documents, reduce efforts to manage existing documents, and simplify user 
experience.
4.1 Approval Groups
4.1.1 Create a New Approval Group
1. In any page, click the ( ) symbol. The sidebar appears.
2. In the sidebar, go to Groups & template > Approval Group. The Approval groups homepage appears with the list of 
Approval groups as per the user's access and Organisation Type.
3. In Approval groups, click Create Approval Group. The Create new approval group page appears.
4. In Create new approval group, enter information in Group name, Organisation, Doc type, LEIs, and Org type. Next 
becomes available.
An Approval Group can also be searched through Search by group name.

### Page 12
11 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
5. Click Next. a message appears stating the Approval group is created successfully. 
6. Enter the email address of the user to be included in the Approval Group in Search by Email id and click Add from 
the resulting dropdown. The user is added to the Approval group and Submit becomes available.
 The options available under Group name, Organisation, Doc type, LEIs, and Org type are as per the 
user's access and Organisation type.
 You can create approval groups with the same approval group name. However, either of their 
Organisation, Doc Type, LEI, and Org Type field values must be different.
 If you select Org type as PB, the Manual approval checkbox appears at the bottom.
Select this checkbox if you want to create the manual ‘PB on behalf of EB’ Approval group.
A new created Approval group does not have users by default.

4.2 Approval Matrix
4.2.1 Create an Approval Matrix
1. In any page, click the ( ) symbol. The sidebar appears.
2. In the sidebar, go to Groups & template > Approval Matrix. The Approval Matrix homepage appears with the list of 
Approval Matrices as per the user's access and Organisation Type.


### Page 17
16 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
3. In Approval Matrix, click Create Approval Matrix. The Create new approval matrix page appears.
4. Select information in the Organisation, LEIs, Org Type, and Doc type dropdowns. Next becomes available.
5. Click Next. A success message with the Update approval matrix page appears. The approval matrix is created with 
no approval groups for any document action.
The options visible in LEIs, Org type, and Doc type are as per the selected Organisation.

### Page 18
17 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
6. Select the approval group from the dropdowns corresponding to different Document actions.
When an approval matrix is created for the first time, the Approval order is automatically set to Parallel by 
default. You can switch the Approval order to Sequential and vice versa. When you switch the Approval 
order, a confirmation message appears to confirm the switch.
Click the Apply All button if you want to set the same approval group across all available Document Actions 
per parallel step while creating an Approval Matrix with Sequential/Parallel approval order.

### Page 19
18 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
7.  Click Submit to save the changes. A success notification appears. The newly created Approval Matrix appears at the 
top in the Approval Matrix homepage. 
4.2.2 Edit an Approval Matrix
An Approval Matrix can be further updated to edit the Document Actions and Approval Groups.
To edit an Approval Matrix
 Click the ( ) symbol to remove the selected Approval groups from the respective dropdowns.  
 Click the + Add Sequence Column button to add more Sequential/Parallel column(s) for the Approval 
group. 
 Click the ( ) icon to delete the sequential/Parallel column. A confirmation message appears to 
confirm the deletion. 
 Click the Reset button to revert the changes to their default settings.
 Select the Parallel or the Sequential option to switch between the approval sequence. The selected 4 
Way or DN agreement document is approved in the selected parallel or sequential order for each 
approval group per document action. 
 In a sequential approval order, approval participants receive notifications one after another. The next 
approver in the sequence is notified only after the previous one has provided their approval, 
continuing until the last approver has approved. However, in a parallel approval order, all approvers 
receive the notification for approval simultaneously. These approval notifications are viewed under the 
the 
Recent Notifications by clicking the Message icon.

3. In USP Rider, click Create New USP Rider. The Create New USP Rider page appears.
4. In the Create New USP Rider page 
a. Select the required Document Type.
b. Select the values for Prime Broker and Client under Select Parties.
c. Enter the PB contact.
d. Type the USP Rider word clause or select the standard clause wording, if you want to use the already written

Bulk Actions help to execute a task in bulk for multiple documents. The following actions are supported by Bulk Actions for a 
document:
 Approve

 Edit
 Terminate
To execute a Bulk Action

document information, such as Document ID, Document Version ID, and Document Status.

4. Select an option from the Bulk Action dropdown to execute the respective Bulk Action.
11.1 Bulk Request Page
The executed Bulk Actions are submitted for approval and appear in Document > Bulk request page.
The Bulk request page shows all the created bulk requests with information columns such as Batch ID, Doc type, Action 
type, and Initiator. The following columns also provide the related information of a bulk request:

Total The total number of documents present in a batch, for the respective bulk request under Action type.

respective bulk request under Action type. The Processed document number appears as a hyperlink and displays the 
documents' Version Id on hover.
Not 
processed

Last

c. Under Approval Group, select the approval group for Reject bulk action.

7. Once you click Submit, a confirmation message box appears. click Confirm. A success message appears stating 
New Legal name has been updated.
8. The legal entity name change has impact under the following cases:
a. When a new approval agreement is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the PB 
and EB entities. Any existing approval agreements created against a previously available PB and EB legal 
entity names will use the latest alternate legal entity names available.
b. When a new USP Rider Notice is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the PB 
Any existing USP Rider Notices created against a previously available PB legal entity names will use the 
latest alternate legal entity names available.
c. When a new document template is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the 
Organisation entity. Any existing document templates created against a previously available Organisation legal 
entity name will use the latest alternate legal entity name available.
d. When a new approval matric is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the 
Organisation entity. Any existing approval matrices created against a previously available Organisation legal 
entity name will use the latest alternate legal entity name available.
e. When a new approval group is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the 
Organisation entity. Any existing approval groups created against a previously available Organisation legal 
entity name will use the latest alternate legal entity name available.
f. When a new product group is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the 
Organisation entity. Any existing products groups created against a previously available Organisation legal 
entity name will use the latest alternate legal entity name available.
g. When a new Currency group or a new Currency pair group is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity 
name available for the Organisation entity. Any existing currency groups or currency pair groups created 
against a previously available Organisation legal entity name will use the latest alternate legal entity name 
available. 
h. When a new Document Framework is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for the 
PB and EB entities. Any existing Document Frameworks use the previously approved alternate legal entity 
name available for a PB and EB entities and NOT any newly added alternate legal entity names.
i. When a new DN is created, it uses the latest alternate legal entity name available for a PB and EB 
entities. Any existing DNs use the previously approved alternate legal entity name available for the PB and 
EB  entities and NOT any newly added alternate legal entity names.
j. When editing an existing Document Framework where PB or EB has a new alternate legal entity name now, 
then a popup appears that informs you that the legal entity(ies) name has changed. If you accept the update, 
the Document Framework updates with the latest alternate entity name(s) and goes through the existing 
Document Framework approval process for re-approval. If you decline the update, there is no change to the 
Document Framework.
k. When editing an existing DN where PB or EB has a new alternate legal entity name now, then a popup 
appears that informs you that the legal entity(ies) name has changed. If you accept the update, the DN 
updates with the latest alternate entity name(s) and goes through the existing DN approval process for re-
approval. If you decline the update, there is no change to the DN.

14 OSTTRA Assistant to ODC
The OSTTRA assistant tool has been embedded into the ODC application. This tool is designed to help you access 
required information more efficiently and in a modern way, with the goal of reducing production operational support 
overheads. To use it, you simply need to enter a query into the tool to receive the relevant information. Additionally, you 
have the option to select from any pre-added queries already available within the interface.
This new feature improves your workflow and provides the support you need more effectively.

1 Introduction
OSTTRA’s Documentation Centre (ODC) is a new version of our original Designation Notice Manager (DNM) service.
The new service supports the management of additional agreement types, in addition to the Designation Notices type 
available in DNM.
ODC provides a broad range of new capabilities and functions, which are designed to provide an enhanced user 
experience and promote greater interoperability with downstream systems through the provision of a comprehensive suite 
of APIs. API access to documents stored within ODC removes the need for the double entry of the information, which is 
prone to errors and requires additional reconciliation processes to ensure integrity.
This guide provides information regarding the main communication channels that ODC supports:
 
Notifications service (Event Driven Document Changes) - Events based service (“Push”) that informs customers 
about the updates related to their documents.
 Events generated signify that a document has been updated
 Full document details pushed to receiver 
 Typically delivered using JSON over Message Queue (MQ) or SFTP

### Page 4
3 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
2 Notifications Service
OSTTRA's notifications service allows users to subscribe to events and receive notifications when those events occur. The 
events can be sent to the customer through any of the OSTTRA's standard communication protocols like Message Queue 
(MQ) or SFTP and can also feed their Credit system. 
2.1 Document Notification Update 
2.1.1 Overview
Doc 
Notification 
Event
Description
Trigger The status of the document gets either “Enforced” or “Terminated”.
Content  The "Documentation Notification" event provides the complete and comprehensive information for the enforced or 
terminated Documentation Notice created on ODC between the Prime broker, Executing broker, and Client.
In case the documentation was updated, the event will also include the previous version information.
The message attributes are depicted in the Message Attributes table below.
Format Message format is JSON sent over MQ
2.1.2 Message Attributes 
The key attributes on the JSON event looks as follows:
JSON Tags Description Possible Values
1 documentId Specifies the base ID of a document, 
which was created uniquely between the 
participants. 
DN-288183-A
2  documentVersionMainId Specifies the unique id of a latest 
document created on ODC between the 
participants. This reflects the latest 
version of the document. Any changes 
happen on the base document are 
assigned a new document version main 
id but the document id remains the 
same.
DN-288183-A-001, here DN stands for 
Designation Notice, 001 represent the 
latest version.
3 documentType Specifies the type of document for 
example, DN, is the Designation Notice 
between 3 participants (PB, EB and 
Client). 
The current supported values are: 
 
DN - Designation Notice
 4W - Four Way
DN

### Page 5
4 © 2026 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved
JSON Tags Description Possible Values
4 participants Participants section specifies the 
participants involved in the document 
creation with their:
 
Legal name,
 Legal entity identifier Id, and
 Org type (specifies if the entity is 
acting as PB, EB, or client)
LEI ID, LEI Name, org type (PB, EB, or 
Client)
5 participantFunds Client's Fund data  Fund Id and Label
6 allowedCurrency This step during initiating a document is 
to identify whether the document is for 
the FX currencies, Bullion currencies, or 
both.
FX, FX and Bullion, Bullion only
7 authScopeLines-  Auth scope includes the Product, tenor, 
and currency authorization created and 
agreed by the participants.
7.1 authScopeLines -> authLineProduct Auth line product specifies the product 
family, asset class, and product 
attributes.
Product authorization includes 
product group, asset class, product 
family, and products characteristics.
7.2 authScopeLines ->
authLineCurrencies , authLineCurrencyPairs
It specifies the currency authorization 
and currency pair authorization for the 
selected products.
Currencies or currency pairs.
7.3 authScopeLines ->
tenorInfo
Tenor Info specifies the defined tenor on 
the selected products for the selected 
currencies and the currency pairs.
Tenor can be in days. business days, 
months, years, up to spot, spot only.
8 authLineCurrencies, authLineCurrencyPairs It specifies the currency authorization 
and currency pair authorization for the 
selected products.
Currencies or currency pairs.
9 tenorInfo Tenor Info specifies the defined tenor on 
the selected products for the selected 
currencies and the currency pairs.
Tenor can be in days. business days, 
months, years, up to spot, spot only.
10 limitScopeLines Limit Scope specifies the assigned 
position limits for the selected product 
family and it also specifies the limit 
calculation methodologies (NOP versus 
DSL) along with netting type on these 
limits (Longs, Shorts, net, gross, and so 
forth). Limit scope lines give the user 
flexibility to choose delta calculation for 
FX options and option to include or 
exclude bullions trades on a credit line.
Calculation type can be NOP or DSL
Netting type can be Longs, Shorts, 
Net, Gross, greater, lesser, gross 
excluding USD, and so forth.
Delta can be yes or no.
Product family can be FX cash, Vanilla 
option, exotic option, and volatility.
Bullion inclusion or exclusion can be 
include metals, exclude metals or all.
Exclude CLS from calculation can be 
yes or no.

Core Foundations: Static
Current Behaviour (DNM) Target Behaviour (ODC)
General Static
Document Specific 
Static (1)
The following static is managed within the DNM application: 
products, currencies, currency pairs, currencies and currency 
pair groups, approvers lists and user roles permissions.
Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI’s), Organisation and User static 
are all managed within the DNM application.
The following static is managed within the ODC application: 
products, bullion products, currencies, currency pairs, 
currencies and currency pair groups, approval groups and 
user role permissions. Of these, approval groups and currency 
groups are managed by customer users.
Approval groups replaces approvers lists.
Please refer to sections 4.3 and 4.1 of the ODC User Guide 
for further details on: currencies and currency pair groups; and 
approval groups respectively.
Legal Entity Identifiers (LEI’s), Organisation and User static is 
managed centrally via the central OSTTRA CRDS and Jigsaw 
services by the OSTTRA onboarding team. LEI reference data 
is directly sourced from GLEIF services.
Overrides to counterparty legal names are managed by the 
OSTTRA onboarding teams via the Alternate Legal Entity 
Name facility.  


### Page 6
The home of MarkitServ, Traiana, TriOptima & Reset© 2024 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved. 
Core Foundations: Approval Setup
Current Behaviour (DNM) Target Behaviour (ODC)
Approval Setup & 
Management
Similarly, Approval Groups are used to manage lists of 
approval users for an organisation in ODC.
In conjunction, Approval Matrices are used to specify 
which approval group’s consent is required to approve 
specific types of document sections and action changes 
per document. Approvals include PB’s approving on 
behalf of EB’s. Approval can be sequential or in parallel 
across approval group of users. 
Both are managed by customer users. Users are also 
prevented from undertaking multiple levels of approval 
during a cycle.
Please refer to sections 4.1 and 4.2 of the ODC User 
Guide for further details.
Approval groups and associated document approval order 
are available to be set up for an organisation using DNM.
These are used to specify and group which users are able 
to approve a MA or EDN document on the service and in 
what approval order it is to occur. Approvals include PB’s 
approving on behalf of EB’s.
Users are prevented from undertaking multiple levels of 
approval during a cycle.
DNM Approvers Lists are created and edited to manage 
approval groups of users.
Document Specific 
Static (2)
The following static and capability does not exist in DNM: 
product groups and approval matrices.
The following static and capability have been introduced in 
ODC: product groups and approval matrices. These are 
managed by customer users.
Please refer to sections 4.4 and 4.2 of the ODC User Guide 
for further details.

Document Framework
Current Behaviour (DNM) Target Behaviour (ODC)
Document 
Framework 
Creation
Document Frameworks can be created for specified PB 
and EB relationships. Users specify the authorization 
scope, position limit lines, approval workflow, enforcement 
rules and general terms.
Product Groups and Currency Groups are available to 
speed up the entry of details.
Please refer to section 6 of the ODC User Guide for 
further details.
Master Agreements (MA) can be created for specified PB 
and EB relationships in DNM. Users specify the products, 
currencies, position limit lines, tenors, enforcement rules 
and general terms information.
Currency groups are available to speed up entry of 
currency details.
Document 
Framework Edit
Single Master Agreements (MA) and their properties can 
be amended subject to pre-defined acceptance rules in 
DNM.
Single Document Frameworks with all their previously 
entered financial and document terms; and position limit 
lines can be amended subject to approval.
Please refer to section 6 of the ODC User Guide for 
further details.

### Page 8
The home of MarkitServ, Traiana, TriOptima & Reset© 2024 OSTTRA Group. All rights reserved. 
Current Behaviour (DNM) Target Behaviour (ODC)
Document 
Framework 
Termination
Single Master Agreements (MA) can be terminated using 
the termination workflow in DNM.
Single Document Frameworks can be terminated.
Please refer to section 6.10.3 of the ODC User Guide for 
further details.
Document 
Framework 
Approval or 
Rejection
Single Master Agreements (MA) can be approved or 
rejected where users have been assigned the 
responsibility via the approval workflow in DNM. Once 
fully approved the MA becomes enforced.
An optional rejection reason can be specified where an 
MA is to be rejected.
Single Document Frameworks can be approved or 
rejected where Online users have the assigned 
responsibility via the approval or rejection workflows in 
ODC. Once fully approved the Document Framework 
becomes enforced.
Lite users who are not signed-up users of ODC can 
approve or reject via the Lite user workflows where a URL 
link is provided and an OTP is required to interact with the 
ODC system.
An optional rejection reason can be specified where a 
Document Framework is to be rejected.
Please refer to sections 6.10.3 of the ODC User Guide for 
further details.

Designation Notice 
(DN) Creation
DN’s can be created for specified PB, EB and client relationships. 
Users specify the authorization scope, position limit lines, approval 
workflow, enforcement rules, client funds, physical settlement 
indicator with trading locations for bullions and document terms.
Product Groups, Currency Groups and Templates are available to 
speed up the entry of details.
Optionally, USP Rider notice’s can be applied against a DN. Inflight 
validation is also provided to authorisation scope currencies match 
the selected settlement type.
Please refer to sections 8 of the ODC User Guide for further 
details.
DN’s can be created for specified PB, EB and client relationships in 
DNM. Users specify the products, currencies, position limit lines, 
tenors, enforcement rules, client funds, physical settlement 
indicator with trading locations for bullions and general tab 
information.
Currency groups are available to speed up entry of currency 
details.
Optionally, USP Rider notice’s can be applied against a DN.
Designation Notice 
(DN) Edit
Single DN’s and their properties can be amended subject to 
pre-defined acceptance rules in DNM. USP Rider’s can also be 
removed.
DN’s pending approval or that have been approved are editable.
Single DN’s with all their previously entered financial and document 
terms; and position limit lines can be amended subject to approval. 
USP Rider’s can also be removed.
DN’s In-approval or that are Approved are editable.
Please refer to section 10 of the ODC User Guide for further 
details.

CreditLink Interoperability
Current Behaviour (DNM) Target Behaviour (ODC)
CreditLink 
Interoperability
Core foundations to allow the integration, sync and 
management of ODC workflows with CreditLink.
Implementation of DN creation and enforced, amend and 
termination workflow events exist for authorisation scope 
and position limits scenarios to CreditLink. Sync success 
or failure status are reported against DN’s.
Deletion of DN associated credit lines support added to 
allow for remedial actions on DN’s with subsequent 
re-sync to CreditLink. (Operation available to 
administration personnel only).
User notification is provided when unsupported products 
and product types in CreditLink are defined on the 
financial economics within a DN agreement. Notification is 
provided where the user’s organisation operates under an 
integrated setup.
DNM interoperates with CreditLink allowing customers of 
both services to manage their DN’s via DNM and then 
have them automatically fed to CreditLink where they can 
monitor their trade activity versus those DN limits.
Updates are streamed following enforcements of the DN’s 
and any subsequent updates to the financial terms held 
within the documents.
Termination of DN’s within DNM are synced immediately.
The status of the interoperability between the two systems 
is reported against each DN along with the reporting of 
any sync failures.

### Page 5
ODC  Product  Development  Update  
  
Functional  Deliveries  
Software  Package  8  (Drop  3d)  
The  following  covers  package  8  of  software  deliverables  -  ODC  version  26.4.0.  
General   
General  Description  
Static  TND  as  a  non-deliverable  currency  is  now  available  in  the  system  for  selection.  
Approval  Workflows  
Users  can  now  implement  approvals  whereby  the  prime  broker  can  manage  offline  manual  agreement  approvals  by  executing  brokers  by:  ●  setting  up  specific  ‘on  behalf  of’  manual  approval  groups,  ●  the  ODC  system  generating  bespoke  or  standard  agreement  PDF’s  sent  to  nominated  email  accounts,  ●  prime  broker  users  approving  agreements  on  behalf  of  executing  brokers  once  agreed  and  approved  offline.  During  the  approval  process,  users  are  now  prevented  from  undertaking  multiple  levels  of  approval  for  an  agreement  where  a  firm  has  been  operationally  set  up  with  several  approval  groups  and  users  belong  to  2  or  more  of  the  groups.  Note :  Approval  groups  used  for  approving  on  behalf  of  an  executing  broker  are  excluded  from  this  processing.  
Draft  Versions  The  system  now  only  allows  one  single  draft  version  of  an  agreement  to  be  inflight  at  any  one  point  of  time  to  optimise  the  management  of  Designation  Notices  and  4  Ways  agreements  for  users.  
Agreement  Editing  
Agreements  in  an  ‘In-approval’  or  ‘Approved’  state  are  editable  by  users.  Edits  can  be  applied  on  an  individual  agreement  basis  or  in  bulk.  
 
Agreement  Types   
Agreement  Type  Description  
Designation  Notices  (DN’s)  
Designation  Notices  can  now  be  created  against  client  counterparties  where  the  client  combines  multiple  legal  entities  to  form  a  single  complex  combined  counterparty  to  represent  the  client.  The  formulated  client  counterparty  is  then  used  on  the  DN  and  for  subsequent  integration  with  CreditLink  for  credit  management.  The  name  of  the  currency  group  used  to  create  required  authorization  scope  are  now  shown  by  system  when  viewing  each  DN  agreement.

### Page 6
ODC  Product  Development  Update  
  
Documentation  Management   
Management  Feature  Description  
USP  Rider  Notices  
The  underlying  framework  is  now  available  to  support  the  generation  of  bespoke  customer  USP  Rider  Notices  out  of  the  ODC  application.   
CreditLink  Interoperability   
CreditLink  Interoperability  Description  
CreditLink  Interoperability  
The  sync  status  values  representing  the  update  status  of  Designation  Notices  with  CreditLink  have  been  enhanced  to:  ●  Sync  Sent  ●  Sync  Successful  ●  Sync  Rejected  ●  Credit  Deletion  Sent  ●  Credit  Deletion  Successful  ●  Credit  Deletion  Rejected  Users  are  able  to  view  the  rejection  reason  should  the  sync  operation  of  a  Designation  Notice  to  CreditLink  was  not  successful.  This  data  along  with  the  sync  status  of  the  DN  can  be  optionally  added  as  columns  to  the  Documents  Dashboard  and  the  fields  are  downloadable  to  an  Excel  file  alongside  agreement  data.  Users  are  able  to  view  the  timestamp  of  when  the  last  sync  message  was  sent  to  CreditLink  and  when  the  last  sync  response  was  received  from  CreditLink.  The  times  are  available  in  UTC  and  local  time.  These  timestamps  can  be  optionally  added  as  columns  to  the  Documents  Dashboard.  The  menu  options  to  manage  the  sync  operations  for  credit  monitoring  with  CreditLink  have  been  relocated  on  the  application  and  also  renamed  to:  ●  Delete  DN  credit  in  CreditLink,  ●  Resync  DN’s  to  CreditLink.  Note :  These  operations  are  for  OSTTRA  administrative  personnel  use  only.   
 
Notifications   
Notifications  Description  
User  Notifications  
Internal  OSTTRA  administrative  personnel  are  able  to  manage  email  and  in-application  notifications  for  various  supported  ODC  events  for  all  users  set  up  in  the  system.  The  notifications  can  be  managed  per  user  or  on  a  bulk  user  basis  across  selected  users.  Additionally,  distribution  lists  can  be  set  up  to  receive  email  notifications.  External  online  users  are  able  to  manage  their  own  individual  email  and  in-application  notifications  for  various  ODC  supported  events.

### Page 13
ODC  Product  Development  Update  
  
CreditLink  Interoperability   
CreditLink  Interoperability  Description  
CreditLink  Interoperability  
User  notification  to  ODC  users  of  unsupported  products  and  product  types  in  CreditLink  when  specified  on  creation,  amendment  and  submission  of  DN’s  with  these  economics  specified  on  the  agreements.  Workflow  added  to  delete  DN  associated  credit  lines  held  in  CreditLink  to  allow  for  remedial  updates  to  be  applied  on  the  DN  without  having  to  terminate  the  DN  in  ODC.  Credit  lines  can  subsequently  be  re-synced  with  CreditLink  on  resolving  the  DN.  Note:  Function  available  only  to  OSTTRA  administration  personnel.  Further  integration  and  sync  of  ODC  workflows  with  the  existing  CreditLink  risk  management  service  including  CreditLink  receipt,  processing  and  monitoring  of  inbound  and  outbound  messages  from  ODC.  Middleware  components  for  messaging  system  communication  between  ODC  and  CreditLink  resolved  from  all  possible  security  vulnerabilities.

Software  Package  4  (Drop  2b)  
The  following  covers  package  4  of  software  deliverables.  
Core  Foundations   
Foundation  Feature  Description  
Static  Static  Management  via  CRDS  and  Jigsaw  central  services  of:  ●  Legal  Entity  Identifiers  (LEI’s)  ●  Organisations  ●  Users  ●  Single  Sign-On  (SSO)  Static  Management  within  ODC  of:  ●  The  following  currencies  and  currency  pairs  are  now  available;  CNH,  LPD,  LPT,  BRL-GBP,  USD-CNY,  USD-ZAR,  USD-CZK,  CNH-HKD,  SGD-CNH,  USD-CNH  and  EUR-CNH.  ●  The  following  currencies  are  now  listed  to  be  both  deliverable  and  non-deliverable  in  settlement;  CLF,  CRC,  DOP,  KES,  LBP,  PKR,  TWD,  UGX,  UYU,  VND  and  ZMW.  ●  Exotic  European  Digital  options  can  now  have  ‘No  Barrier’  and  ‘Reverse-Knock-in’  barrier  type  attributes  specified.  ●  Exotic  One  Touch  options  can  now  have;  ‘No  Barrier’,  ‘Knock-In’,  ‘Knock-Out’,  ‘Reverse-Knock-In’  and  ‘Reverse-Knock-Out’  barrier  type  attributes  specified.  ●  User  creation  and  user  profile  details  management  is  no  longer  supported  within  ODC.  ●  Approval  Groups  -  the  same  name  for  approval  groups  can  exist  across  different  organisations  and  no  longer  have  to  be  unique.  ●  Approval  Matrices  -  add  sequential  approval  review  alongside  parallel  approval  review.  ●  Alternate  legal  entity  names  -  capability  to  override  counterparty  legal  names  across  entities  held  in  ODC  including  on  Designation  Notices  (DN’s).  
 
General   
General  Description  
General  The  UI  presentation  of  the  available  currencies  and  currency  pairs  across  workflows  has  been  remodelled.  All  impacted  columns  that  expose  cross  customer  email  details  have  now  been  removed  to  prevent  customer  data  breaches.  A  user  help  guide  for  the  service  has  now  been  integrated  into  the  ODC  application.  All  OSTTRA  customer  support  contact  details  have  been  updated  to  reflect  the  latest.

Management  Feature  Description  
Document  Report  Users  can  download  DN  and  4  Ways  document  data  from  the  Document  dashboard  view  in  an  Excel  formatted  file  to  their  local  workstation.  The  data  will  contain:  ●  all  records  taking  into  account  any  filtering  applied  on  the  dashboard  view,  ●  column  names  as  seen  on  the  dashboard  view,  ●  data  values  with  ordering  as  seen  on  the  dashboard  view.  The  Document  dashboard  view  has  been  optimised  with  the  default  ordering  of  the  columns  changed  to  reflect  the  level  of  data  importance  and  redundant  whitespace  reduced  along  with  the  column  widths  sizing.

Static  The  name  of  Approval  groups  entered  into  the  ODC  system  can  now  be  amended  by  users.  Additionally,  Approval  groups  can  be  deleted  from  the  system  by  users. General   
General  Description  
General  All  amendments  to  a  Document  Framework,  Designation  Notice  and  4  Ways  agreement  document  are  continually  saved  by  the  ODC  application  when  switching  between  data  tabs  without  prompting  the  user  to  save  any  changes  made. Document  Framework   
Document  Description  
Document  Frameworks  (DF’s)  
Multiple  user  defined  product  groups  can  now  be  selected  by  users  when  adding  the  authorisation  scope  to  a  Document  Framework  on  creation  or  amendment.  Users  are  able  to  set  tenor  values  to  apply  across  all  authorisation  scope  entered  or  to  individual  products  or  product  families  for  applicable  authorisation  scope  on  a  Document  Framework.  On  submission  of  a  Document  Framework,  validation  is  performed  by  the  system  to  ensure  that  an  Approval  Matrix  exists  for  the  legal  entity  and  document  action’s  combinations  as  specified  in  the  Approval  Workflow  for  the  DF.  Where  the  matrix  does  not  exist,  the  user  is  informed  and  requested  to  add  the  required  matrix  to  allow  submission  of  the  DF  to  proceed.  Users  are  given  inflight  validation  and  warned  where  the  selected  authorisation  scope  Touch  Direction  attribute  contradicts  the  associated  specified  Contract  Type.  E.g.  Touch  Direction  =  Up  and  Contract  Type  =  Put.  A  ‘Manual  PDF  approval  email’  value  can  now  be  specified  on  a  Document  Framework  for  use  when  manual  DN  approvals  are  required.

## [1] DMGS-1: DMS User Listing and Onboarding

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-06-08T14:36:03.980+0200`

### Description:
AC

DMS Journeys - Google Docs



DMS User Management (Editing profile, roles, LEI_Orgtype)



User comes to the screen which shows the list of all users with their names, email, phone number, and current status (active/inactive)

User clicks on any user and moves to the user profile screen, the screen opens in edit mode, edit button on the listing screen also lands on the same screen

The user can view profile details (non-editable), status, roles, and LEI_orgtype mapping of the user, they can edit the role and LEI_orgtype mapping and click on submit button to save the changes (only those lei_orgtype combinations can be assigned to the user which is in the online state for this org).

Check to ensure at least 1 lei_orgtype is mapped to the user otherwise stop from the user being in an active state

If it’s a new user send a welcome email once the user becomes active, also if the user does not password created in LDAP also send a create password email to the user (refer to create a password journey)

For the org_admin role all LEI and org_type should be selected by default and Ops users will not be allowed to change their LEIs and Org_type (if an org_admin role is selected no other role can be given and vice-versa)

## [10] DMGS-111: Enable users to capture document type, participants and type of 4-way document (FX/Bullion/Both)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-08-09T09:00:07.364+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-111](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-111)

### Description:
Description:



The user lands on the document creation first screen by clicking on the create new document button.

User selects the type of documents they want to create (the list of different document type should be fetched basis the various type of documents types defined for the application)

Based on the document type selected fetch the following:



Acting as which party dropdown, based on the intersection of the org type enabled for the user and org types needed in this type of document



If only one org type is common by default select that for the user, in case multiple parties exist for the same org type assign the first party to the user (ex. In 4-way if the user has PB org type enabled for them so the user creating the document would be PB-1 by default)

If multiple org types are common in acting as dropdown show the list of common org types for the user to select from, in case multiple parties exist for the same org type assign the first party to the user





The list of all parties needed for the document, the list of LEIs which will appear in each individual parties dropdown should be filtered basis the following



If the user is acting as that particular party in this document list of LEIs should be restricted to only those active LEIs which the user has access to

If the user is not acting as that particular party in the document show a full list of all LEIs coming from the GLEIF DB









User to also select the allowed currencies for this document, based on the selection the workflow should be:



If Both is selected (which is the default selection), a document once created should be unique at the party level, i.e. no further document shall be created with the same 4 parties_orgtype combinations in the document, with any other/same allowed currency (order does not matter in case of multiple parties belonging to the same org_type)

If FX is selected a document with the same party_orgtype combination can only be created with the allowed currency being Bullion

If Bullion is selected a document with the same party_orgtype combination can only be created with the allowed currency being FX





List of templates to be shown basis the doc_type selected by the user and the organization/parent LEI of the user, with the default selection being a blank template, if a user selects any other template we should only copy the information from the template and not create a reference from the template.

When a user clicks on the next button, do the following checks.



Doc Type has been selected

All LEIs for all parties have been selected (we should also leave a placeholder for aliases for now)

The template has been selected

Acting has been selected (either automatically or by the user)

Allowed currency has been selected correctly, if party_orgtype validation with allowed currency is not correct throw an error





If everything is okay move to the next screen and do the following:



Create Master Doc ID

Create Version ID

Define document action as new document for this version (all document actions are pre-defined and fall into 3 categories: new document, terminate a document, edit a document. Edit has a document has further breakdown based on the type of edit)

Define the state of the document version as Draft (Document states are pre-defined as Draft, In-Approval, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled, Terminated, Enforced)

Action Initiator Party based on what the acting as has been selected by the user

Send notifications to other users of all parties about a new document being created.











Link  DMS-Org (adobe.com)

## [11] DMGS-112: Enable users to create/edit approval groups at LEI_Orgtype

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-08-09T09:00:14.246+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-112](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-112)

### Description:
Create an Approval Group



User lands on approval group listing screen which shows list of all approval groups (access to be restricted basis the lei_orgtype defined for the user, Ops user can see all approval groups)

User clicks on Create Approval Group button

User lands to the next screen and needs to provide the name of the group, org (by default if it’s an Org user), LEI name and Org type (only those combinations which the user has access to)

User to click on Next which enables the second half of the screen (at this point the group has been created with 0 members added)

User to now search and add users in the approval group (list of users will be restricted to those who have access to the lei_orgtype combination)

User to click on submit and get redirected to the group listing screen





Edit an Approval Group



User lands on approval group listing screen which shows list of all approval groups (access to be restricted basis the lei_orgtype defined for the user, Ops user can see all approval groups)

User can filter on values using what lei_orgtype are defined for the user (Org, Lei and Org type, show all values for Ops user but only defined values for Org user) and search by group name

User to click on edit button against any approval group and move to the group detail screen in edit mode where they can edit the members in a group (no other details can be edited)

User to click on submit button which saves the updates by the user and redirects to the approval group listing screen

---

## [12] DMGS-113: Enable users to create/edit approval matrix at LEI_org_type

* **Status:** `Done`

### Description:
Create an Approval Matrix



User lands on approval matrix listing screen which shows list of all approval matrix (access to be restricted basis the lei_orgtype defined for the user, Ops user can see all approval matrix)

User clicks on Create Approval Matrix button

User lands to the next screen and needs to select the org (by default if it’s an Org user), LEI name, Org type and Doc type (only those LEI_orgtype combinations which the user has access to)

User to click on Next which enables the second half of the screen (at this point the matrix has been created with 0 approval groups added)

User to now select the action and all approval groups (multi-select can be done) and add groups in the approval matrix (list of approval groups will be defined basis the Lei and org type selected in step 3)

User to click on submit and get redirected to the matrix listing screen





Edit an Approval Matrix



User lands on approval matrix listing screen which shows list of all approval matrix (access to be restricted basis the lei_orgtype defined for the user, Ops user can see all approval matrix)

User can filter on values using what lei_orgtype are defined for the user (Org, Lei and Org type, show all values for Ops user but only defined values for Org user)

User to click on edit button against any approval matrix and move to the matrix detail screen in edit mode where they can edit the approval groups defined against any action (no other details can be edited)

User to click on submit button which saves the updates by the user and redirects to the approval matrix listing screen

## [14] DMGS-117: Create, Edit, Delete Product Group

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-08-09T10:48:22.211+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-117](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-117)

### Description:
Create a Product Group



The user lands on the product group listing screen by clicking on Product Groups under the “Groups  Template” section of the side menu

The user will see the list of all product groups which belong to their Org

The user clicks on Create Product Group button at the top right

The user lands on the next screen where the user needs to provide the name of the group, select the org, and define the product lines for the product group

Once a product line (asset class, Product family  Product) is selected user needs to click on the “Add Product Line” button to add the line to the product group

If the user needs to select certain attributes for this product line they can do by expanding the product line

Once all the product lines are added user needs to click on submit to save the changes



Edit a Product Group



The user lands on the product group listing screen by clicking on Product Groups under the “Groups  Template” section of the side menu

The user will see the list of all product groups which belong to their Org

The user clicks onUpdate button against the Product Groupthey wish to edit

The user lands on the product group where they can edit the name and product lines of the product group

To add a product line user needs to select asset class, Product family  Product and click on the “Add Product Line” button to add the line to the product group

If the user needs to select certain attributes for this product line they can do by expanding the product line



Delete a Product Group



If the user wants to delete an existing product line they can do so by clicking on the delete button against the line they wish to remove

Once all the product lines are updated user needs to click on submit to save the changes

## [15] DMGS-118: Create, Edit, Delete Currency Group and Currency Pair Group

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-08-09T10:48:32.354+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-118](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-118)

### Description:
Create a Currency/Currency Pair Group



User lands on currency group listing screen (default), with a tab for currency pair listing screen which shows list of all currency/currencypair groups (access to be restricted basis the org of the user, Ops user can see all currency groups).

User clicks on Create New Group button which redirects user to currency group view and needs to provide the name of the group, select the org (by default if it’s an Org user, if it’s a Ops user they can select all org or any specific org) and the type of the group i.e. currency and currency pair

User to now select currency from the left section of the screen, all selected currencies/currencypair will move to the right side of the screen which shows the selected list (user can unselect from the selected list and move it back to the left side of the screen)

User to click on submit and get redirected to the listing screen





Edit a Currency/Currency Pair Group



User lands on currency group listing screen (default), with a tab for currency pair listing screen which shows list of all currency/currencypair groups (access to be restricted basis the org of the user, Ops user can see all currency groups).

User can search using the group name or filter using the organization.

User clicks on Edit Group button which redirects user to currency group view in edit mode. (All org groups can only be viewed by org user they can be edited only by Ops users)

User to now select currency from the left section of the screen, all selected currencies/currencypair will move to the right side of the screen which shows the selected list (user can unselect from the selected list and move it back to the left side of the screen)





User to click on submit and get redirected to the listing screen

## [43] DMGS-374: Enable users to define products under auth scope and capture the inputs with validations

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-09-30T11:18:40.323+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-374](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-374)

### Description:
<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><b style="font-weight:700"><span style="text-decoration:none">Product Selection</span></b></span></span></span></p>

<ol><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">User to first select the asset class (to be fetched basis the Doc Type, i.e. allowed asset classes for any product)</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">User to now select the product family of the product, based on the product family selected the list of products to be shown in the product drop-down. User can select multiple product family/products from the drop-down</span></span></span></span><ol><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If the user only selects the product family create one unique line for each product family selected, with an edit option to select the product corresponding to that product family</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If the user selects a list of product from the product families create one unique line for each product with an option to further expand and view the list of attributes applicable for that product (all attributes to be unselected by default)</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If the user selects a combination of 1 product family and products for the second product family create unique lines for product family for which product was not selected and unique lines for all products selected.</span></span></span></span></li></ol></li><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">Once added the following action can be taken on products in the selected product section of the screen</span></span></span></span><ol><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If a product family was selected user can break down the product family to single/multiple products of that family.</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If product was selected user can manage various attributes selected for each product.</span></span></span></span></li></ol></li></ol>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><b style="font-weight:700"><span style="text-decoration:none">Currency Selection</span></b></span></span></span></p>

<ol><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">User can select either currency or currency pairs by clicking on add currency button which opens up a pop-up to enable currency/currency pair selection.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">A currency once selected moves to the selected section of the pop-up (user can also remove a currency by clicking on X on the selected currency)</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">Once selected currency can be edited the same way from the selected section of the screen via the way they were added.</span></span></span></span></li></ol>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><b style="font-weight:700"><span style="text-decoration:none">Tenor Selection&nbsp;</span></b></span></span></span></p>

<ol><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If the product selected is Spot tenor values will be Spot and Up to Spot</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="1" style="list-style-type: decimal;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">If any other product or product family is selected tenor will have the following option and the value to be provided as input by the user</span></span></span></span><ol><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">Calendar Days</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">Business Days</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">Months</span></span></span></span></li><li aria-level="2" style="list-style-type: lower-alpha;"><span style="font-size:13pt; font-variant:normal; white-space:pre-wrap"><span style="font-family:Arial"><span style="color:#000000"><span style="text-decoration:none">Years</span></span></span></span></li></ol></li></ol>

## [44] DMGS-375: Enable users to see information on Preview and Submit tab

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-09-30T11:22:33.363+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-375](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-375)

### Description:
<p dir="auto"><b><span>Previewing the document</span></b></p>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>Under the preview section of the document, the user can preview all 5 sections of the document in view-only mode<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>To toggle to a new section click on the name of the section in the preview window<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>If the user wants to view the document in a continuous PDF format they can do so by clicking on the "View As PDF" button, a pop-up will open with the document in PDF mode<span>&nbsp;</span></li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-SubmittingthedocumentforApproval" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Submitting the document for Approval&nbsp;</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>After the document has been completed and all the content of the document has been put in place the last step is to submit the document for approval.</li><li>The user moves on to the "Preview and Submit" section of the document and sees a "Submit for Approval" button at the bottom right<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>The user clicks on the "Submit for Approval" button and the system checks whether for this document action (that will be "New Document" in this scenario) if any lite participants are part of the approval sequence</li><li>If the system finds lite participants a pop-up appears where the user needs to provide the lite participant email address/es<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>The user provides the email address for all lite participants, 1 email is mandatory with an option to add a 2nd one if needed<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Once all emails are added user click on "Submit" and the document is submitted for Approval and the user is re-directed to the document listing screen.</li></ol>

---

## [45] DMGS-376: Enable users to view and edit the list of documents 

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-09-30T11:24:06.172+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-376](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-376)

### Description:
<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-Selectadocumenttoeditanddefinethetypeofedit" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">View and edit the document</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the "Document" listing screen by clicking on "All Document" under the "Document" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)</span></li><li>Search for the document you wish to edit by using the document ID or available filters on the screen (only Enforced documents and existing drafts can be edited)</li><li>Click on the "Blue Edit" button against the document you wish to edit<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>A pop-up will appear and you need to first select the lei_orgtype on whose behalf you are making the edit<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>the next step is to select the type of edit you wish to do by selecting the value from the Action type dropdown<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Click on submit and the editing process will be started with the document in the "Draft" state</li></ol>

---

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-10-04T11:21:58.818+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-378](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-378)

### Description:
<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-CreateaTemplate" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px"><b>Create a Template</b></h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the document template listing screen by clicking on Document Templates under the "Groups &amp; Template" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>The user will see the list of all templates which belong to their Org<span>&nbsp;</span></span></li><li><span>The user clicks on Create New Template button at the top right</span></li><li><span>The user lands on the next screen where the user needs to provide the name of the template, select the org, and select the document type for which the template is being created<span>&nbsp;</span></span></li><li><span>The user clicks on Next which enables the second half of the screen (at this point the template has been created with no content within it)</span></li><li><span>The user now needs to define the approval workflow and click on next<span>&nbsp;</span></span></li><li><span>The user now moved to the enforcement rules and defines them and clicks next when done<span>&nbsp;</span></span></li><li><span>The user now moved to the final section of the template i.e. legal terms.<span>&nbsp;</span></span></li><li><span>The user after defining legal terms clicks on submit to save the changes to the template</span></li></ol>

## [52] DMGS-386: Dynamic workflow creation based on sequence and approval matrix defined

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2022-10-04T11:36:48.907+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-386](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-386)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Description:</p>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>The user needs to define the sequence in which approval takes place against each document action. They can do so by dragging and dropping participants from the top section of the approval workflow</li><li>If the user wants the participants to approve in parallel they can put the participants in the same Approval sequence</li><li>If the user wants the participants to approve in sequence (one after the other) they can put in different Approval sequences in the order<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>If the user wants a combination of parallel and sequential workflow they can define the same as well<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Once all workflow has been defined the user needs to click on "Next" (saves the changes and takes you to the Enforcement Rule section) or "Save As Draft" (saves the changes and keeps you on the approval workflow section).<span>&nbsp;</span><b>Please note if an online participant is added to any of the approval sequences they should have created their approval matrix for this Document Type without which you cannot proceed.</b></li></ol>

### Description:
<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-Selectadocumenttoeditanddefinethetypeofedit" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Select a document to edit and define the type of edit&nbsp;</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the "Document" listing screen by clicking on "All Document" under the "Document" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)</span></li><li>Search for the document you wish to edit by using the document ID or available filters on the screen (only Enforced documents and existing drafts can be edited)</li><li>Click on the "Blue Edit" button against the document you wish to edit<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>A pop-up will appear and you need to first select the lei_orgtype on whose behalf you are making the edit<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>the next step is to select the type of edit you wish to do by selecting the value from the Action type dropdown<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Click on submit and the editing process will be started with the document in the "Draft" state</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-EditApprovalWorkflow" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Edit Approval Workflow</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Edit Approval Workflow" the user will only be allowed to make changes to the Approval Workflow section of the document all other sections will be grayed out<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>After completing the changes user needs to click on submit for approval</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Edit Approval Workflow"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-EditEnforcementRules" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Edit Enforcement Rules</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Edit Enforcement Rules" the user will only be allowed to make changes to the Enforcement Rule section of the document all other sections will be grayed out<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>After completing the changes user needs to click on submit for approval</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Edit Enforcement Rules"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-EditLegalTerms" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Edit Legal Terms</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Edit Legal Terms" the user will only be allowed to make changes to the Legal Term section of the document all other sections will be grayed out<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>After completing the changes user needs to click on submit for approval</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Edit Legal Terms"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-RemoveProduct" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Remove Product</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Remove Product" the user will only be allowed to remove auth lines (only delete no addition is allowed) from the auth scope section of the document all other sections will be grayed out<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>After removing the auth lines the user needs to click on submit for approval</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Remove Products"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-RemoveCurrency" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Remove Currency</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Remove Currency" the user will only be allowed to make changes to the currency sub-section within auth scope of the document all other sections will be grayed out<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>The user will be provided with a list of all unique currencies across auth lines and they need to select the currency they wish to remove, the selected currencies will be removed from all the auth lines of the document</li><li>After selecting the currencies the user needs to click on submit for approval</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Remove Currency"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-EditLimit" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Edit Limit</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Edit Limit" the user will only be allowed to make changes to the limit value in the Limit Scope section of the document all other sections will be grayed out<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>After completing the limit values the user needs to click on submit for approval</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Edit Approval Workflow"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-EditDocument" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Edit Document</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>If the selected action was "Edit Document" the user has a free hand to make any changes to any section of the document<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>After completing the changes user needs to click on submit for approval from the Preview and Submit section.</li><li>A pop-up will appear asking for email addresses of lite participants if there are any defined in the Sequence against Document action "Edit Document"</li><li>Provide the email and click on submit document will be sent for approval</li></ol>
