### Description:
<h2 id="UserGuidev1.0-DefineEnforcementRules" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; border-bottom-color:#c4c4c4; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:20px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:normal; letter-spacing:-0.008em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">&nbsp;</h2>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>The user needs to define the enforcement rules that will apply to the document for 3 different types of actions new, edit and terminate the document</li><li>The enforcement rule could either be immediate or scheduled. If the rule is immediate no further action is needed.</li><li>In the case of a schedule, the user needs to define the time period by entering the value and selecting the type of duration from the drop-down.<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Once all 3 enforcement rules are defined the user can click on "Next" (saves the changes and takes you to the Legal Terms section) or "Save As Draft" (saves the changes and keeps you on the enforcement rule section).</li></ol>

### Description:
<h2 class="with-breadcrumbs" id="UserGuidev1.0-ProductGroup" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; border-bottom-color:#c4c4c4; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:20px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:normal; letter-spacing:-0.008em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Product Group</h2>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-CreateaProductGroup" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px"><b>Create a Product Group</b></h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the product group listing screen by clicking on Product Groups under the "Groups &amp; Template" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>The user will see the list of all product groups which belong to their Org</span></li><li><span>The user clicks on Create Product Group button at the top right</span></li><li><span>The user lands on the next screen where the user needs to provide the name of the group, select the org, and define the product lines for the product group<span>&nbsp;</span></span></li><li><span>Once a product line (asset class, Product family &amp; Product) is selected user needs to click on the "Add Product Line" button to add the line to the product group</span></li><li><span>If the user needs to select certain attributes for this product line they can do by expanding the product line</span></li><li><span>Once all the product lines are added user needs to click on submit to save the changes</span></li></ol>

## [77] DMGS-756: Authorization - User Service

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-01-02T12:52:19.775+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-756](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-756)

### Description:
View Own: Users should be able to view the users of their own org

View All: The user should be able to view users of all the orgs except their own org, also the user listing screen should be available to the user with this permission

View Own + View All: The user should be able to the users of all the orgs including their own org as well,also the user listing screen should be available to the user with this permission



EditOwn: Users should be able to editthe users of their own org i.e. Add new users using search and add, update the LEI_orgtype, update the roles and update the active/inactive status.

Edit All: The user should be able to edit the users of all the orgs except their own org

Edit Own + EditAll: The user should be able to edit the users of all the orgs including their own org as well

## [78] DMGS-757: Authorization - CurrencyService

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-01-02T12:52:30.397+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-757](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-757)

### Description:
<p>If a user has view own permission they should be able to see the currency groups of their org and global currency groups</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>If a user has view all permission they should be able to see all the currency groups own, others, and global</p>

<p>----------</p>

<p>If a user has edit own permission they should be able to see and edit currency groups of their org and view global currency groups</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>If a user has edit all&nbsp;permission they should be able to see and edit all the currency groups own, others, and global</p>

<p>------------</p>

<p>If a user has create own permission they should be able to create currency groups of their org only</p>

<p>If a user has create all permission they should be able to create all the currency groups&nbsp;own, others, and global</p>

### Description:
<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-Addinganewauthlineusingproductgroup" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Adding a new auth line using product group</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li>Select a Product Group the user want to use for creating auth lines in the auth scope<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Once a product group is selected the asset class, product family, and product group dropdown are greyed out (as the selection has already been done in the Product Group)<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Select currencies/currency pairs by clicking on add currencies option under "Auth Currencies", a popup will open with a list of currencies<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Select the currencies you wish to add and click on submit, currencies will be added to auth lines<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Enter the Tenor Value and Tenor Type<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>Once the user has defined auth product, currencies, and, tenor the option to add auth line will be enabled, user to click on "Add Auth Line"</li><li>All the auth lines based on how many product lines were in the product groups will be added to the auth scope section</li><li>Once all auth lines are created user clicks on "Next" (saves the changes and takes you to the Limit Scope section) or "Save As Draft" (saves the changes and keeps you on the Auth Scope section)</li></ol>

### Description:
<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-Terminatedocumentsinbulk" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Terminate documents in bulk</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the "Document" listing screen by clicking on "All Document" under the "Document" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)</span></li><li>The user clicks on the "Bulk Action" button on the top-right, and a drop-down with different actions appear</li><li>The user clicks on "Terminate" and a pop-up window opens, where the user needs to select the lei_orgtype on behalf of which they are terminating the documents in bulk and click on Next<span>&nbsp;</span></li><li>The user will be redirected to the bulk document selection screen which will list all the documents that are currently enforced and the selected lei_orgtype is one of the participants</li><li>The user can select the documents one by one or all in one go by using the checkbox in the first column</li><li>Once all documents are selected user clicks on the "Terminate" button, and a new bulk request with terminate action is created</li><li>The user is now redirected to the lite user alert screen where they need to provide email addresses for all those lite participants which are defined in the sequence against the Document action "Terminate Document" in their respective documents</li><li>Once provided user to click on submit and a request to terminate the documents in bulk will be submitted.</li></ol>

## [97] DMGS-991: Bulk Approve/ Reject on Document listing

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-02-15T08:47:16.004+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-991](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-991)

### Description:
Approve documents in bulk



The user lands on the “Document” listing screen by clicking on “All Document” under the “Document” section of the side menu

Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)

The user clicks on the “Bulk Action” button on the top-right, and a drop-down with different actions appear

The user clicks on “Approve” and a pop-up window opens, where the user needs to select the lei_orgtype and the approval group on behalf of which they are approving the documents in bulk

The user will be redirected to the bulk document selection screen which will list all the documents that are currently pending approval with this approval group

The user can select the documents one by one or all in one go by using the checkbox in the first column

Once all the documents to be approved in bulk are selected the user needs to click on Approve and a request to approve the documents in bulk will be submitted.



Reject documents in bulk



The user lands on the “Document” listing screen by clicking on “All Document” under the “Document” section of the side menu

Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)

The user clicks on the “Bulk Action” button on the top-right, and a drop-down with different actions appear

The user clicks on “Reject” and a pop-up window opens, where the user needs to select the lei_orgtype and the approval group on behalf of which they are rejecting the documents in bulk

The user will be redirected to the bulk document selection screen which will list all the documents that are currently pending approval with this approval group

The user can select the documents one by one or all in one go by using the checkbox in the first column

Once all the documents to be rejected in bulk are selected the user needs to click on the Reject button and a request to reject the documents in bulk will be submitted.

## [101] DMGS-1068: Bulk / Batch Processing of Docs to show indicative time to process

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2023-02-28T10:36:52.341+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1068](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1068)

### Description:
<p>When making a bulk change to documents there needs to be some indication of the time / progress being made&nbsp;to process</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Presently when making a bulk change there is no indication of the amount of time it will take for the changes to feed through, it could be minutes or hours. The customer will not know if the processing of the messages is working as expected or is in some way stuck. The customer will have to repeatedly revisit the screen and refresh to see if any progress has been made. Not a good experience for a user of this.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Couple of options I see that might work (Haim and Jack to offer views)</p>

<p>We provide some form of estimated remaining&nbsp;processing time</p>

<p>We show some form of progress indicator (processing message 2 of 60) that auto updates with progress.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Here is an example of what windows provides when copying files that might help with visualising&nbsp;</p>

<p><span class="image-wrap" style=""><img src="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202302281473320245782317871&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202302281473320245782317871&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png)" alt="" class="je-pasted-image" width="451" height="287" style="border: 0px solid black;"></span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Priority of the issue would be determined by the number of people likely to use it and the frequency of use <a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="197062" data-mention="sF3EKNjo" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=jackje](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=jackje)" rel="jackje" data-wiki="">Jack Jeffreys</a>&nbsp;<a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="197062" data-mention="T1enaa1Q" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=haim](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=haim)" rel="haim" data-wiki="">Haim Levy</a>&nbsp; to provide input here.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

## [106] DMGS-1090: Implement Bulk Approve/Reject permissions on document screen

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-03-15T09:12:03.119+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1090](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1090)

### Description:
<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-Approvedocumentsinbulk" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Approve documents in bulk</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the "Document" listing screen by clicking on "All Document" under the "Document" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)</span></li><li>The user clicks on the "Bulk Action" button on the top-right, and a drop-down with different actions appear</li><li>The user clicks on "Approve" and a pop-up window opens, where the user needs to select the lei_orgtype and the approval group on behalf of which they are approving the documents in bulk</li><li>The user will be redirected to the bulk document selection screen which will list all the documents that are currently pending approval with this approval group</li><li>The user can select the documents one by one or all in one go by using the checkbox in the first column</li><li>Once all the documents to be approved in bulk are selected the user needs to click on Approve and a request to approve the documents in bulk will be submitted.</li></ol>

<h3 id="UserGuidev1.0-Rejectdocumentsinbulk" style="-webkit-text-stroke-width:0px; background-color:#ffffff; color:#172b4d; font-family:-apple-system,&quot;system-ui&quot;,&quot;Segoe UI&quot;,Roboto,Oxygen,Ubuntu,&quot;Fira Sans&quot;,&quot;Droid Sans&quot;,&quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-style:normal; font-variant-caps:normal; font-variant-ligatures:normal; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:-0.006em; line-height:1.5; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:30px; orphans:2; padding:0px; text-align:start; text-decoration-color:initial; text-decoration-style:initial; text-decoration-thickness:initial; text-indent:0px; text-transform:none; white-space:normal; widows:2; word-spacing:0px">Reject documents in bulk</h3>

<ol dir="auto" style="list-style-type:decimal; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><li><span>The user lands on the "Document" listing screen by clicking on "All Document" under the "Document" section of the side menu</span></li><li><span>Here the user will be able to see all the document and their versions currently in the system (list restricted based on the lei_orgtype assigned to the user)</span></li><li>The user clicks on the "Bulk Action" button on the top-right, and a drop-down with different actions appear</li><li>The user clicks on "Reject" and a pop-up window opens, where the user needs to select the lei_orgtype and the approval group on behalf of which they are rejecting the documents in bulk</li><li>The user will be redirected to the bulk document selection screen which will list all the documents that are currently pending approval with this approval group</li><li>The user can select the documents one by one or all in one go by using the checkbox in the first column</li><li>Once all the documents to be rejected in bulk are selected the user needs to click on the Reject button and a request to reject the documents in bulk will be submitted.</li></ol>

## [137] DMGS-1418: Explanation as to what are emails for lite access users for on document creation

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-06-09T09:59:22.379+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1418](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1418)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Background</p>

<p dir="auto">It is possible to add an email underneath a lite access user in document creation, however it is not at all clear what the email is for or why it is there (unless you refer to the user guide). Please can we add a short inline&nbsp;explanation so that it becomes intuitive.</p>

<p dir="auto"><span class="image-wrap"><img alt="" class="je-pasted-image" height="86" src="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202306092161942059705670199&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202306092161942059705670199&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png)" style="border:0px solid black" width="570"></span></p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Requirement:</u></p>

<p dir="auto" style="margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><b>As</b><span>&nbsp;</span>an end user</p>

<p dir="auto" style="margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><b>I want</b><span>&nbsp;to be clearer on the purpose of the lite email id that is entered when editing my documents</span></p>

<p dir="auto" style="margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><b>So That</b>&nbsp;I do not enter an incorrect email id or not enter one at all when one is required.</p>

<p dir="auto" style="margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto" style="margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-top:10px; text-decoration-thickness:initial"><u>Acceptance Criteria:</u></p>

<ol dir="auto"><li style="margin: 10px 0px 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial;">The field label displays the text '<span style="color:#222222; display:inline; float:none; font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif; font-size:small; text-decoration-thickness:initial">+ Notification recipient email ID</span>' when a lite email id is required.</li><li style="margin: 10px 0px 0px; text-decoration-thickness: initial;">Emails are sent to the lite email id when document changes are applied and no lite email specification forms part of the workflow. This applies when editing limits, removing products and removing currencies.</li></ol>

## [138] DMGS-1420: Remove 'LEI Name' and replace with 'Legal Entity Name'

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-06-09T14:41:58.969+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1420](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1420)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Background:</p>

<p dir="auto">LEI stands for Legal Entity Identifier. 'LEI Name' as a term does not make&nbsp;no sense.</p>

<p dir="auto">A legal entity has a name and an identifier, as well as a bunch of other information like address, etc. It is the legal entity that has the name, not the identifier.</p>

<p dir="auto">If we use LEI Name, it will present to our a customers a view that we don't truly understand what we have built, hence the need to change it. Although our customers would probably understand what it means.</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Requirement:</u></p>

<p dir="auto">As the application</p>

<p dir="auto">I want all references to 'LEI Name' changed to 'Legal Entity Name'</p>

<p dir="auto">So That the application correctly reflects the industry known terminology&nbsp;for this attribute when used by customers.</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Acceptance Criteria:</u></p>

<p dir="auto">The following areas of the application now use the term 'Legal Entity Name' when the attribute is referenced:</p>

<ol dir="auto"><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Documents dashboard columns:<ol><li style="margin-left: 15px;">PB-1 LEI Name</li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">PB-2 LEI Name</li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Client-1 LEI Name</li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Client-1 LEI Name</li></ol></li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Approval groups dashboard column:<ol><li style="margin-left: 15px;">LEIs Name</li></ol></li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Approval group update:<ol><li style="margin-left: 15px;">'LEIs' in Approval group info section</li></ol></li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Approval matrix dashboard column:<ol><li style="margin-left: 15px;">LEIs Name</li></ol></li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">Approval matrix update:<ol><li style="margin-left: 15px;">'LEIs' in Approval matrix info section</li></ol></li></ol>

<p dir="auto" style="margin-left:15px">&nbsp;</p>

## [141] DMGS-1440: Copy Functionality on Dashboard not working or documented

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-06-23T14:44:52.919+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1440](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1440)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Background:</p>

<p dir="auto">The previous product development cycles included the requirement to add the ability for a user to take the core details of a submitted&nbsp;4 Ways document and use them to create a new 4 Ways document. Development work was started as per the screenshot attached but was not captured and development time ran out. As per <a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="201828" data-mention="3dIzUOpD" data-wiki="" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=aniket.agarwal](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=aniket.agarwal)" rel="aniket.agarwal">Aniket Agarwal (IHS Markit)</a>&nbsp;we cannot track down the unfinished development code from our repositories either.</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Requirement:</u></p>

<p dir="auto">As an ODC user</p>

<p dir="auto">I Want to copy the core details of a previously submitted 4 Ways document</p>

<p dir="auto">So That I do not have to re-enter the core details when creating&nbsp;a new 4 Ways document agreement which will contain the same core information. This will save me valuable document processing time.<br>&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Acceptance Criteria:</u></p>

<ol dir="auto"><li>The 'Copy' operation is available for external customers users who have been assigned the 'ORG_USER' user role.</li><li>The 'Copy' operation only applies to 4 Ways documents which are in an 'Enforced' document state.</li><li>The 'Copy' operation is available from the main 'Documents' dashboard as per the attached screenshot.</li><li>The following core details are defaulted and enabled&nbsp;/&nbsp;disabled on the new 4 Way document:<ol><li>Document Type:&nbsp;Defaulted to 4 Way. Field disabled.</li><li>Acting as: 'PB' and 'Client' dropdown&nbsp;options for user selection&nbsp;based on&nbsp;the organisation type.&nbsp;Fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Allowed currencies: Copied from originating document. Fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Document templates (optional): Field disabled.</li><li>Select parties: All 4 fields available for user to specify parties from dropdowns.&nbsp;Fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Approval Workflow: All fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Enforcement Rule:&nbsp;Copied from originating document.&nbsp;Fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Legal Term:&nbsp;Copied from originating document.&nbsp;Fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Auth Scope:&nbsp;Copied from originating document.&nbsp;Fields enabled and user editable.</li><li>Limit Scope:&nbsp;Copied from originating document.&nbsp;Fields enabled and user editable.</li></ol></li><li>The copied and user edited details on the new 4 Ways document can be previewed by the user.</li><li>The new 4 Ways document created based off the 'Copy' operation can be submitted into the system for approval.</li><li>The new 4 Ways document created based off the 'Copy' operation can be progressed through the ODC document workflow stages through to an 'Enforced' document state.</li></ol>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">Design Considerations:</p>

<ol dir="auto"><li>See attached screenshot of where the 'Copy' operation is to be made available.</li><li>The 'Create New Document' UX look and feel should be followed when creating the new document based off the 'Copy' operation.</li></ol>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><span class="image-wrap"><img alt="" class="je-pasted-image" height="250" src="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202305242350216152164699471&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202305242350216152164699471&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png)" style="border:0px solid black" width="553"></span></p>

## [152] DMGS-1515: Rename 'DMS' service to 'OSTTRA Documentation Centre'

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-07-26T17:06:28.922+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1515](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1515)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Background:</p>

<p dir="auto">Following senior management review, the 'DMS' service is to be renamed to be known as the 'OSTTRA Documentation Centre'.</p>

<p dir="auto"><b>Note</b>: 'Centre' is to be spelt using&nbsp;the UK English version.</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Requirement:</u></p>

<p dir="auto"><b>As</b> the application</p>

<p dir="auto"><b>I Want</b> to be renamed to&nbsp;the 'OSTTRA \ Documentation Centre' or&nbsp;'OSTTRA \ DC'&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><b>So That</b> we have an appealing and attractive branding name for the service.</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto"><u>Acceptance Criteria:</u></p>

<p dir="auto">The following application pages show&nbsp;'OSTTRA Documentation Centre' as the branding label:</p>

<ol dir="auto"><li>Main landing page.</li><li>Forgot&nbsp;password page.</li></ol>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">The following application pages show&nbsp;'OSTTRA DC' as the branding label:</p>

<ol dir="auto"><li>Banner at the top of the pages when viewing&nbsp;entities held in the system.</li><li>Banner at the top of the pages when creating entities into the system.</li><li>Help &amp; Settings page.</li><li>View Notifications page</li></ol>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">Considerations:</p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>We keep the 'OSTTRA' wording in black and the 'Documentation Centre' or 'DC' words are to be in pink.</li><li>Currently, when clicking on 'OSTTRA \ DMS' under pages 3 to 6 listed in the acceptance criteria will navigate the user to the documents dashboard. This is to be retained.</li><li>Do we have code with 'DMS' references which will become out of date and cause supportability issues?</li></ul>

### Description:
Description 



As the system undergoes continuous evolution, it becomes imperative to enhance its flexibility to optimize expandability and cater to a broader user base. With this goal in mind, we have taken into account the limitations identified in the existing system (Phase 1).

Therefore, we aim to make thesystem rely on OrgType permission, irrespective of the user.Consequently, the Approval Workflow will continue to function as it currently does without any changes.

## [194] DMGS-1740: Implement Auth Code Flow for controlled and consistent user experience

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-09T12:19:00.810+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1740](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1740)

### Description:
Spring Security recommends the adoption of the authorization code flow for UI Clients. Without its implementation, there will be diminished security, absence of refresh tokens, an inconsistent user experience, or the potential for credential exposure.

---

## [195] DMGS-1741: Remove Roles and Authorities from Controllers as it shouldn't be hardcoded

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-09T12:23:09.522+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1741](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1741)

### Description:
Microservices are designed to be loosely coupled and independently deployable components that can be developed, deployed, and scaled independently of each other. Hard coding roles and authorities directly into controllers violates some of the key principles of microservices, such as modularity, maintainability, and scalability.

---

## [196] DMGS-1742: Request header should not contain permissions

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-09T12:24:00.700+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1742](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1742)

### Description:
Considering the practice of setting permissions in response headers within microservices applications might indeed be regarded as a dubious programming approach. Such a practice could result in restricted service flexibility, heightened intricacy, and generate apprehensions about maintaining proper separation of application logic.

## [214] DMGS-1768: As a user, I should be able to view all requests on the listing screen

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-18T19:39:03.321+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1768](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1768)

### Description:
A user I should be able to view the list of all requests that were created by the Doc Type, Legal Entity & Org Type for which I have access to with a View/Edit/Create permission. The request list is not dependent on the user who created the request but only on Doc Type, Legal Entity and Org type of the requesting entity.This will help me keep a track of all the requests whether they are Approved, Rejected or still Pending awaiting approval from the requested entity

Acceptance Criteria:Users should access their dashboard via a button from the main interface like the menu section.The listing screen user should have the feature filter data Search request ID, dropdown doctype, and dropdown status.The dashboard should categorize requests into sections: Pending, Approved, and Rejected.

Each request card should show:Request ID:Purpose: To uniquely identify each document request.Type: Alphanumeric identifier.Type:Purpose: To specify the type of the requested document.Type: Textual description (e.g., "4 Way", "DN").Requested by:Purpose: To identify the user who initiated the request.Type: User's full name or email id.Requester’s legal entity:Purpose: To identify the legal entity of the requester.Type: Textual description (e.g., "JP Morgan-PB", "Citi Group-PB").Reviewed by:

## [215] DMGS-1769: Requests Approve/Reject Document Creation

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-18T20:11:35.140+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1769](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1769)

### Description:
As a designated approver, I want to review document creation requests, So that I can either approve or reject them.

Acceptance Criteria:A dashboard should display all pending requests to the approver.

Each request card should display:Request ID :Type:Requested by:Requester’s legal entity:Reviewed by:Reviewer’s legal entity:Requested on:Version ID:Status:

Two action buttons, "Approve" and "Reject," should be present on each request when the user opens any request details page.The listing screen user should have the feature filter data Search request ID, dropdown doctype, and dropdown status.On approval, the system should automatically create a document with 'draft' status, and the request status will be marked as approved.On rejection,  the request status will be marked as Rejected.

Page Navigation Controls:Users should be able to navigate to the next, previous, first, and last pages.Display the current page number and total pages (e.g., "Page 3 of 45").

Items Per Page Selection:Provide an option for users to choose how many requests they want to view per page (e.g., 10, 25, 50, 100).

## [217] DMGS-1773: Remove and Test Hard-coded Checks in GraphQL Code

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-19T08:00:28.151+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1773](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1773)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">It has come to our attention that there are hard-coded checks present in our GraphQL codebase. These hard-coded values could lead to potential issues in flexibility and maintainability. The task is to identify, remove, and replace these hard-coded checks with appropriate configurations or mechanisms. Post removal, the affected flow should be thoroughly tested to ensure functionality remains intact.<br><br><b>Steps</b>:</p>

<ul class="ul1" dir="auto"><li class="li1">Review the GraphQL codebase to identify any hard-coded checks.</li><li class="li1">Remove these hard-coded values and replace them with the appropriate configurations or dynamic checks.</li><li class="li1">Test the affected flow to ensure it functions as expected without any regressions.</li></ul>

<p class="p1" dir="auto"><b>Expected Result</b>:</p>

<p class="p1" dir="auto">The GraphQL code should be free of hard-coded checks, and the affected flow should function as expected.</p>

---

## [222] DMGS-1854: Bulk operations performance testing

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2023-11-03T16:48:50.511+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1854](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1854)

### Description:
Background:



In order to better understand the requirement raised viaDMS-1068,performance testing on bulk operations in ODC is needed to allow for informed decision making.



Requirement:



ODC has bulk operations initiated by users. Functional details around bulk operations can be foundherewhere required.





Can we get metrics on the following scenarios please:



Users:





Single user request

Is it worth testing against concurrent requests? Any recommendations?



Note - We don’t have active users on the prod atm but test with 5 concurrent users.



Number of documents:





10 documents

50 documents

100 documents (this is the current maximum limit).

Try with 500 documents as well - Please note limit is 100 on UI but we can increase by API



Note: Numbers are for comparison purposes.



Bulk operations to perform:



Bulk document approval

Bulk document rejection

Bulk document termination

Bulk currency removal across documents

Bulk product removal across documents

Bulk limit amendments across documents





Note: The scheduler that manages bulk operations runs at configurable periods so those ‘time delays’ need to be subtracted when capturing the time metrics.





Any recommendations on other performance testing scenarios are more than welcome!



Questions?

How many documents do we want the client to hold?

## [224] DMGS-1857: Reduce negotiation time across parties for 4 Way agreements

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2023-11-03T18:39:40.506+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1857](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1857)

### Description:
Natwest are the leading client on the street with respect to 4 Ways legal documents that ODC is centred around today and as such they are the No.1 target client for us. Their main gripe is that their current manual negotiationprocess when agreeing legal terms across 4 parties for an agreement is time heavy. Currently, our application is geared towards automating that negotiation process but Natwest have a requirement whereby they would like it to assist inreducingthe negotiation time spent. i.e. getting the system to lead users to accept legal terms presented rather than having the opportunity debating  negotiatingterms presented to them. It’s an interesting requirement. Example workflow:



PB 1 sets out terms with Client A

PB 2 agrees the terms with PB 1 and Client A

PB 1, PB 2 and Client A sets outs terms with Client B - this step is seen as time intensive as the negotiationhas to go through all 4 parties involved when Client B querys and debates agreement terms across all the respective legal teams.



Note: There may be scenarios where our clients want the full negotiationexperience too.

## [235] DMGS-1888: Inbound: Success / Failure event following CreditLink processing

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-11-14T16:17:04.581+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1888](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1888)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the Documentation Centre application

I Want to be updated on whether a EDN notification message sent to aconsumingsystem has been processed successfullyor not

So That an audit against the EDN is captured.

Acceptance Criteria:

* The ‘CreditLinkStatus’ for the EDN in the document dashboard is marked ‘Updated’ when the notification has been processed successfully.
* 2. The ‘CreditLinkStatus’ for the EDNin the document dashboard is marked ‘Update Rejected’ when the notification has not been processed successfully.
* 3. When the notification has not been processed successfully, the ‘Rejection Reason’ provided is reported against the EDN in the document dashboard.
* 4. Acceptance criteria 1, 2 and 3 apply to EDN notification messages sent to consuming systems when an EDN is enforced following i) Creation, and ii) is then Amended or iii) is then Terminated.
Design:

See the current “CreditLink Response” Success and Failure message formats as per section 2.0of the DNM Message API at:DNM Specification.

## [249] DMGS-1931: As a user, I should be able to add general terms to a new document based on selected participants

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-11-21T07:28:44.177+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1931](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1931)

### Description:
Description:As a user, I need the ability to add general terms to a new document tailored to the selected participants. This feature will enhance the document creation process by including relevant participant-specific information, making the documents more personalized and detailed.General Terms should exist as a separate section within the document and should have the following fields for all the participants to the document:Name of the participant and their LEI ID pre-filledContact (free text)Address (free text)Acting office (option to select from the available list or add your own value with only one input allowed)Relationship (dropdown)NAActing ThroughOperating ThroughSpecified Offices (option to select from the available list or add your own value with multiple inputs allowed)Notes (free text)None of the fields are mandatory, for UI view mock ups can be referredAny user that has the permission to the edit the document should be allowed to add general terms to the document.

Acceptance Criteria:General Terms Section Display: When creating a new document, a 'General Terms' section should be visible and accessible to the user.

Dynamic Participant-Based Content: The content in the 'General Terms' section should dynamically change based on the participants selected for the new document.

Participant Information Fields: For each participant, the following fields should be displayed:Address: A text field where the user can enter the participant's address.

Contact: A text field to enter contact details.

Acting Office: A dropdown (single select) to choose the acting office for the participant.

Relationship: A dropdown (single select) to define the participant's relationship to the document or other parties.

Specified Office: A dropdown (multi-select) allowing multiple office selections relevant to the participant.

Note: A text area for any additional notes or information about the participant.

User Interface: The interface for adding general terms should be intuitive and user-friendly, enabling easy navigation and data entry.

Data Validation: Appropriate validation checks (e.g., required fields, correct data format) should be in place for each input field.

Testing: The feature should be thoroughly tested for different scenarios, including varying numbers and types of participants.

Documentation: The feature should be documented clearly, with user instructions on how to utilize the new section.

## [258] DMGS-2023: As a user I should be able to view/edit general terms in a document

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-12-11T10:36:42.764+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2023](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2023)

### Description:
Description:General Terms once added to a document should be visible as a separate section in the Document Preview with all the details entered visible to the user.If the user wishes to edit the general term section of the document in future they can do so by selecting the relevant document and "Edit Document" action, The general term section will be blocked for editing in case of any other Document action being selected while editing the document.None of the fields are mandatory, for UI view mock ups can be referredAny user that has the permission to the edit the document should be allowed to edit general terms to the document.

Acceptance Criteria:Viewing General Terms:Users should be able to easily access and view all general terms included in a document.The display of general terms should be clear and well-organized to facilitate quick comprehension.

Editing Functionality:Users must have the ability to edit the general terms in a document.Editing options should include modifying text, adding or removing information, and adjusting participant-specific details.

Intuitive User Interface for Editing:The interface for editing should be intuitive and straightforward, allowing users to make changes without confusion.

Save and Update Changes:Changes made to the general terms should be savable with an easy-to-locate 'Save as Draft' or 'Next' button.Upon saving, the document should reflect the changes immediately.

Validation and Error Handling:Proper validation checks should be in place to prevent the entry of incorrect or incomplete information.Clear error messages should be displayed in case of invalid inputs.

Access Control:Only authorized users should have the ability to edit the general terms.Viewing permissions can be more flexible based on the document's confidentiality level.

Testing for Different Scenarios:The feature should be thoroughly tested.

Documentation and User Guide:Comprehensive documentation should be provided, detailing how to view and edit general terms.Best practices and guidelines for editing should also be included in the documentation.

---

## [259] DMGS-2024: As a user, I should be able to add fund/s to a new document for every client 

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-12-11T10:37:20.644+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2024](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2024)

### Description:
As a user, I need the ability to add funds to a new document for each client. This involves interacting with a user interface where I can select from existing funds or add new funds. The process should be initiated from the document’s header section, and a dedicated model (modal window) for fund management should appear for streamlined interaction.

Acceptance Criteria:



Accessing Fund Management:



From the document header section, there should be an ‘Add Fund’ option.

Clicking this option should open a modal on the right side of the screen for managing funds.





Fund Selection via Dropdown:



Within the modal, there should be a dropdown menu listing existing funds.

Users should be able to select one or multiple funds from this dropdown for the document.





Adding New Funds:



Users should have the option to add new funds through a simple text input field.

Upon entering the fund name and confirming, the new fund should be added to the list of available funds.





Search Functionality for Funds:



For clients with multiple funds, a search feature should be available to quickly locate specific funds.





Validation and Error Handling:



Proper validation (for existing fund names, correct input format) should be in place when adding new funds.

Clear error messages or prompts should be displayed for any invalid actions.





User Interface and Experience:



The modal and overall fund management interface should be user-friendly and intuitive.

The design should be consistent with the overall application’s user interface for coherence.





Performance Considerations:



The fund addition and search process should be optimized for performance, ensuring quick responses and minimal lag.





Testing and Documentation:



Extensive testing should be conducted to ensure reliability, especially for edge cases like adding duplicate fund names or handling a large number of funds.

Provide comprehensive documentation and user guides for this feature.

---

## [260] DMGS-2025: As a user, I should be able to view/edit the list of funds associated with any client in a document

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-12-11T10:37:49.946+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2025](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2025)

### Description:
<p class="p1" dir="auto">As a user, I need the capability to view and edit the list of funds associated with any client in a document. It should allow&nbsp;for adjustments and updates as client needs and fund details change over time.</p>

<p class="p1" dir="auto"><b>Acceptance Criteria:</b></p>

<ul class="ul1" dir="auto"><li class="li1"><b>Easy Access to View Funds:</b>

<ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">Users should be able to easily access and view the list of funds associated with a client within the document.</li><li class="li1">The funds list should be displayed in a clear, organized manner to facilitate quick understanding.</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>Editing Funds Information:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">Users must have the ability to edit the funds associated with a client. This includes adding new funds, and removing existing ones.</li><li class="li1">The editing process should be intuitive, with straightforward options for making changes. Editing should only be allowed when the selected action is "Edit Document".</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>User-Friendly Editing Interface:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">The interface for editing the funds list should be user-friendly, allowing for efficient navigation and data entry.</li><li class="li1">Necessary tools and options for editing (such as add, remove, save changes) should be clearly visible and accessible.</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>Validation and Error Handling:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">Proper validation checks should be in place to ensure the accuracy of the fund information being entered or modified.</li><li class="li1">Clear and informative error messages should be displayed for any invalid inputs or actions.</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>Security and Permissions:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">Ensure that only authorized users have the ability to view and edit the funds list, in line with the document's access controls and confidentiality requirements.</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>Performance and Efficiency:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">The view and edit functionality should be optimized for performance, ensuring responsiveness and minimal delay.</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>Comprehensive Testing:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">Thorough testing should be conducted to ensure the feature works reliably under various scenarios, including different document types.</li></ul></li><li class="li1"><b>Documentation and User Guide:</b><ul class="ul1"><li class="li1">Provide detailed documentation and user guides on how to view and edit the funds list, including any specific instructions or limitations.</li></ul></li></ul>

## [261] DMGS-2026: Add general terms and the list of funds to the pdf version of the document

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-12-11T10:38:32.881+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2026](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2026)

### Description:
As a user, I should be able to view the general terms and a list of funds in the PDF version of a document. Additionally, users should be able to view this enhanced PDF document once enforced and download it for offline use or sharing.

Acceptance Criteria:Inclusion of General Terms and Funds List:The PDF version of the document should include a section for general terms and a detailed list of funds relevant to the document.These sections must be formatted correctly and align with the overall document layout.

PDF Display and Readability:The PDF document, including the general terms and funds list, should be displayed clearly and be easily readable.Ensure that the text is well-formatted and the layout is not distorted in the PDF version.

Download Capability:Users must have the option to download the PDF document directly from the platform.The download process should be straightforward, with a clearly labeled download button or link.

Document Integrity and Accuracy:The PDF should accurately reflect all the latest changes and additions made to the document, including the general terms and funds list.Ensure that there are no discrepancies between the original document and the PDF version.

Performance and Efficiency:The generation of the PDF with the additional sections should not significantly impact the performance or speed of the system.The download process should be efficient, with minimal wait time for the user.

Testing for Reliability:The feature must be rigorously tested for various scenarios, including different document sizes, varying content in general terms and funds list, and multiple user access.

User Guidance and Support Documentation:Provide clear instructions and support documentation for users on how to view and download the PDF document with the newly added sections.

---

## [269] DMGS-2108: Remove Approve/Reject button for users where documents are currently not pending with the user

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-12-20T08:28:44.280+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2108](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2108)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Requirement:</p>

<p dir="auto">In the current system a user is presented with the approve/reject button against every document where any of the entities they belong to have is one of the participants in the document.</p>

<p dir="auto">If the document is currently pending with the user once they click on the Approve/Reject button they can go ahead and record their decision. However for scenarios where the user is not expected to approve/reject the document they are shown an error informing them the document is currently not pending with them.</p>

<p dir="auto">The change expected is to not show the Approve/Reject button itself to the user if document is currently not pending with them.</p>

<p dir="auto">Acceptance Criteria:</p>

<p dir="auto">From the Documents dashboard, the Approve and Reject action buttons are not visible to users when the document is not pending with them for review and subsequent approval or rejection.</p>

## [277] DMGS-2198: As a user, I should be able to create a new USP Rider template

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-01-16T10:27:01.392+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2198](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2198)

### Description:
As a PB user, I need the capability to create a new USP rider template. There should be dedicated section for USP riders in the Templates and Groups section of the navigation menu. From here if the user has the necessary permission they should be allowed to create new USP Rider templates.

A USP rider template will always be unique at the following grain, i.e. only a single template can exist for this combination. If a user is trying to create a duplicate in the system they shouldn't be allowed toDoc TypePartiesLEI 1 - PBLEI 2 - Client

Content of a USP Rider template is as follows:List of doc types for which the template can be used for (at least one, can be more than one)Name of the PB LEI (list restricted to the number of PB LEIs assigned to the user)Name of the Client LEI (list based on entire GLEIF database)PB Contact (Free text field with 100 char limit)USP Date (Date picker to choose date from)Option to include your own word clause (Free text 10000 char)Q&A section where the user can have one or more rows in the listCovered PB counterparty/Class of PB counterparties (typically the name of the LEI of the client or the funds belonging to the client)LEI based search on GLIEF or the user has the option to provide their own inputAgreed in writing to oral disclosure......Radio option (Yes/No)Agreed in writing to non-disclosureNo. 12-42 : Radio option (Yes/No)No. 12-58 : Radio option (Yes/No)

Additional Relief : Radio option (Yes/No)Wireframes shall be referred for UI/UX design and step-wise user journeyAcceptance Criteria:I should be able to create a new USP rider template in the system with all validations mentioned in the description holding true

User-Friendly Editing Interface:The interface for creating USP rider template should be convinient for navigation and data entry.Necessary tools and options for editing (such as add, remove, save changes) should be clearly visible and accessible.

Validation and Error Handling:Proper validation checks should be in place to ensure the accuracy of the USP information being entered or modified.Clear and informative error messages should be displayed for any invalid inputs or actions.

Security and Permissions:Ensure that only authorized users have the ability to view and create the USP list, in line with the document's access controls and confidentiality requirements.

Performance and Efficiency:The view and edit functionality should be optimized for performance, ensuring responsiveness and minimal delay.

Comprehensive Testing:Thorough testing should be conducted to ensure the feature works reliably under various scenarios, including different document types.

---

### Description:
As a user, I should be able to view and add the USP rider in the document. The document once in Draft state should have a separate section for USP rider (i.e. like Approval Workflow, Legal Terms, etc.)In the USP rider section the system should be able to identify based on the LEI of the PB and Client if a USP rider already exists between those 2 legal entities for that particular document type.If the USP rider exists user should be able to view the content of the same (just view not edit) and be given the option whether they wish to include it as part of the document via a checkbox. If the user selects the checkbox the USP rider becomes a part of the document as an addendum

If the USP rider does not exist, user if belonging to a PB should be given an option to create a new USP rider template from within document itself, once the template is created user should be able to see the checkbox with the newly created template available for use.Wireframes shall be referred for UI/UX design and step-wise user journey

Acceptance Criteria:Functional Journeys:I should be able to see the USP rider template for the parties if it exists alreadyI should be able to select the template if available and it should be added into the document

User-Friendly Editing Interface:The interface for adding USP rider template should be convenient for navigation and data entry.Necessary tools and options for editing (such as add, remove, save changes) should be clearly visible and accessible.

Validation and Error Handling:Proper validation checks should be in place to ensure the accuracy of the USP information being selected.Clear and informative error messages should be displayed for any invalid inputs or actions.

Security and Permissions:Ensure that only authorized users have the ability to view the USP template, in line with the document's access controls and confidentiality requirements.

Performance and Efficiency:The adding USP rider functionality should be optimized for performance, ensuring responsiveness and minimal delay.

Comprehensive Testing:Thorough testing should be conducted to ensure the feature works reliably under various scenarios, including different document types.

---

## [280] DMGS-2202: As a user, I should be able to view/edit an existing USP Rider template

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-01-16T10:32:22.010+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2202](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2202)

### Description:
As a: User

I Should: be able to view and edit USP Rider Templates, with restrictions on certain fields, and receive a confirmation for viewing impacted documents upon submission.

So that: I can efficiently manage USP Rider Templates and understand the impact of changes on associated documents.

User Story Description:

Upon clicking the “Update” button from the USP Rider Template listing screen, I should be directed to the USP Rider edit screen. On this screen, I should be restricted from changing the “Document Type” and “Selected Participants” but allowed to edit all other attributes of the USP Rider Template. Upon clicking “Submit,” a confirmation pop-up should appear, asking if I want to view impacted documents, with options to select “Yes” or “No.” Choosing “No” completes the update and returns me to the listing screen. Selecting “Yes” presents a pop-up with a list of associated documents, allowing for selection and actions on these documents.

Acceptance Criteria:



Edit USP Rider Template:



Users can edit attributes of the USP Rider Template except for “Document Type” and “Selected Participants.”





Submit Confirmation:



Upon submission, a confirmation pop-up asks if the user wants to view impacted documents, with “Yes” or “No” options.





AssociatedDocuments Pop-up:



Selecting “Yes” on the confirmation displays a pop-up listing associated documents with columns for Document ID, Version ID, DOCUMENT TYPE, USP TEMPLATE ID, USP UPDATE STATUS, LAST UPDATED ONand DOC STATUS.

The pop-up includes checkboxes associated with each document and the user can select either all the documents or partially via the check boxes.

After selection the user can simply click the APPLY button available at the bottom right corner.





Apply or Cancel Actions:



Clicking “Apply” button on the bottom right corner of the screenthe USP will be updated on the selected documents andthe user is navigatedto the USP Rider Template listing screen.

A “Cancel” option allows the user to bypass document updates and return to the listing screen.





USP Rider Template Listing Screen:



Post-update, the USP Rider Template listing screen includes a “Doc Count” column showing the number of associated documents for each template.

---

## [281] DMGS-2203: As a user I should be able to view and apply changes in a USP rider to the associated documents through the document listing screen.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-01-16T10:33:11.869+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2203](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2203)

### Description:
As a: UserI want: To see a "USP Status" column in the Document Listing screen indicating if the document's USP is "Pending" or "Applied," and to have a workflow for applying USP updates.So that: I can easily identify which documents need updates and efficiently apply the latest version of the USP

User Story Description:In the Document Listing screen, there should be a clear indication of the USP status for each document, categorized as either "Pending" (the document has an outdated USP) or "Applied" (the document has the latest USP version). For documents with a "Pending" status, when viewing the document details, a prominent message should alert me that an updated USP is available, with an option to view and apply the update. Additionally, when editing a document with a "Pending" USP status, a popup should provide me with options to handle the update before making further edits.

Acceptance Criteria:USP Status Column:The Document Listing screen includes a "USP Status" column showing "Up to date" or " New Update" & "N/A" for each document based on the USP version attached or if not attached.

View Document Screen:For documents with " New Update" status, a message is displayed at the top: "The USP attached to this document has been updated, do you want to view the update?"A "View" button is present, leading to a comparison view of the USP template, with "Cancel" option for closing the comparison.

Edit Document Screen:Upon initiating the "EDIT DOCUMENTS" action for a document with a "Pending" USP status, a popup message appears: "The USP attached to this document has been updated. Do you want to apply the changes?"The popup provides two options: "Yes" & "No", Clicking on yes will populate the comparison view and the user will be available with the Apply button there if they want to apply the Updated USP on the document.

Comparison View:The comparison view clearly displays the differences between the current and updated USP templates, facilitating informed decisions on applying the update.User Choices:Selecting "Yes" will populate the comparison view for the user.Selecting "No" will close the popup of Update alert and the user will be able to continue the editing.

---

## [282] DMGS-2204: As a user, I should be able to view the list of all USP Rider templates

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-01-16T11:43:21.402+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2204](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2204)

### Description:
As a PB user, I should be able to view the list of allUSP rider templates belonging to my legal entities (PB). There should be dedicated section for USP riders in the Templates and Groups section of the navigation menu.



The list should have the following columns:



ID: Unique ID of the USP rider

PB Name: Name of the PB LEI

Client Name: Name of the Client LEI

Doc Type: The list of doc types for which the USP rider template is allowed to be used for (in case of more than 1 doc type show +x icon that on hover shows the complete list of doc types)

Last updated by: email of the user who made the last update to the template

Last updated on: Time and date when the last change was done by the user

Action: View/Update (based on the user permission)



The listing screen should also the users to search/filter based on the following:



Search based on the USP rider ID

Dropdown and searchable multi-select filter for the PB name

Dropdown and searchable multi-select filter for the Client name

Dropdown and searchable multi-select filter for all the available Doc-Types



Wireframes shall be referred for UI/UX design and step-wise user journey



Acceptance Criteria:



Functional Journeys:



I should be able to see the list of all existing templated belonging to my PB LEIs

I should be able to search using a particular USP rider ID

I should be able to filter based on the PB name, Client name and Doc types





User-Friendly Editing Interface:



The interface for creating USP rider templateshould be convenient for navigation and data entry.

Necessary tools and options for editing (such as add, remove, save changes) should be clearly visible and accessible.





Validation and Error Handling:



Proper validation checks should be in place to ensure the accuracy of the USP informationbeing entered or modified.

Clear and informative error messages should be displayed for any invalid inputs or actions.





Security and Permissions:



Ensure that only authorized users have the ability to view theUSP list, in line with the document’s access controls and confidentiality requirements.





Performance and Efficiency:



The view and search functionality should be optimized for performance, ensuring responsiveness and minimal delay.





Comprehensive Testing:



Thorough testing should be conducted to ensure the feature works reliably under various scenarios, including different document types.

* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2276](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2276)

### Description:
Requirement:



ODC has bulk operations initiated by users. Functional details around bulk operations can be foundherewhere required.





Can we get metrics on the following scenarios for Designation Notice agreements (DN’s:



Users:





Single user request

5 concurrent users





Number of documents:





50 documents

1000 documents

5,000 documents

10,000 documents

Bulk operations to perform:



Bulk document approval

Bulk document rejection

Bulk document termination

Bulk currency removal across documents

## [291] DMGS-2303: Outbound- Send Error "Edn Update CreditLink - Error"(Both UI & backend)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-02-07T06:37:16.552+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2303](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2303)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the Documentation Centre application

I Want to inform interested consumer systems when an updated electronic designation notice (EDN) which is enforced and synced with CreditLink to be deleted on consumer system.

So That they are able to carry out subsequent required processing. E.g. the CreditLink application deletes tri-party credit lines created as per the agreement details specified in the EDN.



This functionality should be available only for **Osttra admin users** and gets sent to CreditLink, when Admin User presses the Error CreditLink button.

**UI representation: **An “Error to CreditLink” button should be given for osttra admin users who wants to delete the setup from creditlink,

Creditlink can either accept this error event and delete all the reference credit line and send back success or it can reject it and send back failure as Error Rejected and this should get updated on CreditLink sync status.



* Will be enabled only if all selected EDNs are:

* EDN is not Terminated and
* EDN is **Enforced **and
* Credit Link Status= Updated/Error Rejected
* Once the user presses this button the following actions will occur:

* Send "Edn Update CreditLink - Error" Event to the selected EDN's
* Set Credit Link Status=Error.


**ODC event or message type name**: Edn Update CreditLink - Error  (Sent to CreditLink, when Admin User presses the Error CreditLink button)

The ODC application should set the CreditLink sync status as “Error” once the user clicks this button to send error message to CreditLink. The Error creditlink button should be shown only for Updated Edns i.e. whose creditlink sync status is Updated.



CreditLink will send back success or failure message back to ODC:

Success

 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Message Name="CreditLink Response"><Doc Id="4000699" Action="Sync" Time="19082015:092904"/><Status Value="**Success**" Reason=""/></Message>

 

Failure

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><Message Name="CreditLink Response"><Doc Id="4000116" Action="Terminate" Time="10082015:062831"/><Status Value="**Rejection**" Reason="could not locate LEI by ID - "/></Message>







Acceptance Criteria:

The Documentation Centre application sends out messages to consuming systems when an EDN which is enforced and synced to be deleted on creditlink side.



Design:

See the current “EDN Update CreditLink - EDN Terminated” message format as per section 1.3.1of the DNM Message API at:[DNM Specification.](https://wiki.traianaops.luminatesec.com/pages/viewpage.action?spaceKey=DNM&title=Messaging+API+between+DNM+and+CreditLink)

Ref DNM design:

## [298] DMGS-2337: Enhance USP Rider Template Listing Screen with Document Count and Detailed Pop-up View

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-02-12T16:54:38.799+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2337](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2337)

### Description:
As a: UserI want: To see a "Document Count" column in the USP Rider Template listing screen and interact with numeric links to view associated documents.So that: I can easily manage and apply USP Template updates to documents associated with specific USP Rider Templates

User Story Description:In the USP Rider Template listing screen, a new "Document Count" column should be added to display the number of documents associated with each USP Rider Template. Clicking on the numeric link in this column will open a pop-up on the right side of the screen, showing a list of associated documents for the selected USP Rider Template. This pop-up will enable users to view document details, select/deselect the documents with pending status which implies that the USP update has not been applied on that particular document and apply updates directly from the listing screen.

Acceptance Criteria:Document Count Column:A "Document Count" column is visible on the USP Rider Template listing screen, showing the number of associated documents for each template.Interactive Numeric Link:Clicking on a numeric link in the "Document Count" column opens a pop-up on the right side of the screen.The pop-up displays a list of documents impacted by the selected USP Rider Template.

Pop-up Details:The pop-up includes columns for Document ID, Document Version ID, USP Template ID, and USP Update status, Last created on, Doc status.Under USP update status the user will be available with 2 statuses: 1. NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE, 2. UP TO DATE.Users can select/deselect all documents with a NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE.An "Apply Update" button is available for users at the bottom right of the screen to apply updates to selected documents.

View Update Feature:Next to each USP Template ID, a "View Update" link is provided.Clicking "View Update" opens a comparison view between the enforced USP Rider and the latest USP Rider version for that document.Pending Status and Apply Button:Documents with updates not yet applied display a "NEW UPDATE AVAILABLE" status in the USP Update status.The user can select either all the documents on which the user wants to apply the updated USP on or the user can partially select the documents via the checkbox associated with each of the document.After selecting the documents, the user can click on apply button available on bottom right corner and apply the change on the selected documents.
