## [313] DMGS-2495: As a user I should be able to apply the USP in bulk to the relative documents.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-03-11T10:18:24.535+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2495](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2495)

### Description:
As a user, I should be able to apply the USP Rider created to all documents in bulk, ensuring consistency across documents with the same Prime Broker and Client combination used during USP creation.



Journey:

When a user creates a USP rider template and clicks on submit the user gets a toast notification notifying “The USP has been created successfully”

Along with this the user gets a prompt asking the user “Do you want to view the Impacted document.” with two options for a user to choose from “Yes” or “No”,



Clicking on Yes will populate a list of documents with the same PB  Client combination. The user can choose the documents to apply the USP to via this listing.

Clicking on Nowill take the user to the main USP listing screen.



Listing screen properties:

The document listing screen which populates after click on YES will have the following columns/Properties:



The user will be available with the check box to either select all the documents or partial documents to apply the USP to.

Columns:



DOCUMENT ID

VERSION ID

TYPE

USP Template ID

Last Updated On

USP Status

Doc Status







Acceptance Criteria:



The application interface includes a bulk apply feature accessible to users with appropriate permissions.

The system accurately identifies and retrieves all documents matching the specified Prime Broker and Client combination.

The selected USP Rider/EBC is applied consistently to all retrieved documents without any errors or inconsistencies.

A confirmation prompt or dialogue box is displayed to users before applying the USP Rider/EBC in bulk to ensure user confirmation.



Definition of Done:



Bulk apply feature implemented in the application interface.

Testing conducted to verify the accuracy and functionality of bulk apply functionality.

Confirmation prompt added to ensure user confirmation before applying the USP Rider/EBC in bulk.

User documentation updated to include instructions on using the bulk apply feature.



Additional Information:

This user story aims to streamline the process of applying USP Rider/EBCs to multiple documents with the same Prime Broker and Client combination, ensuring consistency in branding and messaging across related documents. The bulk apply feature enhances efficiency and productivity for users managing multiple documents within the application.

---

## [314] DMGS-2496: As a user I should not be able to see the USP Date section on USP Creation screen and instead it should be configurable at Document level.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-03-11T10:21:09.626+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2496](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2496)

### Description:
As a user, I should not be able to see the USP Date section on the USP Creation screen. Instead, it should be configurable at the Document level to allow for more flexibility and customization in managing USP dates.



Acceptance Criteria:



The USP Date section is removed from the USP Creation screen in the application interface.

A new configuration option is added at the Document level to specify the USP date for each document.

Users with appropriate permissions can access and modify the USP date configuration for individual documents.

The configured USP date is accurately reflected in the system and associated reports.

Proper validation is implemented to ensure that only valid date formats and ranges are accepted for USP dates.

User documentation is updated to include instructions on configuring USP dates at the Document level.



Definition of Done:



USP Date section removed from the USP Creation screen.

Configuration option added at the Document level for specifying USP dates.

Testing conducted to verify the accuracy and functionality of the USP date configuration.

Validation checks implemented to ensure data integrity and prevent errors.

User documentation updated to reflect the changes and provide guidance on configuring USP dates.



Additional Information:



This user story aims to enhance the flexibility and customization options within the application by allowing users to configure USP dates at the Document level.This change enables users to tailor USP date settings according to their specific document management requirements.

When a USP is edited and attached to the document then the USP date should be same which was initially defined while creating the document.

---

## [315] DMGS-2517: As a OSTTRA OPS & PS user I should be having only USP_VIEW_ALL permissions only.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-03-18T05:16:32.288+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2517](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2517)

### Description:
<p dir="auto"><b>Acceptance Criteria:</b></p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>User roles are configured to limit OSTTRA OPS &amp; PS users to only USP_VIEW_ALL permissions.</li><li>Users with this role should be unable to perform actions beyond viewing all relevant data within the system.</li><li>Access controls are implemented to prevent unauthorized users from modifying or accessing restricted functionalities.</li><li>Verification conducted to ensure that OSTTRA OPS &amp; PS users can only access information pertinent to their roles and responsibilities.</li><li>Regular monitoring and auditing mechanisms are established to maintain compliance with access restrictions.</li></ul>

<p dir="auto"><b>Definition of Done:</b></p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>User roles and permissions are configured according to specifications.</li><li>Testing conducted to verify that only USP_VIEW_ALL permissions are granted to OSTTRA OPS &amp; PS users.</li><li>Access controls successfully implemented to enforce restrictions on user actions.</li><li>Documentation updated to reflect the changes in user roles and permissions.</li><li>Approval obtained from stakeholders confirming compliance with security requirements.</li></ul>

<p dir="auto"><b>Additional Information:</b></p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>The purpose of this user story is to enhance security measures within the OSTTRA OPS &amp; PS system by limiting user permissions to USP_VIEW_ALL access only. This ensures that sensitive data and functionalities are protected from unauthorized access or modifications.</li></ul>

## [316] DMGS-2518: As a user I should be available with a apply USP Action to define the relative approval cycle of documents.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-03-18T05:18:27.015+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2518](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2518)

### Description:
As a user I should be available with a Apply USP action in the “Approval Workflow”, “Approval Matrix”, “Single edit action.” so that a user has a capability to define an approval cycle for a document after the following cases:



After the creation of USP when a user applies the USP to documents in bulk.

If a USP is already attached to documents and then a user updates the USP and then attaches the updated USP to relative documents.



For both of the above-mentioned cases the user can define a sequence in the workflow to define the approval cycle, if the user chooses not to define the sequence, then the documents will not go through the approval.



Acceptance Criteria:



“Apply USP” action is integrated into the “Approval Workflow,” “Approval Matrix,” and “Single Edit Action” functionalities within the application interface.

Users are provided with the option to initiate the approval cycle when applying a USP to documents in bulk or selective.

When updating a USP and attaching it to documents, users have the ability to define a sequence in the approval workflow.

If users choose not to define the sequence, the documents will skip the approval process.

Proper validation is implemented to ensure that the defined approval sequence aligns with organizational policies and requirements.

User documentation is updated to provide guidance on utilizing the “Apply USP” action and defining approval sequences.



Definition of Done:



“Apply USP” action integrated into the specified functionalities.

Testing conducted to verify the accuracy and functionality of the approval workflow.

User documentation updated to reflect the changes and provide instructions on defining approval cycles.



Additional Information:

This user story aims to enhance the document management process by providing users with the ability to incorporate USP application actions within the approval workflow. This feature promotes consistency and compliance with approval procedures, ensuring that documents adhere to organizational standards and requirements.

---

## [324] DMGS-2640: Replace "LEI's" references with LEI Name

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-04-08T17:08:29.056+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2640](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2640)

### Description:
Background:LEI stands for Legal Entity Identifier.A legal entity has a name and an identifier, as well as a bunch of other information like address, etc. It is the legal entity that has the name, not the identifier.If we use LEI, it will present to our a customers a view that we don't truly understand what we have built, hence the need to change it. Although our customers would probably understand what it means.

Requirement:As the applicationI want all references to 'LEIs' changed to 'Legal Entity Name'So That the application correctly reflects the industry known terminology for this attribute when used by customers.

Acceptance Criteria:The following areas of the application now use the term 'Legal Entity Name' when the attribute is referenced:Approval group update:'LEIs' in Approval group info sectionApproval matrix update:'LEIs' in Approval matrix info section

## [333] DMGS-2667: As a user I should be available with Traiana Approval Section in Document.

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2024-04-15T08:57:24.570+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2667](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2667)

### Description:
As a user I should be available with a TRAIANA APPROVAL section in Documents with the following attributes captured:



STANDARD CLAUSE:





Notwithstanding any provision contained under any master give-up agreement (“MGUP”) between (1) the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, and (2) the Prime Broker governing the issuance of a Designation Notice (as defined below) which purpose is for the Prime Broker to designate a counterparty (“Designated Party”) to enter into transactions on its behalf with the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, and applying the specified trading parameters applicable to such Designated Party, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, hereby agree and acknowledge that to the extent that a Designation Notice is issued through the CreditLink DNM platform operated by Traiana Harmony TM for the purposes of Designation Notice issuance and management (the “System”), the Designation Notice’s terms described under the MGUP are hereby restated by the applicable Designation Notice’s terms under the System. The parties using the System hereby agree, by accepting the following terms and conditions, that to the extent a Designation Notice is issued through the System, the parties consent to amend their MGUP in relation to the Designation Notice by applying the issuance and notification process as provided by the System’s terms and conditions, and hereby waive any requirement under their MGUP by which any amendment to the MGUP has to be agreed in writing or be delivered in a specified manner or to a specified destination. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the parties agree that any purported amendments to the MGUP made outside the System shall be made pursuant to the terms of the relevant MGUP.

“Designation Notice” means  a notice substantially in the form described under the MGUP with the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, (“Paper DN”), and/or (ii) an electronic designation notice (“EDN”) transmitted from the Prime Broker to the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, via the System, each or both as may be amended from time to time in accordance with the terms of the MGUP. For the avoidance of doubt, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, hereby agree that an EDN shall constitute a legally binding and enforceable agreement between the parties. For the further avoidance of doubt, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, agree that a Designation Notice may be  sent as, (ii) amended by or (iii) terminated by, a Paper DN and/or an EDN, and in the event of any inconsistency between a Paper DN and an EDN, the Designation Notice issued later in time shall prevail with respect to the term(s) being established or amended.

“Prime Broker” means the party designated as “PB” in the System that is the party under the MGUP designating a Designated Party to enter into transactions on its behalf with a Dealer or Executing Broker.

“Dealer or Executing Broker” means the party designated as “EB” in the System that is the party under the MGUP designated to enter into transactions with certain counterparties designated by the Prime Broker as Designated Parties.

## [343] DMGS-2728: Approval workflow implementation of restrictions (backend) 

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-04-30T09:28:57.680+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2728](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2728)

### Description:
* User should be able to add only online participants in approval workflow of restrictions.
* 2. approval workflow of restrictions should contain seq1 and seq2 to add the participants.
* 3. when user submits the restriction for approval, the document should go for approval to participants added in workflow sequence wise.
* 4. If any participant rejects the restriction document, it should go in Rejected state.
* 5. when all the participants approve the document, the restriction should enter the Approved state.
* 6. Participants can only be added in approval workflow if they have an approval matrix defined with approval groups in defined document actions (approval matrix should exist for doc type DN)
* 7. DN approval workflow should also be tested as it should have no impact from restriction workflow

## [359] DMGS-2814: Approval and status change Notification(In-app) Implementation for PB & EB

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-09T12:33:59.109+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2814](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2814)

### Description:
Once the Restriction Document is created and submitted for approval then basis on the approval workflow for both New document and Edit document a notification should be sent to the Users onboarded on the participants LEI.

For the PB users we need to send in app notification as PB has to be online for creating restrictions and for EBs if it is online then in app notification( Lite EB will not be part of approval workflow for RN)



ODC should publish a notification( In- app only) to the PB and EB whenever the lifecycle status of restriction changes.



Draft State: A notification to PB and EBspecifies a restriction is created between these participants.

In Approval: Approval notifications as perDMS-2814

Approved: A restriction among PB and EB is approved and a document can be created using these restrictions.

Terminated: A restriction among PB and EB is now terminated.

Expired: A restriction is expired and new version is created.



Online participants should have in app notification.



Templates: Existing document creation in-app notification can be referred here as well.

Acceptance Criteria’s:

1.) Once restriction is submitted for approval then notification should be sent(in app) to the participants listed on approval workflow for new restriction and edit restriction.

2.) Online participants can approve the restrictions from listing screen.

3.) Upon the response on approvals, the status should be reflected and updated accordingly on restriction document.

4.) For RN’s lifecycle status change should be sent via in app notification to associated online PB and EB.

---

## [360] DMGS-2816: Notification service for Restriction documents(mail notifications) - Part 1

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-09T12:48:23.997+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2816](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2816)

### Description:
As an application, it should publish a notification to the PB and EB whenever the lifecycle status of restriction changes.

So that they are notified about the state of restriction on which they are acting as one of participant.



**Rules for Online participants:**

1.) Mail notification to be sent  for asking approvals(if approval is pending from online participants) if the RN is in approval state.

2.) Mail notification should be sent in case of termination.

3.) Mail notification should be sent once the RN is approved.

Note: Lite participants is not necessary to approve the restriction. Restriction approval is limited only for the online participants.

**Recipients of Mail notification:**

1.) Online participants(PB & EB): the mail should be sent to the people who are assigned with DN management and DN Approval manager for that entity.

2.) For Lite users, the mail should be sent to the mail address provided  at the time of selecting an lite entity on the creation screen.

**Acceptance Criteria's:**

1.) Both online and lit user should receive the mail notification whenever the status of RN changes to in approval, approved or terminated.

2.) Follow up mail notification should be sent if approval is pending for 24hrs, 48hrs, 96 hrs.





Templates: (attached)



Assumptions for estimation:

* Lite is to implemented together with this story
* 2. 15 pds - multiple email notifications, coordination for platform changes (prepare templates and provide to them), we lack clarification around event
* 3. Dependency on platform team. Cannot test without code changes at their end?
Email Templates:

## [361] DMGS-2818: Import Restriction framework on Doc creation (both backend and UI)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-09T14:28:05.104+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2818](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2818)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I Should be able to import the Restriction Framework defined between PB & EB on the Doc creation journey

So That the auth scope, limit scope, enforcement rules(read only), approval workflow(read only) gets synced on my doc creation journey for creating a Doc between PB, EB & Client.

Note: We should be able to import the RN definition as soon as the user clicks the Next button on the creation new document journey and its definition should be updated on the document and stored on the backend for further validation when the user edits the document while creating and editing afterwards. 



Validation Check:

1.) If the RN definition fails to get imported on document, then the application should not allow the user to proceed ahead for doc creation.

2.) If there is no RN defined between the selected PB and EB then an error warning should be issues “The Restriction Framework between the selected PB and EB does not exist, Please create a Restriction framework between these parties to proceed ahead with document creation.” and application should not let the user move ahead with doc  creation.

3.) Application should not allow partial import of RN definition and allows user to create document.



Acceptance Criteria:

* User should be able to import the RN definition on doc creation journey.
* User should get validation warnings if there is no RN defined between parties.
* RN definition including Auth scope, limit scope, enforcement rules (read only), approval workflow (read only) should be populated on the doc creation journey.
* Partial import should not let the user create document.

---

## [362] DMGS-2819: Auth Scope definition on Doc creation as per restriction (UI)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-09T14:29:48.378+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2819](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2819)

### Description:
**Requirement:**

As a user when I am creating a doc then I should be able to create/define the Auth scope as per the defined Restriction framework

So that I can created an EDN(Document) between PB-EB-Client via doc creation journey.

**This requirement should be developed via considering below business rules:**

Rule1: The create auth line ribbon(Auth Product) should have only Asset class, Product family and Product selection drop downs only. Auth currency and Auth Tenor should not be reflected.

Rule2:  Product Family and Product dropdown should only show the selection which are true(selected) on  its corresponding restriction definition rest all should be shown as greyed out product family and product.

Rule3: User Can select any product family only or its combination with its associated Products from dropdown and then the “ Add Auth Line” button should allow the user to create that product auth line.

Rule4: Basis on selection in rule 3 only those auth scope line should appear which were selected or are part of auth scope definition on Restriction.

Rule5: The currencies/Currency Pairs will be auto selected as per selection done on RN for a particular auth scope line i.e. all the currencies selected on RN will only be possible for selection on Doc creation.

Rule6: Auth tenor will be default selected as per the definition on RN.

Rule 7: A Text should be shown below the Auth tenor filed showing the max allowed Tenor of the particular auth scope line.

Rule8: An opt in/Flag/Slider(green if selected else in Off mode) should be provided on all the Auth scope line on Doc creation form, by defalt this flag should be in turned off mode(opt out) specifying these lines are not considered for this document.

Rule 9: Selected auth scope line via flag will be up for editing and user can change the selection of currencies, change the Tenor as per the scope of RN and can change the product attributes.

Rule 10: Product attributes will appear as per the selection done on RN and will follow below conditions:

a.) if out of one or multiple attributes under same category were all un selected on RN then user should be allowed to select any one of them or multiple selection or all selection. User can remain in decisive also and can leave them all un selected(all will be considered as selected as per the flexibility).

b.) If out of multiple combination, user had selected only one or two option on RN then on docs user should be able to select either those one or two options only rest everything should appear in greyed out manner.

c.) If all the options were selected under RN then user should get all the option to select or can select few out of them.



**Validation Check:**

1.Tenor: if the user tries to enter the auth scope greater than the values defined on RN then it should give a warning by making the input field red and saying “Tenor is exceeding its limit defined on RN.”

1 year=12 months

1 months= Max 31 days or Business days

1 Year= Max 366 days or business days



**Acceptance Criteria's:**

1.) There should not be any pre-populated Auth scope lines on doc creation form.

2.)all the rules mentioned above i.e. rule no 1 to rule no 10 will become acceptance criteria's as well.

## [363] DMGS-2820: Limit scope integration from restriction(both backend and UI)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-09T14:30:23.046+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2820](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2820)

### Description:
**Requirement:**

As a ODC user I should be able to define the limit value against the limit scope imported from RN

So that Limit scope line definition gets completed and an associated position based credit line can be created on risk systems for limit monitoring.



**Detailed Requirement:**

As soon as the RN gets imported at the time of doc creation journey then all the limit scope lines gets pre-populates on the Document’s limit scope section. User will be able to define the limit values against the limit scope lines. 

A flag need to be introduced  on each limit scope line which basically indicates whether the user want to opt for this limit scope line or not.

Or a N/A flag radio button, if selected then that particular limit scope line wont be considered for selection and sync.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

1.) User should get the pre-populated list of all the limit scope lines

2.) Lines opted for only will be considered for the validation check

3.) Lines without the limit values should not allow the user to move to next screen or save and submit the draft.

4.) Apart from limit value, user should not be able to edit/alter the scope of limit scope line.

## [364] DMGS-2822: Restriction Edits enhancement on documents journey(Approval workflow)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-09T14:33:25.638+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2822](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2822)

### Description:
As an ODC application whenever the active restriction is edited then automatically the scope of changes should be updated on the associated EDNs

So that the EDNs will always remain in sync and as per the definition of Restrictions.

**Detailed requirement:**

Scenario1: When the scope gets narrowed(deletion of limit scope line, removal of product, currency, tenor narrow down)  and this RN has active EDN associated  to it then once the RN gets fully approved then via batch process we need to update these narrowed scope on the impacted EDNs and the associated EDN will go for approval again as per the approval rules defined for edit document.

Changes on the limit scope definition is also considered as scope narrow only and associated limit scope lines should get removed from the document.

During the cycle of approval of RN, user can not make any changes on the EDNs and application should give exclusive waring saying “The corresponding restriction framework for the PB-EB is waiting for approvals and you can not amend the document during this period”.

## [379] DMGS-2911: CreditLink Sync functionality

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-06-05T07:58:15.958+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2911](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2911)

### Description:
Sync to CreditLink button should be provided on the Enforced DNs on the document dashboard for DN Documents.

This functionality should be there for the Ops users to sync manually in case auto sync fails.

A database and UI attribute should be added to track the status of the Document for the creditlink sync and it should be part of both UI and database tables.



Acceptance Criteria:

The Documentation Centre application sends out messages toresync user specified electronic designation notice (EDN) statuses to aconsumer system. I.e. CreditLink.



This functionality need to be developed in 2 steps:

1.) On the document Dashboard a “CreditLink Status” coulumn/attribute should be given which can have below values depending on the document’s sync status with creditlink.



Pending: The Sync to CreditLink is pending for the EDN to be Enforced.

Sent: The CreditLink event was sent to CreditLink (when the EDN is Enforced or using the Resend CreditLink button).

Updated: CreditLink sent a response to any DNM withStatus/@Value=Success.

Updated Rejected: CreditLink sent a response to any DNM withStatus/@Value=Rejection.

Error: The Credit stats was set toErrorby an Admin User.

Error Acknowledged: If the Credit stats wasErrorand CreditLink sent a response to the error withStatus/@Value=Success.

Error Rejected: If the Credit stats wasErrorand CreditLink sent a response to the error withStatus/@Value=Rejection.

Transformer Failure: CreditLink sent a response to any DNM with Status/@Value=Failed.



Note: this new attribute on Dashboard should be reflected for all users.

2.) For Ops user, we need to give an additional functionality for syncing the document again or as per use. This option can be given via bulk action as well. And Ops user should able to sync any document which is in enforced or terminated state and whose creditlink status was either Sent/Pending/Updated/Updated Rejected/Error Acknowledged/Error/Error Rejected/Transformer Failure.



Admin/Ops user should able to re-sync all the documents selected in bulk batch process and should be synced again with creditlink and their respective credit link status should get updated once submitted for sync and when the Ack/Nack comes from creditlink.



Note: This sync to creditlink functionality should be available only for Osttra users.

Design:

See the current “EDN Update CreditLink” message format as per section 1.1 of the DNM Message API at:DNM Specification.

---

## [380] DMGS-2912: Mail notifications for the ODC-CL sync failures

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2024-06-05T07:59:38.978+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2912](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2912)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the Documentation Centre application

I Want to inform interested Ops team  when an updated electronic designation notice (EDN) which is enforced and its sync got failed from the creditlink side due to improper setup, missing mandatory attributes or due to connectivity issues.

So That they are able to carry out subsequent required processing and can act upon the failures.

The mail should be sent only if the sync status is updated rejected, **Error Rejected**, or transformer failure(external transformer). 

Template of Mail: TBA

Recipients: L1 & L2 team ( we may need to extend these notification to the PB/EB users as well in future, so the design and solution should be done considering this change of scope)

Frequency: As and when this status gets updated.

**Subject Line**: OSTTRA Documentation Centre: ODC-CreditLink sync failure reported for Electronic Designation Notice

Content:

### Dear User,

This email is being sent to you by OSTTRA Documentation Centre (ODC) (you can read about the same in the below section) in reference to a sync failure reported between ODC and CreditLink for the Electronic Designation Notice(EDN) ${@documentId}.

You can refer the Designation Notice Dashboard for more details.

Document participants are:

* <Legal name of PB>
* <Legal name of EB>
* <Legal name of Client>
**About OSTTRA Documentation Centre**

ODC provides a comprehensive, digital solution for managing multi-asset agreements, including:

* Four-Way Agreements
* Prime Broker Agreements
* Designation Notices Agreement
* Reverse Give-up Agreements and more.
Subscribing clients can create, amend, terminate, and negotiate any part of an agreement using a flexible and customizable approval process. ODC subscribers can consolidate and gain approval for all of their agreements even if their counterparts are not yet subscribed to the service through the ODC Lite Access adoption, which allows a non-subscribing party to view, upload Power of Attorney and approve documents as required.

 

Thank you,OSTTRA team



Acceptance cases:

1.) Mail notification should be sent out to ops team for the above sync statuses.

Restriction Status (Active/Inactive)





Restriction Life Cycle Status ( Approved, Rejected, Modified, Terminated, Pending Approval, New/Draft)





Next Approving Entity(Name of PB or EB depending on the approval cycle)





Doc Type





Bullion (True means both FX and Bullion, False means only FX)





Doc Count





Party 1(PB)





Party 2( EB)





Created On





Last Updated By





Last Updated On





Action (Approve/Reject/Update/Terminate)





Duplication/Clone Icon (Copy)







Acceptance Criteria’s:

1.) User should able to login and navigate to Restriction screen.

2.)Restriction Id should be hyper linked and upon clicking it should open the restriction in view mode.

3.) Doc count should be hyperlinked and upon clicking it should take to the necessary documents.

4.)A user can approve/ reject from the action button if the restriction is pending with him.

5.) An initiator org(PB) user should be allowed to update/terminate the restrictions.

## [410] DMGS-2994: DN: Optional capture of reject reason when bulk rejecting agreements

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-06-14T17:36:58.106+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2994](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2994)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a Online user

I want to optionally capture arejection reason when bulk rejecting DN agreements sent to me for approval

So That there is anaudit on why the DN agreements were rejected.

Design:

A single rejection reason is to apply for one or more selected documents. I.e. No requirement for a rejection reason per selected document.

Acceptance criteria:



Online users should be able tobulk reject DN agreements sent to them for approval without a rejection reason as required.

Online users should be able to enter a single rejection reason for all selected documents when bulk rejecting DN agreements sent to them for approval.

The rejection reason should be captured as an audit per DN document where entered by the online user.

## [413] DMGS-3008: UI/UX design challenges - risk

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-06-20T08:22:19.529+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3008](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3008)

### Description:
At the time of creation of document we need to import the scope from restriction framework.

The scope on EDN is always a subset of scope defined on RN and a user cannot supersede the scope on EDN creation.



The challenge is how we enable the RN scope(master set of conditions) reflected on EDN creation journey. Either we need to import and load all the auth scope defined on RN to the Doc creation journey i.e. pre-populating auth scope on document creation.

problems on above approach: if a user need to create a single or only few lines on EDN but on RN scope there exist alot many auth scope line then manually he has to delete the unnecessary auth scope line this give a bad user experience.

second approach is internally building a logic and user can create the auth scope/limit scope line by manually selecting attributes from the creation form but never let the user to go beyond the scope defined on the RN.

## [420] DMGS-3093: Disable DNM to CreditLink interoperability workflow

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-07-11T09:17:17.355+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3093](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3093)

### Description:
Note: Capturing requirement here but there is an argument that this should be under the DNM specific project.

Requirement:

As an operator

I want to be able to manually disable the interoperability workflows between DNM and CreditLink

So That DN agreements that have been migrated from DNM to ODC will no longer result in DN updates being sent outbound. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* Migrated PB’s (and the related EB’s) can be disabled by an operator manually for the CreditLink interoperability workflow from DNM.
* No DN updates will be sent outbound for the disabled PB’s (and the related EB’s).
* All DN’s and master agreements (MA) for the disabled PB’s (and the related EB’s) will be read-only.
* Users of the organisations can no longer create or edit the DN’s or MA’s for the disabled PB’s (and related EB’s).
* All individual DN’s and master agreements (MA) for the disabled PB’s (and related EB’s) are flagged that they have been disabled for the CreditLink interoperability workflow.
The following are to be made DNM Read Only:

* MA Create/Edit/Approve/Reject/Terminate
* MA Audit Report
* EDN Create/Edit/Approve/Reject/Terminate
* EDN Details Report
* USP Rider Create/Edit/Delete/Apply
* USP Rider Audit Report
* Legal Entities
* Legal Entities -> Versions
* Add/ Edit CCY Groups
* Add/ Edit Ccy Pair groups
* Edit Approval Group
* User Management
* EDN Bulk Management
* Client Management -> Bulk Management per Client
* Client Management -> Onboarding
* Client Management -> Credit Distribution
* External Data -> External IC Outbound Report - Resend button
PS users need to ensure that no updates should be performed on data related to migrated organizations at the following:

* Setup screens
* Legal Entity Naming
* FX >> User Management >> Add New User
Design:

There may be a consideration to allow re-enablement of the interoperability workflows should a fallback be required. Assumption that this is not required.

## [432] DMGS-3160: Implementation of Enforcement Rules of DN on RN

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-05T07:33:23.559+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3160](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3160)

### Description:
As an ODC application , It should allow the user to create the enforcement rules for the EDNs on the Restriction framework

So that once the documents gets created and approved then it gets enforced and become a legally binding document for the legal parties involved in it.

Details:

The enforcement rules should be defined for:

New Document

Amendments

Termination



User should be given option via radio buttons to either select enforcement as immediately or he can schedule the enforcement after few min, hours and days i.e. schedule enforcement for the New document and Amend document.

For Termination of document, enforcement status should be Immediately and by default it should be selected as immediately.



User having edit and create access should be able to define the enforcement rules and can edit them as well.

**Enforcement Edit  rules on RN:**

In Case user edit/amend the RN and changes the enforcement rules for documents in RN then the user should be prompted with a pop up message showing that its associated EDNs will be impacted due to this change in enforcement rules. Below should be the message reflected on the pop up message  where in user can either click Ok(accept the condition), Cancel(do not accept and changes will be reverted to originals in RN).

As a result of changes to the PB-EB Restriction Framework, the following modifications will be made to all the EDNs defined under it.

Enforcement Changed:

Period Type - New EDN : Immediately to Schedule(or vice versa)

Period Type - Amend EDN : Immediately to Schedule(or vice versa)



Rule1:

In case enforcement rules changes on RN and its associated DN is either  in approved, in approval, enforced state state then the application should suspend any edits(It should give warning” Amendments can not happen on this document as its corresponding Restriction Framework is pending for approvals” if a user open any DN for edit on document and should wait for the RN’s approval to be completed and once RN is approved for its changes then the impacted DN should be sent for Pending Re-approval.

DNs waiting for Pending re-approval due to changes in enforcement rules on RN can not be rejected by user and can only be approved. and once user approves this DN then it should Re-synced to its downstream systems. No need to create separate version of DN.



Rule2:

If the changes on enforcement rules are only meant for new document then any document gets created once the RN changes are approved then the DN should be created with changes enforcement rules.



Rule3:

The pop up advisory for changes on RN(related to enforcement rules) should be shown to user who is making these amendments and only if he accepts this message then only it should be submitted for approvals or should be saved in case of no approval is needed(Auto approval). and it should be shown to all the approver's for this RN.

If approver accept these conditions then it will move to next approving entity and if user reject it then the last version will stay intact.





Acceptance Criteria:

1.) User should able to define enforcement rules for document on RN.

2.) User with right role and permission should able to edit the enforcement rules.

3.) Upon edits all the associated EDN should change and adopt the approval workflow.

4.) Necessary popup and warnings should be issued to user to act upon.

---

## [433] DMGS-3162: Integration of Enforcement Rules from RN into Doc creation(Both Backend & UI)

* **Status:** `Done`

* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3162](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3162)

### Description:
As an application, it should import the enforcement rules defined for DN on RN into Doc creation journey

so that valid enforcement rules can be defined for documents.

This Enforcement rules include rules for new document , amend document and termination. These should be populated as read only on doc creation journey and cannot be edited it.

For amend document action(edit , delete, add, remove currency, tenor, products, changes in approvals should follow the Amendments enforcement rules.



**Enforcement Edit rules on RN:**

In Case user edit/amend the RN and changes the enforcement rules for documents in RN then the user should be prompted with a pop up message showing that its associated EDNs will be impacted due to this change in enforcement rules. Below should be the message reflected on the pop up message where in user can either click Ok(accept the condition), Cancel(do not accept and changes will be reverted to originals in RN).

As a result of changes to the PB-EB Restriction Framework, the following modifications will be made to all the EDNs defined under it.

Enforcement Changed:

Period Type - New EDN : Immediately to Schedule(or vice versa)

Period Type - Amend EDN : Immediately to Schedule(or vice versa)

 

Rule1:

In case enforcement rules changes on RN and its associated DN is either in approved, in approval, enforced state state then the application should suspend any edits(It should give warning” Amendments can not happen on this document as its corresponding Restriction Framework is pending for approvals” if a user open any DN for edit on document and should wait for the RN’s approval to be completed and once RN is approved for its changes then the impacted DN should be sent for Pending Re-approval.

DNs waiting for Pending re-approval due to changes in enforcement rules on RN can not be rejected by user and can only be approved. and once user approves this DN then it should Re-synced to its downstream systems. No need to create separate version of DN.

 

Rule2:

If the changes on enforcement rules are only meant for new document then any document gets created once the RN changes are approved then the DN should be created with changes enforcement rules.



In case of changes of lifecycle status of Document due to changes in enforcement rules on RN then  as per enforcement rules and life cycle status a sync should be triggered to creditlink.

 



 

 

Acceptance Criteria:

1.) User should able to define enforcement rules for document on RN.

2.) User with right role and permission should able to edit the enforcement rules.

## [441] DMGS-3175: View latest version of a document

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-08T17:52:24.644+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3175](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3175)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an User

I want to be able to optionally view the latest version of a DN or 4 Ways agreement

So That I can find and report on agreements for my organisation quickly.

Acceptance Criteria:

* By default, the Documents Report will display all versions of a DN or 4 Ways agreements belonging to my organisation.
* I am able to optionally view the latest version of a) a DN, b) 4 Ways agreement or c) both DN and 4 Ways agreements that belong to my organisation from the Documents Report.
* Simple filtering criteria (individual fields and those from ‘+ Apply More Filters’) will be combined with the latest version option.
* The advanced query builder filtering will NOT be combined with the latest version option.
* The latest version of a DN or 4 Ways agreement to display is based off the following rules:
a) If an agreement has NEVER been Enforced then display the *latest document version - **this can be any of the possible system document states.

b) If the *latest version of an agreement is in an Enforced state then display this version of the agreement.

c) If an agreement has been previously Enforced (irrespective of the number of times) but subsequently amended from the most recent Enforced version then display the *latest document version - **this can be any of the possible system document states. Do not display the most previously available Enforced agreement.

Design Hints:

***The latest version of a DN or 4 Ways agreement is denoted by the highest last 3 digits of the existing Document Version ID for an agreement. E.g. DN-935937-A-****006****.**

* The text to be displayed where users select to see the latest version of agreements should be ‘Show only latest version’.
* Users will use the existing Document Type report filter to be able to view the latest versions DN’s, 4 Ways or both types of agreements.
Background: 

****The available document states are captured and can be found at ****[ODC document states](https://osttra.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DMS/pages/95224072/Document+Properties#DocumentProperties-Stateoftheversion)****.**

---

## [444] DMGS-3189:  Identification of DN limits differences from the previous version

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-13T18:23:04.951+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3189](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3189)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be notified of the agreement differences on limits from the last Enforced version of the DN

So That I can quickly establish the changes made and to allow swift approval or rejection of the DN as part of the agreement approval process.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Users can quickly establish the changes made to each DN from the last Enforced version via the Documents Report.
* The agreement differences notified to users are (where applicable to the individual agreement):

* NOP old and new limits with reporting on the trade population specified.
* DSL old and new limits with reporting on the trade population specified.
* By default, the above limit value and trade population differences columns are to be located immediately after the Client based columns on the Documents Report.
* The above limit value and trade population differences columns can be configurable to be added or removed by a user using the standard ‘Column Selection’ facility.
* No report column filters are available for these fields.
* No query or advanced filtering is available for these fields.
Design Hint:

There can be multiple limit lines per DN (in practice probably ~15) that can be amended.

Bare in mind that in Drop 3 that there exists requirements to replicate the EDN Details report and the EDN Changes report. The 3 requirements in total are overlapping so any technical solution should take this into consideration.

## [445] DMGS-3190: Upfront user notification of unsupported products in CreditLink

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-13T18:35:48.221+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3190](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3190)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be notified of unsupported FX or Bullion products in CreditLink when creating or amending a DN and then submitting

So That I am aware that they will not processed and supported as part of any CreditLink workflows when configured in an integrated setup.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Users are notified of unsupported FX or Bullion products in CreditLink on creation or amendment of a DN.
* The unsupported FX or Bullion products, or functionality in CreditLink that users will be notified on are as follows with this message:
**“The following functionality is not supported in CreditLink:**

* NOP and DSL calculations based on forward rates (defaults to spot).
* Currency authorization for exotic options. (if exotic options products are added)
* CreditLink does not differentiate between exercise style barrier style and considers exercise style only for credit calculations. (need to show for products with attribute barrier/exercise style)
* Bullion products are considered as regular FX products for credit calculations. (when bullion product are added)
**The following Products are not supported on CreditLink for credit calculations:**

* Bermudan Options,
* Asian Options,
* Multi-leg Options,
* Basket Options,
* Windows Single Barrier Options,
* Windows Double Barrier Options,
* European Digital Options with Instant settlement,
* Digital Single Barrier,
* Digital Double Barrier,
* Volatility products,
* Exotic NDO.”
Design Hints:

Provide an advisory prompt to the user when they submit a DN for approval, whereby the user is given the option to either Commit or Cancel the submission. Clicking ‘Commit’ means the user agrees to the conditions and upon clicking, this will send the DN for approval. Clicking ‘Cancel’ will return the user back to the screen in edit mode.

## [448] DMGS-3207: Copy & Delete on Auth Scope definition on Doc creation (both backend and UI)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-16T04:39:03.282+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3207](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3207)

### Description:
**Requirement:**

As an ODC application the Copy functionality on Doc creation should allow user to copy the selected auth scope line and create a one more version of it

So that user can define the same auth scope line  with varying tenor for currencies and product.



**Rules for Copy Functionality:**

1.) Copy should create a separate auth scope line with exactly same attributes inside it from the source path.

2.) Auth scope lines created via copy functionality should be created in a turned off mode and user have to turn it on or enable it to edit its settings.

3.)User should be able to define the varying tenor for the currency/currency pairs, though duplicate check should work as expected when user submits it if user is trying to define different tenors for same currency/currency pairs for the same set of product selection.

4.) User should be able to alter his selection on defining the product attributes for the product selection via copy functionality generated auth scope line.



**Delete Functionality:**



Delete functionality on auth scope line should work as it is and it should allow user to delete the selected auth scope line.



**Duplicate Check:**

In case user tries to create auth scope line from Add product ribbon  for selected product and product family then it should allow the user to add all the possible combinations of auth scope from the basis of product family and product

Note: if user is doing full selection(going for specific selection i.e. defining product family and product) then only the specific auth line only should be imported.

A duplicate check should happen when the user clicks next or save it as draft and if duplicate line exist then application should give warning.





**Validation Check:**

1.Tenor: if the user tries to enter the auth scope greater than the values defined on RN then it should give a warning by making the input field red and saying “Tenor is exceeding its limit defined on RN.”



**Acceptance Criteria's:**

1.) Copy should allow the user to create similar auth scope line in a disabled mode.

2.) Delete should allow the user to delete the selected auth scope line.

3.) Duplicate check should work as per the conditions mentioned above.

4.) User should be allowed to work on the auth scope line generated via copy functionality as good as lines created via regular functionality.

## [454] DMGS-3213: Deliverable vs Non deliverable currency on Auth Scope presentation

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-16T12:15:09.404+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3213](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3213)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be know what currencies are deliverable versus non-deliverable

So That when I specify the currencies against my chosen products with either or both settlement types on the authorisation scope I can distinguish the currencies available for each category. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* When specifying the authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can see which currencies are deliverable currencies.
* When specifying the authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can see which currencies are non-deliverable currencies.
* Currency groups and currency pair groups should be identified based on deliverable and non deliverable currencies.
Design Hints

* CreditLink already has logic which understands what currencies are deliverable versus non-deliverable. Please use a reference point.
* Note: Some currencies may be both deliverable and non-deliverable. E.g. ILS - Israeli Shekel.


Background

**Scenario**:

On ODC application we do not support the distinguish logic to separate out deliverable versus non deliverable currencies and user is presented  with a single list of currency(all possible currencies) which is completely away from the implementation done on DNM.

This sort of implementation on ODC can lead a scenario where in if the user has selected any Non deliverable kind of product(NDF, NDO) and do not select any corresponding non deliverable currencies and instead selects only deliverable currencies, this will lead to a sync failure on CreditLink because creditlink expects a non deliverable currency against a non deliverable type of product. And this sync failure is not partial in nature, it is always 0 or 1, so the whole document sync fails at creditlink end.

Another scenario is when the user selects high level product family/product and does not specially select its sub attributes(settlement type), then as per client's expectation we need to allow both deliverable and non deliverable types of products for trading purpose but he can very well leave selecting non deliverable currencies and due that also document sync will fail on CreditLink end.

Our discussion lead to a conclusion that this problem need to be fixed at source side not on the transformation layer or on the target system and for that we need to do an enhancement on ODC itself. 

**Enhancement:**

ODC application should provide the list of deliverable, non deliverable, bullions type of currencies and currency pairs in a segregated manner on the currency selection screen. A validation need to be placed while submitting any Doc or RN for approval which should check the product selection and its corresponding currency/currency pair selection and it should allow only if all the validation meets successfully else it should give an error to the user.

---

* Executing Broker LEI ID,

with all the fields having standard report filtering available.

Live Approval Agreements held can only exist once between the prime broker and executing relationship on the system. This excludes those which have been deleted.

## [457] DMGS-3217: Approval terms and signatory

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-08-16T16:37:50.697+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3217](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3217)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a prime broker or executing broker user

I want to specify the relationship, review the Approval agreement terms and enter my details along with an approval or disapproval

So That I can indicate if I approve or disapprove of the usage terms and conditions for using the Documentation Centre service.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I can specify the prime broker and executing broker organisation for the relationship.
* I can view both the Traiana and OSTTRA Approval agreement terms in this order. (see further note below).
* I can specify either ‘Agreement Signed Externally’ or ‘Electronic Signature’ to indicate if external terms or ODC captured terms are applicable.
* I can enter the following user details:

* First Name (mandatory field),
* Last Name (mandatory field),
* Role (mandatory field),
* Email (mandatory field),
* Phone Number (mandatory field),
* Date of approval or disapproval as the approving user (system defaulted).
* I can apply my approval or disapproval of the usage terms.
**Note Approval agreement terms as follows:**

* **Traiana Approval language terms**
Notwithstanding any provision contained under any master give-up agreement ("MGUP") between (1) the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, and (2) the Prime Broker governing the issuance of a Designation Notice (as defined below) which purpose is for the Prime Broker to designate a counterparty ("Designated Party") to enter into transactions on its behalf with the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, and applying the specified trading parameters applicable to such Designated Party, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, hereby agree and acknowledge that to the extent that a Designation Notice is issued through the CreditLink DNM platform operated by Traiana Harmony TM for the purposes of Designation Notice issuance and management (the "System"), the Designation Notice's terms described under the MGUP are hereby restated by the applicable Designation Notice's terms under the System. The parties using the System hereby agree, by accepting the following terms and conditions, that to the extent a Designation Notice is issued through the System, the parties consent to amend their MGUP in relation to the Designation Notice by applying the issuance and notification process as provided by the System's terms and conditions, and hereby waive any requirement under their MGUP by which any amendment to the MGUP has to be agreed in writing or be delivered in a specified manner or to a specified destination. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the parties agree that any purported amendments to the MGUP made outside the System shall be made pursuant to the terms of the relevant MGUP.

"Designation Notice" means (i) a notice substantially in the form described under the MGUP with the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, ("Paper DN"), and/or (ii) an electronic designation notice ("EDN") transmitted from the Prime Broker to the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, via the System, each or both as may be amended from time to time in accordance with the terms of the MGUP. For the avoidance of doubt, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, hereby agree that an EDN shall constitute a legally binding and enforceable agreement between the parties. For the further avoidance of doubt, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, agree that a Designation Notice may be (i) sent as, (ii) amended by or (iii) terminated by, a Paper DN and/or an EDN, and in the event of any inconsistency between a Paper DN and an EDN, the Designation Notice issued later in time shall prevail with respect to the term(s) being established or amended.

"Prime Broker" means the party designated as "PB" in the System that is the party under the MGUP designating a Designated Party to enter into transactions on its behalf with a Dealer or Executing Broker.

"Dealer or Executing Broker" means the party designated as "EB" in the System that is the party under the MGUP designated to enter into transactions with certain counterparties designated by the Prime Broker as Designated Parties.

* **OSTTRA Approval language terms**
*Notwithstanding any provision contained under any master give-up agreement ("MGUP") between (1) the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, and (2) the Prime Broker governing the issuance of a Designation Notice (as defined below) which purpose is for the Prime Broker to designate a counterparty ("Designated Party") to enter into transactions on its behalf with the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, and applying the specified trading parameters applicable to such Designated Party, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, hereby agree and acknowledge that to the extent that a Designation Notice is issued through the Osttra Documentation Center platform for the purposes of Designation Notice issuance and management (the "System"), the Designation Notice's terms described under the MGUP are hereby restated by the applicable Designation Notice's terms under the System. The parties using the System hereby agree, by accepting the following terms and conditions, that to the extent a Designation Notice is issued through the System, the parties consent to amend their MGUP in relation to the Designation Notice by applying the issuance and notification process as provided by the System's terms and conditions, and hereby waive any requirement under their MGUP by which any amendment to the MGUP has to be agreed in writing or be delivered in a specified manner or to a specified destination. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the parties agree that any purported amendments to the MGUP made outside the System shall be made pursuant to the terms of the relevant MGUP. *

* "Designation Notice" means (i) a notice substantially in the form described under the MGUP with the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, ("Paper DN"), and/or (ii) an electronic designation notice ("EDN") transmitted from the Prime Broker to the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, via the System, each or both as may be amended from time to time in accordance with the terms of the MGUP. For the avoidance of doubt, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, hereby agree that an EDN shall constitute a legally binding and enforceable agreement between the parties. For the further avoidance of doubt, the Prime Broker and the Dealer and/or the Executing Broker, as applicable, agree that a Designation Notice may be (i) sent as, (ii) amended by or (iii) terminated by, a Paper DN and/or an EDN, and in the event of any inconsistency between a Paper DN and an EDN, the Designation Notice issued later in time shall prevail with respect to the term(s) being established or amended.*

*"Prime Broker" means the party designated as "PB" in the System that is the party under the MGUP designating a Designated Party to enter into transactions on its behalf with a Dealer or Executing Broker.*

*"Dealer or Executing Broker" means the party designated as "EB" in the System that is the party under the MGUP designated to enter into transactions with certain counterparties designated by the Prime Broker as Designated Parties.*

## [466] DMGS-3283: Customer EB and Client identifier codes to support STP processing via DN API push notifications

* **Created At:** `2024-09-06T22:02:51.027+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3283](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3283)

### Description:
Requirement

As a Prime Broker

I want to be able to receive alternate EB and Client identifier codes on DN’s push notifications

So that my receiving system can recognise the EB and Client counterparties and apply STP DN updates processing. 

Acceptance Criteria

* Where enabled on the system at a PB level, I can optionally enter alternate EB and Client identifier codes on creation of a DN. The codes can be fully numeric or alphanumeric and can contain multiple codes which are comma separated up to a max of 255 characters.
* Where enabled on the system at a PB level, I can amend a DN where I can enter or change the alternate EB and Client identifier codes. The codes can be fully numeric or alphanumeric and can contain multiple codes which are comma separated up to a max of 255 characters.
* Where enabled on the system at a PB level for entry, I can view the alternate EB and Client identifier codes when added for a DN from the Documents Report. These are optional columns for the report. Where the values are not available, they will be empty. I.e. blank. Filtering is also available to users for these columns from the Documents Report.
* Where enabled on the system at a PB level for entry, the alternate EB and Client identifier codes when added for a DN will be sent on the Push Notification messages when a DN is enforced (including following an amendment) or terminated. Where the values are not available, they will be empty. I.e. blank.
Note: Requirements specification attached. The spec is Barclays specific but the requirement is for the product and its functionality is available for all customers consuming the API capability.

* When my selected currencies do not match the specified settlement type for any authorisation scope lines in my Document Framework, I am informed when saving the authorisation scope for the document.

## [471] DMGS-3313: Integration & Amendments of Enforcement Rules from RN into Doc creation(Both Backend & UI) - Amendment

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-09-13T07:06:18.469+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3313](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3313)

### Description:
As an application, it should import the enforcement rules defined for DN on RN into Doc creation journey

so that valid enforcement rules can be defined for documents.

This Enforcement rules include rules for new document , amend document and termination. These should be populated as read only on doc creation journey and cannot be edited it.

For amend document action(edit , delete, add, remove currency, tenor, products, changes in approvals should follow the Amendments enforcement rules.



**Enforcement Edit rules on RN:**

In Case user edit/amend the RN and changes the enforcement rules for documents in RN then the user should be prompted with a pop up message showing that its associated EDNs will be impacted due to this change in enforcement rules. Below should be the message reflected on the pop up message where in user can either click Ok(accept the condition), Cancel(do not accept and changes will be reverted to originals in RN).

As a result of changes to the PB-EB Restriction Framework, the following modifications will be made to all the EDNs defined under it.

Enforcement Changed:

Period Type - New EDN : Immediately to Schedule(or vice versa)

Period Type - Amend EDN : Immediately to Schedule(or vice versa)

 

Rule1:

In case enforcement rules changes on RN and its associated DN is either in approved, in approval, enforced state state then the application should suspend any edits(It should give warning” Amendments can not happen on this document as its corresponding Restriction Framework is pending for approvals” if a user open any DN for edit on document and should wait for the RN’s approval to be completed and once RN is approved for its changes then the impacted DN should be sent for Pending Re-approval.

DNs waiting for Pending re-approval due to changes in enforcement rules on RN can not be rejected by user and can only be approved. and once user approves this DN then it should Re-synced to its downstream systems. No need to create separate version of DN.

 

Rule2:

If the changes on enforcement rules are only meant for new document then any document gets created once the RN changes are approved then the DN should be created with changes enforcement rules.



In case of changes of lifecycle status of Document due to changes in enforcement rules on RN then  as per enforcement rules and life cycle status a sync should be triggered to creditlink.

 

Rule3:

The pop up advisory for changes on RN(related to enforcement rules) should be shown to user who is making these amendments and only if he accepts this message then only it should be submitted for approvals or should be saved in case of no approval is needed(Auto approval). and it should be shown to all the approver's for this RN.

If approver accept these conditions then it will move to next approving entity and if user reject it then the last version will stay intact.

 

 

Acceptance Criteria:

1.) User should able to define enforcement rules for document on RN.

2.) User with right role and permission should able to edit the enforcement rules.

3.) Upon edits all the associated EDN should change and adopt the approval workflow.

4.) Necessary popup and warnings should be issued to user to act upon.

5.) Re-sync of document should happen as per the status update.

## [473] DMGS-3329: UI - Deliverable vs Non deliverable currency  in Currency Groups screen

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-09-19T09:35:53.358+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3329](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3329)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be know what currencies are deliverable versus non-deliverable

So That when I specify the currencies against my chosen products with either or both settlement types on the authorisation scope I can distinguish the currencies available for each category. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* When specifying the authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can see which currencies are deliverable currencies.
* When specifying the authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can see which currencies are non-deliverable currencies.
* Currency groups and currency pair groups should be identified based on deliverable and non deliverable currencies.
Design Hints

* CreditLink already has logic which understands what currencies are deliverable versus non-deliverable. Please use a reference point.
* Note: Some currencies may be both deliverable and non-deliverable. E.g. ILS - Israeli Shekel.


Background

**Scenario**:

On ODC application we do not support the distinguish logic to separate out deliverable versus non deliverable currencies and user is presented  with a single list of currency(all possible currencies) which is completely away from the implementation done on DNM.

This sort of implementation on ODC can lead a scenario where in if the user has selected any Non deliverable kind of product(NDF, NDO) and do not select any corresponding non deliverable currencies and instead selects only deliverable currencies, this will lead to a sync failure on CreditLink because creditlink expects a non deliverable currency against a non deliverable type of product. And this sync failure is not partial in nature, it is always 0 or 1, so the whole document sync fails at creditlink end.

Another scenario is when the user selects high level product family/product and does not specially select its sub attributes(settlement type), then as per client's expectation we need to allow both deliverable and non deliverable types of products for trading purpose but he can very well leave selecting non deliverable currencies and due that also document sync will fail on CreditLink end.

Our discussion lead to a conclusion that this problem need to be fixed at source side not on the transformation layer or on the target system and for that we need to do an enhancement on ODC itself. 

**Enhancement:**

ODC application should provide the list of deliverable, non deliverable, bullions type of currencies and currency pairs in a segregated manner on the currency selection screen. A validation need to be placed while submitting any Doc or RN for approval which should check the product selection and its corresponding currency/currency pair selection and it should allow only if all the validation meets successfully else it should give an error to the user.

## [477] DMGS-3334: Restriction Edit & Mandatory Prompt for Impact on associated DNs 

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-09-19T11:55:42.435+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3334](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3334)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an ODC application, i should issue an mandatory prompt message to user whenever the restriction is edited and its associated EDN’s scope is narrowed down due to that.

So that the user will get a clear idea that his action on restriction will impact its associated EDNs.

Detailed requirement:

ODC application should specify the impacted scope narrow on the product(un selecting any specification or completely deleting the auth line), currency(removal of currency and currency pairs) and tenor(bringing down the tenor from existing value).

The application should issue a warning something like below:

**As result of the changes to the PB Name - EB name Restriction Framework,**

**the following modifications will be made to all EDNs defined under it .**

Product removed:

Snippet of product line with attributes(after amendments)

Currency Removed:

Name of currency which got removed

Tenor Narrow:

Snippet of auth line with narrowed tenor.



The pop up message should give user the option to either do Ok or cancel.

Ok means user is agreeing to these changes and these amendments will be recorded on EDNs as well cancel means the whole process is cancelled and RN will come to existing state.



These advisory prompt should appear for all the user who are going to approve the changes on RN and at any stage if the approving user cancel it then the RN will come to its original state. For approving user instead of Ok the message approve should appear on the pop up message and it should work equivalent to approval if clicked.



Note: For scope widening(additions), application does not have to issue any pop up and changes can be approved in a regular manner.

**Limit scope amendments:**

In case user removes any limit scope line then the prompt says as

Limit Removed

specify all the attributes like calculation method, population, delta, type. bullion etc…

In case Limit scope is changes then pop up should say as

Limit Expands

specify all the attributes like calculation method, population, delta, type. bullion etc…

Limits Removed :    1> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL             TRADE POPULATION: FX Cash             Delta: false             LIMIT TYPE: Net excluding USD             EXCLUDE CLS: false             BULLION TRADES: Include Metals    2> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL             TRADE POPULATION: FX Options             Delta: false             LIMIT TYPE: Shorts             EXCLUDE CLS: false             BULLION TRADES: Include Metals

Limit Expand :   1> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL             TRADE POPULATION: Vanilla FX Options             Delta: false             LIMIT TYPE: Net excluding USD             EXCLUDE CLS: false             BULLION TRADES: Only Metals



Acceptance Criteria's:

1.) In case of scope narrow for auth scope and limit scope, the advisory prompt should be shown to users to act upon.

2.) User can either accept the change or cancel them.

3.) Approval history should be recorded as usual for the RN amendments.

---

Date: 11/11/2024

Scenario: Edit the Document framework data.

Expected behavior: 

On click of submit and approval button. A new pop up screen will be opened in which all the tabs will be shown. 

In enforcement Rule, Auth scope and Limit scope tab we’ll show the data changed in the new version of the DF.

For Enforcement Rule Tab:  We’ll show the changed data from previous to new state e.g. Immediate to schedule or vice-versa according to the change

For Auth scope: Changes Done for each row will be shown below that row as if there is:Product removed, Snippet of product line with attributes(after amendments), Currency Removed, Name of currency which got removed, Tenor Narrow.

For Limit scope: Changes Done for each row will be shown below that row as if there is any Limit removed or Limit expanded.

There will be a button for Impacted documents on click of which a pop over will be open showing all the Impacted documents.

## [481] DMGS-3373: View last DN CreditLink Sync sent and response timestamps

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-09-30T13:55:59.258+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3373](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3373)

### Description:
Requirement:As an user

I Want to able to view the timestamps in UTC and Local Time of when the last DN sync operation was performed and the response received

So That I have a view from an audit perspective when operating in an integrated ODC and CreditLink setup.

Acceptance Criteria:

* When a DN sync operation is performed between ODC and CreditLink, I am able to see the datetime timestamp in UTC for when it was carried out for a DN from the Documents Dashboard. The timestamp is for the last sync in the cases whereby multiple DN syncs are performed.
* When a DN sync operation is performed between ODC and CreditLink, I am able to see the datetime timestamp in Local Time for when it was carried out for a DN from the Document Dashboard. The timestamp is for the last sync in the cases whereby multiple DN syncs are performed.
* I am able to see the response datetime timestamp in UTC for all DN sync operations performed. The responses can be from: a) Sync Successful, b) Sync Rejected, c) Credit Deletion Successful, d) Credit Deletion Rejected and e) Transformer Failure messages.
* I am able to see the response datetime timestamp in Local Time for all DN sync operations performed. The responses can be from: a) Sync Successful, b) Sync Rejected, c) Credit Deletion Successful, d) Credit Deletion Rejected and e) Transformer Failure messages.
* The field ‘Last CreditLink Sync Timestamp (UTC)’ should be an optional column available immediately after the ‘Failure or Rejection Reason’ column on the Documents Dashboard.
* The field ‘Last CreditLink Sync Timestamp (Local Time)’ should be an optional column available immediately after the ‘Last CreditLink Sync Timestamp (UTC)’ column on the Documents Dashboard.
* The field ‘Last CreditLink Response Timestamp (UTC)’ should be an optional column available immediately after the ‘Last CreditLink Sync Timestamp (Local Time)’ column on the Documents Dashboard.
* The field ‘Last CreditLink Response Timestamp (Local Time)’ should be an optional column available immediately after the ‘Last CreditLink Response Timestamp (UTC)’ column on the Documents Dashboard.
* I am able to apply the standard column filter criteria for the new fields from the Documents Dashboard.
* I am able to apply the the new fields data as query builder filter criteria from the Documents Dashboard.
