## [487] DMGS-3424: Include Historical DNM based EDN Main ID on outbound Sync

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-10-11T13:18:57.399+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3424](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3424)

### Description:
As a ODC application whenever  it sends a sync message to creditlink, it should include the historical EDN main ID(DNM based) within the JSON message

So that CreditLink knows this sync is happening for the migrated EDNs from DNM to ODC.

Detailed requirement:

For the easy reconciliation of credit lines on credit link and disabling the credit lines created from DNM application between the same set of parties, CreditLink needs to know their historical EDN main ID(DNM based).

For this ODC need to send the EDN main ID along with ODC based document IDs in the sync flow.

Note: This historical EDN id should be sent only for the first time sync happening from ODC to Creditlink for migrated EDNs, once that sync is successful then going forward ODC should not include the historical EDN main ID in its sync JSON.

In case the first sync fails due to some reason then it should include this EDN main ID in its following sync as well.



Acceptance Cases:

1.) For the migrated EDNs, sync message from ODC to CL should contain historical EDN main ID as well.

2.) Once sync is successful then for the next sync(regular sync, amend and re-enforced) , it should not send this historical ID.

3.) Upon un successful sync, ODC keeps on including the historical EDN main id in its JSON output.

## [489] DMGS-3484: Enhancement to copy functionalities on DN screen

* **Status:** `Done`

* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3484](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3484)

### Description:
As an ODC application Copy functionality on DN dashboard should work as per the criteria listed below so that  a DN can be created and validated in an authorised manner.

Copy functionality Criteria's:

1.) When a user copies an existing DN version then you can act as PB/EB and then  PB  and EB will remain same of the copied DN  and user is allowed to change the Client entity for DN creation. Now:

a.) If all these three entities are corresponding or matching the source DN’s entities then a application should issue a duplicate error saying a DN already exist for the set of parties.

b.) If all these three entities do not match to existing source copied DN and user add a new client as PB and EB getts copied in non editable mode then a new version of DN should be created between PB and EB and Client.



Acceptance Cases:

a.) If all these tree entities are corresponding or matching the source DN’s entities then application should not let the user to create new version and issue a duplicate error saying a SN already exist between selected parties.

b.) If all these three entities do not match to existing source copied DN then it should go to similar creation journey(create document) and first check if any approved DF exist or not and if DF exist then only it will allow user to proceed ahead and the definition of DN will be inherited from the copied DN.

## [492] DMGS-3511: Limit scope Amendments

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-10-23T13:47:50.728+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3511](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3511)

### Description:
Detailed Requirement:

Whenever the user amends the limit scope under DF then it will have direct impact on its associated EDNs. Amends can be either adding new limit scope definition, altering the existing limit scope definition or removing the limit scope definition.

So as soon as such amendments happens on DF then a pop up advisory form should be presented to user doing these edits and also to the approvers( as implemented in this story ).



Limit Removed

specify all the attributes like calculation method, population, delta, type. bullion etc…

Limits Removed : 1> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL  TRADE POPULATION: FX Cash  Delta: false  LIMIT TYPE: Net excluding USD  EXCLUDE CLS: false  BULLION TRADES: Include Metals

Limit Expand:

Change in the limit scope will affect the EDNs involving all its clients as below:

PB-EB-Client(“name of PB, EB and client”)

1> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL  TRADE POPULATION: Vanilla FX Options  Delta: false  LIMIT TYPE: Net excluding USD  EXCLUDE CLS: false  BULLION TRADES: Only Metals

Limit Value: “ “



In case of limit expand scenario we need to give a text box in front of limit definition screen, so that user can specify the limit value for the limit scope definition and same should be updated on the associated EDNs.



Note: In case this amendment on limit scope is impacting multiple EDNs then in the pop up message we need to specify the clients name and user should able to enter specific limits for clients involved in EDNs.



Once the impacted EDNs are updated as per the new limit scope definition then they should follow the standard approval process defined for MA amendments.



Acceptance cases:

1.) User should able to amend the limit scope and application should issue an advisory to the users regarding the impact.

2.) User should able to specify the limit value for all its EDNs.

3.) Pop up message should specify changes related to auth scope, limit scope, enforcement rules, approval workflow related.



---

Date: 11/11/20124

New discussion points:

* On scope change preview screen we'll able to see Limit scope tab.
* On opening the limit scope tab we'll able to see the changes done on the limit lines.
* If limit line is removed or expanded. as per description added in the DMGS-3334.
* There will be a button which will open a popup with list of all the lines changed.
* user will be able to add the limit value for the limit lines for respective DNs.
* after adding limit value for each line, user will submit the new added values.

## [504] DMGS-3670: POC: DNM Out of memory issue

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-11-07T10:56:28.800+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3670](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3670)

### Description:
Analysis/POC need to carried out how when the download triggers and application opens a new pop up window then how the main process will get to know if the download is completed.



Problem Statement

Recently an incident was reported on DNM applictaion where application went out of memory and we had increase the memory.

This happened when one of the user repeatedly clicked the download button to download detailed EDN report.

 

The report download takes some time and during that window if user keeps on clicking download button then application keeps on sending DB calls for the action and meanwhile the first download is still in progress.



Acceptance cases:

1.) this POC should result in a solution to know the status of completion of pop up window to the main window/process.

## [505] DMGS-3678: DNM OOM solution implementation

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-11-07T10:56:46.694+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3678](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3678)

### Description:
Problem Statement:

Recently an incident was reported on DNM applictaion where application went out of memory and we had increase the memory.

This happened when one of the user repeatedly clicked the download button to download detailed EDN report.

 

The report download takes some time and during that window if user keeps on clicking download button then application keeps on sending DB calls for the action and meanwhile the first download is still in progress.



Impacted Reports: EDN detailed report, EDN report, Master agreement report, USP rider mgmt report, USP rider audit report, additional product setup report, product tooltip, user management report..



As a DNM application if one of the report download is in progress then during that time it should not allow user to click the download button again

so that the first download process gets completed and it does not increase load on application.

The application should show the advisory message as “Download in in progress, please wait for the action to be completed” during the download process.

One the first process(download) is completed or expired then there after user should be able to click it again and can download again.



Acceptance Cases:

1.) User should not be allowed  to click the download button again if the first download is in progress.

2.) The application should show the advisory message as “Download in in progress, please wait for the action to be completed” during the download process.

3.) One the first process(download) is completed or expired then there after user should be able to click it again and can download again.

---

## [506] DMGS-3690: Approval matrix validation on submission of a DF, DN and 4W

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-11-11T08:15:28.044+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3690](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3690)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the ODC application

I Want validation to be applied to check that an Approval Matrix exists for the legal entity(s) and document action(s) combinations as specified in the Approval Workflows for Document Frameworks, DN or 4 Ways agreement when submitting for approval

So That the Document Frameworks, DN or 4 Ways agreements do not get stuck during the approval cycle processing and users can never review the agreements.

Acceptance Criteria:

* On submission of a Document Frameworks, DN or 4 Ways agreement, the system validates that an Approval Matrix exists for the legal entity(s) and document action(s) combinations as specified in the Approval Workflows and allows the agreement to be reviewed and complete the approval cycle.
* On submission of a Document Frameworks, DN or 4 Ways agreement, where the system validates that an Approval Matrix does NOT exist for the legal entity(s) and document action(s) combinations as specified in the Approval Workflows a user error is reported with the message “An approval matrix for entity ‘Name of Entity’ and document action ‘Name of Document Action’ is missing, please add the required approval matrix to allow submission of the document”.

## [512] DMGS-3806: Restriction Edit & Mandatory Prompt for Impact  on associated DNs for Auth scope.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-11-22T12:12:27.471+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-3806](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-3806)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an ODC application, i should issue an mandatory prompt message to user whenever the restriction is edited and its associated EDN’s scope is narrowed down due to that.

So that the user will get a clear idea that his action on restriction will impact its associated EDNs.

Detailed requirement:

ODC application should specify the impacted scope narrow on the product(un selecting any specification or completely deleting the auth line), currency(removal of currency and currency pairs) and tenor(bringing down the tenor from existing value).

The application should issue a warning something like below:

**As result of the changes to the PB Name - EB name Restriction Framework,**

**the following modifications will be made to all EDNs defined under it .**

Product removed:

Snippet of product line with attributes(after amendments)

Currency Removed:

Name of currency which got removed

Tenor Narrow:

Snippet of auth line with narrowed tenor.



The pop up message should give user the option to either do Ok or cancel.

Ok means user is agreeing to these changes and these amendments will be recorded on EDNs as well cancel means the whole process is cancelled and RN will come to existing state.



These advisory prompt should appear for all the user who are going to approve the changes on RN and at any stage if the approving user cancel it then the RN will come to its original state. For approving user instead of Ok the message approve should appear on the pop up message and it should work equivalent to approval if clicked.



Note: For scope widening(additions), application does not have to issue any pop up and changes can be approved in a regular manner.

**Limit scope amendments:**

In case user removes any limit scope line then the prompt says as

Limit Removed

specify all the attributes like calculation method, population, delta, type. bullion etc…

In case Limit scope is changes then pop up should say as

Limit Expands

specify all the attributes like calculation method, population, delta, type. bullion etc…

Limits Removed :    1> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL             TRADE POPULATION: FX Cash             Delta: false             LIMIT TYPE: Net excluding USD             EXCLUDE CLS: false             BULLION TRADES: Include Metals    2> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL             TRADE POPULATION: FX Options             Delta: false             LIMIT TYPE: Shorts             EXCLUDE CLS: false             BULLION TRADES: Include Metals

Limit Expand :   1> CALCULATION METHOD: DSL             TRADE POPULATION: Vanilla FX Options             Delta: false             LIMIT TYPE: Net excluding USD             EXCLUDE CLS: false             BULLION TRADES: Only Metals



Acceptance Criteria's:

1.) In case of scope narrow for auth scope and limit scope, the advisory prompt should be shown to users to act upon.

2.) User can either accept the change or cancel them.

3.) Approval history should be recorded as usual for the RN amendments.

---

Date: 11/11/2024

Scenario: Edit the Document framework data.

Expected behavior:

For Auth scope: Changes Done for each row will be shown below in scope change section:Product removed, Snippet of product line with attributes(after amendments), Currency Removed, Name of currency which got removed, Tenor Narrow.

There will be a button for Impacted documents on click of which a pop over will be open showing all the Impacted documents.

Impacted documents will include all the DNs, in which no auth line remained after doing the changes in auth lines of the Document framework.

User have to add the auth lines for the Impacted documents and click on the confirm button of the Impacted Auth scope pop up.

If user doesn’t open the Impacted Auth scope pop up or doesn’t confirm the new auth lines added, then user will not be able to submit the document.

After changes done on the DNs, and clicking on confirm button, user will be able to submit the document framework for approval.

* **Created At:** `2024-12-31T07:27:47.022+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4066](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4066)

Description : Limit values disappears when user click on confirm after providing the values for limit lines in DF 

* Create a DF with Auth Scope & Limit line
* Create a document for the same & Enforce it
* Edit the DF & edit the limit lines & go to submit & preview tab .

## [526] DMGS-4183: Comparison view to identify changes versus Enforced document version

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-01-16T08:54:23.096+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4183](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4183)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to view the agreement differences from the last Enforced version of the DN

So That I can establish the changes made and to allow swift approval or rejection of the DN as part of the agreement approval process.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Users can establish the changes made to a DN from the last Enforced version by invoking the ‘Compare’ action against the required DN from the Documents Dashboard.
* By default, the comparison screen ONLY shows the sections where there are differences between the selected and last Enforced version of the DN.
* The agreement differences viewed by users are (where applicable to the individual agreement):

* Approval Workflow
* Enforcement Rules
* Document Terms
* General Terms
* Auth Scope
* Limit Scope
* USP Rider
* Users are able to optionally change the comparison view to show the FULL document details of both the selected and last Enforced version of the DN.
* In both views (from 2 and 4 above), removals will be highlighted in Red on the Enforced version and additions will be highlighted in Green on the user selected version on the comparison screen.
Design:

Highlighting the differences between the enforced and current version in the compare action screen.

Below Implementations will be done:

* A switch button will be given on the compare screen, with values as “View All“ and “View Difference“.
* By default view difference option will be enabled.
* On View difference, only those section of document will be shown where the 2 versions differ from each other. The changes in the current version will be highlighted in green and the changes on enforced version will be highlighted in red.
* On View all, all sections of the documents will be shown regardless of the differences, but still the differences will be highlighted.
Note: description will be updated, if any further discussion takes place.

---

## [527] DMGS-4184: Outbound JSON supporting segregation of currencies as per their Settlement type (Technical item)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-01-16T12:29:04.424+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4184](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4184)

### Description:
As ODC is getting enhanced to support the currency selection as per their settlement type of product defined underneath. And due to this the outbound JSON need to be enhanced to include the segregation of currencies into two Buckets for both currencies or currency pair selection.

FX Cash Deliverables for Cash products

FX Cash Non Deliverables Cash products(NDF or forwards with non deliverable settlement type)

FX Option Deliverable (Vanilla options)

FX Option Non deliverable (Vanilla options)

FX Exotic Option Deliverable (Exotic Options)

FX Exotic Non Deliverable (Exotic Options)



Deliverable currencies/currency pairs can have currencies with the status of pure deliverable or with the status of Both.

Non Deliverable currencies/currency pairs can have currencies with the status of pure Non deliverable or with the status of Both. 



Acceptance Cases:

1.) The outbound JSON for enforced, amendments, termination will have the currency section of  products into two categories i.e. deliverable and non deliverable.

2.) This updated JSO should be sent to all the applicable downstream systems at the time of enforcements(New or amendments) and terminations.



Updated JSON has to be shared with CreditLink team as well and should be updated on Jira.

## [528] DMGS-4203: Deliverable and non-deliverable currency / currency pairs UI display rework away from a combined 'both' category

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-01-17T17:00:42.516+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4203](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4203)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be know what currencies are deliverable versus non-deliverable

So That when I specify the currencies against my chosen products with either settlement type on the authorisation scope I can distinguish the currencies available for each category as well as subsequently on DF or DN display after entry. The categorisation also applies to the filtering specification of currencies for DN’s.

Acceptance Criteria:

* When specifying the DF authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can see which currencies are deliverable currencies.
* When specifying the DN authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can see which currencies are non-deliverable currencies.
* Currency groups and currency pair groups should be identified based on deliverable and non deliverable currencies.
* When bulk editing agreements, currencies can be identified based on deliverable and non deliverable currencies.
* When apply advance filtering on agreements, bullions can be selected for filtering and currencies can be identified based on deliverable and non deliverable currencies.
* When amending the currencies on agreements, currencies can be identified based on deliverable and non deliverable currencies.
* When specifying the authorisation scope and my chosen currencies belong to both settlement types then I can see the currency in both individual category's and not in a combined ‘both’ category.
* For query based filtering, currency display and selection remains the same.
* For DF and DN’s, the ‘view details’ tooltip shows the currencies selected are displayed by deliverable, non-deliverable and both where applicable.
* When previewing a DF or DN, the currencies selected are displayed by deliverable, non-deliverable and both where applicable.
* When viewing a DF or DN PDF, the currencies selected are displayed by deliverable, non-deliverable and both where applicable.
Design Hint:

As discussed between UI designer and the UI team, we have opted to go with 2 category columns for this implementation away from the current 3 column category columns we have today.

References:

Analysis reference sheet (Bullion CCY tab):

## [534] DMGS-4267: SSO logout and application timeout timeout for SSO enabled applications for ODC app

* **Status:** `Draft`
* **Created At:** `2025-01-21T10:13:33.493+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4267](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4267)

### Description:
**Logout**: When user logout from the application (say CFD/ETD/H3 etc.) then this should logout the application as well as logout the Azure session. This should not impact the other applications session until that application is forcefully logged out or timeout.

**Session Timeout: **Similar to logout, when application's session is timed out then logout the application session and also logout the Azure session so upon next login user has to authenticate again. This should not impact the other applications active session.

When I am logged in to application via SSO Then my application should validate if SSO session is active in every 5 mins And if SSO session is active then do nothing and continue to work in application If SSO session is not active/ logged off then logout the application as well 

Acceptance Criteria: 

> I am able to launch the application via SSO providing all the required access are in place 

> If I logout from SSO (Azure) then > My application should also logout in 5 mins which are logged in via SSO

> >when application's session is timed out then logout the application session and also logout the Azure session so upon next login user has to authenticate again.
> 
>



Ref Jira from implementation side>>

## [541] DMGS-4386: Products are not displayed in DF selected order 

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2025-01-28T05:16:33.729+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4386](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4386)

### Description:
Bug Description : Products are not displayed in DF selected order 

* Login to odc-qa .
* Create a DF with all products .
* Create a DN select all products family then click on product then observe .
Actual result : Products are not displayed in DF selected order 

Expected result : Products should display in DF selected order . 



Enhancement story:

Part1:

Whenever we are creating the DN from an approved DF, then while selecting the products under product family, the products should appear in the below order:

FX Cash products(Spot, forward, swap..)> Vanilla options>> Exotic options(in alphabetical order)> Volatility products> Bullion Products

In the current state the products are reflected in the order how the product family is selected(the last selection on product family will lead to the products getting reflected on top under the product selection tab)

Note: The product belonging to product family will only need to be reflected if a particular product family is not selected then its associated products should not be reflected under product tab.

Part 2:

 The underlying attribute under auth selection of any products should follow a common pattern of reflecting the attribute/components underlying a product. And this pattern should be followed both on DF and DN creation/amendment journey.



Vanilla options:  Settlement type> exercise style> contract type

Single barrier/double barrier: settlement>exercise> contract>barrier style>barrier type>windows>windows period

Single barrier digital/double barrier digital: exercise> contract>barrier style>barrier type>payout timing>payout currency>touch direction>windows



European Digital: exercise> contract>barrier type>payout timing>payout currency



No Touch: exercise>payout timing>payout currency> touch direction

One touch: exercise>contract>barrier type>payout timing>payout currency> touch direction



Double No touch: exercise>payout timing>payout currency> touch direction

Double One touch: exercise>payout timing>payout currency> touch direction

---

## [543] DMGS-4472: View agreement Enforcement start and end times

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-03T19:05:40.871+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4472](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4472)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to optionally view the Start and End times of when a DN or 4 Ways agreement has been Enforced or is no longer Enforced

So That I can view them for reference purposes.

Acceptance Criteria:

* From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the Start date and time for when a DN agreement has been enforced.
* From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the End date and time for when a DN agreement has been enforced.
* From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the Start date and time for when a 4 Ways agreement has been enforced.
* From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the End date and time for when a 4 Ways agreement has been enforced.
* The Start and End date and times reported can be viewed in the local time or UTC time or both.
* Where either enforcement date and time is not yet applicable then the values show empty, i.e. are blank. E.g. When an agreement is not enforced yet.
* The Start and End times are filterable for each column when added to the Documents Report dashboard.
Design Hints:

* Date and times to be reported in local time and UTC to be consistent with other system date/times provided within Doc Centre.
* Enforcement End time applies when an agreement has Terminated and Expired.
* I have included both DN’s and 4 Ways in the requirement as I have made the assumption that technically there is no separation in the implementation.

---

* From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the Current Return date and time for when a 4 Ways agreement when it has been user specified.
* The Current Return date and time reported can be viewed in the local time (Column name: “Current Return (Local Time)”) or UTC time (Column name: “Current Return (UTC Time)”) or both.
* Where no Current Return date and time has been user specified on an agreement then the value will show empty, i.e. are blank.
* The Current Return date and time is filterable when added to the Documents Report dashboard.
Design Hints:

* Date and times to be reported in local time and UTC to be consistent with other system date/times provided within Doc Centre.
* I have included both DN’s and 4 Ways in the requirement as I have made the assumption that technically there is no separation in the implementation.

## [548] DMGS-4517: View client funds for DN agreements

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-03T20:21:14.474+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4517](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4517)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to optionally view the funds specified against the client counterparty on my DN agreement

So That I can quickly view them for reference purposes and to be able to filter for DN’s with specific funds.

Acceptance Criteria:

* From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the funds specified against the client counterparty for a DN agreement when they have been user specified.
* The dashboard column value will indicate how many funds have been specified. E.g. “N Funds” where N is the number of funds specified. From the cell, users are able to view all the assigned funds.
* Where no funds have been user specified for an agreement then the value will show ‘No Funds’ and there will be no funds to view.
* Funds can be searched and filtered for directly on the Documents report column covering partial match (e.g. wildcard search for part of a funds name) and full match if a user specifies the full name of a fund.
* Funds can be filtered for using the Query filter builder from the Documents report with partial match operation available. i.e. ‘IS’ operator.
Design Hints

* The column name from the dashboard and query builder is to be called ‘Client-1 Funds’.
Background Info:

The following **NO** longer applies following some further data analysis.

A spot check from DNM production suggests a maximum of  2 funds are being specified on enforced DN’s today - this will be our current benchmark so any UI decisions (filtering columns and report display) will based on this understanding.

## [554] DMGS-4597: Update of Document Framework and DN's to use latest alternate legal entity name

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-07T17:38:10.511+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4597](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4597)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I Want to be prompted and given the option to update an existing selected Document Framework or DN to use the latest available alternate legal entity name where available for a legal entity or entities specified

So That my Document Framework or DN is legally correct.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Where alternate legal entity names exist for an existing Document Framework and I invoke it, I am prompted with a message informing me that the legal entity(ies) name has changed.
* If I accept the update, my Document Framework will update with the latest alternate entity name(s) and will go through the existing Document Framework approval process for re-approval.
* If I decline the update, there is no change to my Document Framework.
* Where alternate legal entity names exist for an existing DN and I invoke it, I am prompted with a message informing me that the legal entity(ies) name has changed.
* If I accept the update, my DN will update with the latest alternate entity name(s) and will go through the existing DN approval process for re-approval.
* If I decline the update, there is no change to my DN.
Design:

Example msg prompt screenshot (taken from DNM):

The 2nd line is to be changed to show “Please note that the update of the Legal Entity Name(s) will take effect only after you have submitted the agreement for approval after accepting the name changes“.

## [558] DMGS-4658: UI level differentiation on the changes across notification due to amendments on DF

* **Status:** `Draft`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-12T09:36:22.319+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4658](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4658)

### Description:
As an ODC application whenever we are showing a notification while showing impacted DNs due to changes on the DF then then 

Application should highlight the changes in some colour combinations,

So that a user while approving will be able to see the high level changes on UI screen itself.



Detailed Ask:

Limit scope amendments on DF:

In case limit scope is amended then currently we are showing these changes in manner where in one one side we are saying Limit scope removed and showing the changes under Limit scope Added.

So on these two tabs we should highlight what exactly are the amendments(product family, netting type, calculation type, bullion flag and delta flag).  The line added should show the additional added/amended attribute should be highlighted in green colour and under line removed the attributes removed should be highlighted in red.



Auth scope amendments:

 Tenor Narrow/expanded:

Currency Removed Added:

In case of new currency/currency pair gets added on any auth scope line then the added currency should be highlighted in green.

In case of any currency/currency pair is removed then the removed currency/currency pair should be highlighted din red.

Product Added/Removed:

Product snippet should highlight the added attribute in green and if anything is removed/unchecked that should be highlighted in red.

Acceptance Cases:

1.) These scenarios are only for DF amendments and valid on the notification screen while approving the DF amended version.

2.) The highlighted rules for limit scope and auth scope are mentioned on the detailed ask section.

## [560] DMGS-4680: Mandatory e mail id requirement for Lite participants.

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-14T10:34:27.827+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4680](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4680)

### Description:
As an ODC application, it should ask the user who is creating DN/DF to enter the e mail id of lite participants if the Lite participants is one of the party in the approval workflow for the documents(for all actions)

So that an email can be sent to lite user whenever the approval is required from Lite participant.

Detailed requirement:

We have one pop warning available which tells the user to mention the email id if lite participant is defined under approval workflow for new document, we need to extend the same functionality for all the document actions and to the DF screen as well. User should not be allowed to proceed ahead in case a Lite party is added on approval workflow for DN on DF screen and prompted to supply the mail id of Lite party.

Without mail id user should not be allowed to create the document provided the lite participants is defined under the approval workflow for DN for any of the document actions.

Scenarios to be covered:

1.) User should be prompted to enter the lite participant’s mail ID if the lite party is added in the approval workflow for the DN for any action.

2.) Supplied lite party’s mail id should be imported on the DNs as well while creating the DN on the basis on DF.

3.) If the lite participant was not defined under approval workflow then application will let the user to create EDN without the mail id of lite participants on the first instance but in case the approval workflow is amended on the DF and user has selected the lite participant for the DN approvals then in that case:

a.) the application will  prompt the user to input the mail id of lite party on the DF itself and DN should inherit the mail Id of Lite participants defined on the DF and populate under DN also if mail id exist on DF.

4.) In case mail id does not exist on DF then user should be prompted with a warning and asking to input the mail id for DF and which further can be used for approval communication for DNs as well.

5.) Mail id defined on DF will be imported on on EDNs as well and that will be used for approval workflow, in case user wants to override the mail id defined on DF then he should be able to do so and allowed to add the new mail id on DN(this case is for users who want to mention the mail id of specific lite user from which approval is needed).

6.) Amending/Changning only mail id on DF will not create any new version of DN and DN should import the new mail id from DF and it should use the new mail id for further approvals for new DNs. and in case lite approver gets added after DF amendments then the new mail id should be silently updated on the associated DNs.

7.) Updating the mail id while doing the DF amendments(adding the lite party on approval workflow) should use the newly defined mail id for DNs and it should import the new mail id for Lite party and use it for approval process.

8.) While Copying DN, the mail id of Lite party also should get copied from source DF to Target EDN.



Acceptance Cases:

1.) ODC application should ask user to enter mail id for Lite party if it is defined on any approval workflow for DN on DF and DN.

2.) If lite party exist on approval workflow then application should not let the user to submit the DN and DF without mentioning mail id for Lite party.

3.) Document should not get approved if the lite party exist on approval workflow and and in case mail notification is not sent to lite party.

4.) A user should not be able to cancel and reject the document when the the doc is created via DF amendment journey, both PB and EB have to accept it.

5.) A PB should not be able to cancel the DN(created via DF amendments) if its pending with EB’s approval and vice versa.

6.) User should be prompted to enter the lite participant’s mail ID if the lite party is added in the approval workflow for the DN for any action.

7.) Supplied lite party’s mail id should be imported on the DNs as well while creating the DN on the basis on DF.

8.) If the lite participant was not defined under approval workflow then application will let the user to create EDN without the mail id of lite participants on the first instance but in case the approval workflow is amended on the DF and user has selected the lite participant for the DN approvals then in that case:

a.) the application will  prompt the user to input the mail id of lite party on the DF itself and DN should inherit the mail Id of Lite participants defined on the DF and populate under DN also if mail id exist on DF.

9.) In case mail id does not exist on DF then user should be prompted with a warning and asking to input the mail id for DF and which further can be used for approval communication for DNs as well.

10.) Mail id defined on DF will be imported on on EDNs as well and that will be used for approval workflow, in case user wants to override the mail id defined on DF then he should be able to do so and allowed to add the new mail id on DN(this case is for users who want to mention the mail id of specific lite user from which approval is needed).

11.) Amending/Changning only mail id on DF will not create any new version of DN and new DN should import the new mail id from DF and it should use the new mail id for further approvals. Existing DNs can stay on the earlier used mail id and in case lite approver gets added after DF amendments then the new mail id should be silently updated on the associated DNs.

12.) Updating the mail id while doing the DF amendments(adding the lite party on approval workflow) should use the newly defined mail id for DNs and it should import the new mail id for Lite party and use it for approval process.

13.) Whenever the user is copying DN  involving lite party and lite party defined on approval then the mail id of lite party also should get copied to target EDN and application should not allow user to submit the copied EDN without the mail id of lite user if lite participant is one of approver. Mail id should be copied from updated DF version by default but user can override.

---

## [564] DMGS-4754: Auth Scope Enhancement on Impacted AUth scope screen

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-25T11:48:27.878+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4754](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4754)

### Description:
As ODC user whenever I am amending the DF and then going to Impacted Auth scope section then the application should store my changes I made on the auth scope section in case i confirm the changes and revisit the impacted scope again before submitting it for approval.



Existing Gap:

Currently whenever a user is going in the impacted auth scope section while doing the DF amendments then once he did some changes (enable any auth scope line, defined tenor and currencies on that auth scope under impacted DN) and then confirm those changes and again if he is revisiting the impacted auth scope section before submitting it for approval then his previous changes are getting lost and it prompts him to again make those mandatory changes.



Enhancement: 

Application should somehow store or flag the changes made on the impacted auth scope section while amending the DF and changes should not get lost when user revisit the impacted auth scope before doing final submit for approval on DF. At the same time user should be shown only those DNs under the impacted auth section for which there are no auth scope left under the associated DNs.

At any given point of time the data shown on the impacted auth scope should show the exact applicable auth scope available under DF(ex in first instance if user was shown 3 auth scope line and user goes back and delete one of the auth scope line from DF and then again re-visit the impacted auth scope section then user should be shown only the remaining 2 auth scope lines only.



Acceptance Cases:

1.) The intermittent changes/selection made by user should be visible to him once user again visit the impacted auth scope page before final submit.

2.) Impacted auth scope should show the updated changes from DN, DF amendments and selection done in a temporary manner while visiting the impacted auth scope section last time.

3.) Changes made on auth scope(line enablement/disable, currencies selection and tenor section should retain its values supplied by user and should not be erased when the user comes back on the same page before making final submit for DF.

4.)  If an auth scope line is enabled and  values were supplied  in it then that should be retained and shown to user when he enters this page again, though he should be allowed to make changes on his past sections.

## [577] DMGS-4946: Document Framework: Allow optional tenor specification on authorisation scope

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-03-14T17:20:01.548+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4946](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4946)

### Description:
Requirement

As an User

I Want To optionally not set a tenor value for my authorisation lines when setting up my Document Framework agreements

So That I have the flexibility to defer the authorisation line tenor value entry on creation of the DN which uses the Document Framework as I may not know what the required tenor up front.

Acceptance Criteria

* When creating a Document Framework, the tenor value for an authorisation line can be omitted where required.
* When creating a Document Framework, the tenor value for an authorisation line can be specified where required.
* From the Preview and Submit tab for a Document Framework, the tenor value status for an authorisation line is reflected accordingly to show whether a tenor was user specified of not.
* From the View As PDF button for a Document Framework, the tenor value status for an authorisation line is reflected accordingly to show whether a tenor was user specified of not.
* On creation of a DN utilising the Document Framework, the DN correctly shows whether a tenor was user specified or not for the tenor value status of an authorisation line. This applies when showing the possible opt-in authorisation lines with details and when the authorisation line has been user opted-in.
* On creation of a DN utilising the Document Framework, the DN correctly shows a ‘max tenor value’ of “Unspecified” for each authorisation line where no tenor was specified. In addition, there is no in-flight validation checks of exceeding the max tenor.
* On creation of a DN utilising the Document Framework where a tenor was not specified for an authorisation line but was subsequently added as part of the DN specification, the DN can be previewed, submitted and processed through the approval cycles.
* Where DN’s have been created utilising a Document Framework and the tenor on the Document Framework is then amended the following will apply: a) if the amended tenor is >= tenor’s on the impacted DN’s then no scope narrowing is reported on approval with no material impact on the DN’s, b) if the amended tenor is not specified (i.e. optional) or < the tenor’s on the impacted DN’s then a tenor scope narrowing is reported to users with impacted DN details provided and on approval submission by the user the impacted DN’s are updated and go through the approval workflow.
UI/UX Design

Have some type of option for user to select either a) Unspecified or b) Tenor value + Period Type?

---

As the ODC application

I Want to relax the check for mandatory entry of either the set of PB or EB approver details prior to the submission of an Approval Agreement

So That I can allow the details to be entered at a later time rather than at the point specifying the number of PB and EB approvers.

Acceptance Criteria

* On creation of an Approval Agreement and setting the number of PB and / or EB approvers, the Approval Agreement can be submitted without all the detail fields being populated.
* On amending an Approval Agreement, the Approval Agreement can be submitted without all the detail fields being populated.
* An Approval Agreement can be submitted with all the detail fields being populated.
* The detail fields (PB and EB approver fields) are no longer marked with asterisks to indicate that they are mandatory fields.
* On approval by PB or EB users of their details, all fields are required to have been entered.

## [593] DMGS-5476: Sequential approval group review of agreements setup

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-05-21T19:58:16.078+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5476](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5476)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to set up sequential approval group review of DN and 4 Way agreements

So That agreements can be reviewed in a set order to meet my organisation's review and approval processes and to support the migration of the equivalent from DNM.

Acceptance Criteria:

* For my organisation, I can set up whether I want sequential approval group OR the existing parallel approval group review of DN agreements across all document actions from the Approval Matrix. Mix 'n' Match of individual document actions is NOT available.
* For my organisation, I can set up whether I want sequential approval group OR the existing parallel approval group review of 4 Ways agreements across all document actions from the Approval Matrix. Mix 'n' Match of individual document actions is NOT available.
* The maximum sequence order that can be defined is per the maximum number of supported approval groups per organisation as supported in the application today.
* Where sequential approval review is selected, a single approval group can apply i.e. meaning they will be the only group requiring approval from.
Assumption:

DN’s and 4 Ways share the same shared technical processing so addressing both document types at the same time.

Design:

UI and UX for end users to set this up are to follow.

## [594] DMGS-5485: Sequential approval group review of agreements

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-05-21T20:11:51.891+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5485](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5485)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able have sequential approval group review of DN and 4 Way agreements when it has been set up

So That my agreements can be reviewed in a set order to meet my organisation's review and approval processes and to support the migration of the equivalent from DNM.

Acceptance Criteria:

* For my organisation where sequential approval group review of DN agreements has been specified, the DN is reviewed in the specified sequential order for each approval group per document action.
* For my organisation where sequential approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified, the 4 Way agreement is reviewed in the specified sequential order for each approval group per document action.
* For my organisation where parallel approval group review of DN’s has been specified, the DN’s is reviewed in the specified parallel order for each approval group per document action.
* For my organisation where parallel approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified, the 4 Way agreement is reviewed in the specified parallel order for each approval group per document action.
* The maximum sequence order that can be processed is per the maximum number of supported approval groups per organisation today.
* Where sequential approval review is selected, a single approval group can apply i.e. meaning they will be the only group requiring approval from.
Assumption:

DN’s and 4 Ways share the same shared technical processing so addressing both document types at the same time.

## [595] DMGS-5494: Sequential approval group review notification for Online users

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-05-21T20:26:25.838+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5494](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5494)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an Online user

I want to be informed at the appropriate time in the defined review processing order that I need to review a DN or 4 Ways agreement which has the sequential approval group order set up

Where I belong to that approval group as a user

So That I can approve or reject it at the correct time.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Where sequential approval group review of DN agreements has been specified for an Online user’s organisation, the user is informed at the correct sequential processing order to review the DN from the Pending Approval summary bar.
* Where sequential approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified for an Online user’s organisation, the user is informed at the correct sequential processing order to review the 4 Ways agreement from the Pending Approval summary bar.
* Where sequential approval group review of DN agreements has been specified for an Online user’s organisation, the user is informed at the correct sequential processing order to review the DN from the In-App notification.
* Where sequential approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified for an Online user’s organisation, the user is informed at the correct sequential processing order to review the 4 Ways agreement from the In-App notifications.
* Where sequential approval group review of DN agreements has been specified for an Online user’s organisation, the user is informed at the correct sequential processing order to review the DN as part of the ‘Approval Requested’ and periodic approval reminder email notifications.
* Where sequential approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified for an Online user’s organisation, the user is informed at the correct sequential processing order to review the 4 Ways agreement as part of the ‘Approval Requested’ and periodic approval reminder email notifications.
Note: Users can belong to multiple approval groups.

Assumption:

DN’s and 4 Ways share the same shared technical processing so addressing both document types at the same time.

---

* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5503](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5503)

So That I can be informed of the latest approval status for my DN or 4 Ways agreement.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Where sequential approval group review of DN agreements has been specified, the document approval status reports the specified sequential order for each approval group and their approval status for each document action.
* Where sequential approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified, the document approval status reports the specified sequential order for each approval group and their approval status for each document action.
* Where sequential approval review is selected with a single approval group specified, the document approval status reports on this single approval group and its approval status for each document action.
* Where parallel approval group review of DN agreements has been specified, the document approval status reports the parallel approval group and their approval status for each document action.
* Where parallel approval group review of 4 Ways agreements has been specified, the document approval status reports the parallel approval group and their approval status for each document action.
Assumption:

DN’s and 4 Ways share the same shared technical processing so addressing both document types at the same time.

* Product Family: Exotic Options **>** Product: One Touch **>** Barrier Type: “No Barrier”, “Knock-In“, “Knock-Out“, “Reverse-Knock-In“, “Reverse-Knock-Out“
So That I am able to support the migration of Master Agreements (MA’s) and Designation Notices (DN’s) from DNM.

Acceptance Criteria:

* When specifying European Digital Exotic Options, I am able to select a value of ‘No Barrier’ for the Barrier Type attribute when adding this product to my authorisation scope on Document Framework’s, Designation Notices and 4 Ways agreements.
* When specifying One Touch Exotic Options, I am able to select values of “No Barrier”, “Knock-In“, “Knock-Out“, “Reverse-Knock-In“ or “Reverse-Knock-Out“ for the Barrier Type attribute when adding this product to my authorisation scope on Document Framework’s, Designation Notices and 4 Ways agreements.
Assumptions:

DN’s and 4 Way’s agreement share a common product attribute setup.

## [600] DMGS-5592: Document Agreements: Prevent data breach on 'Last Updated By' values

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-05-30T00:02:55.256+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5592](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5592)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the ODC application

I want users to ONLY see user emails in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter value list associated with either:

* the logged in user’s organisation
* or if the user email belongs to one of the counterparties specified within the DN or 4 Ways documents belonging to the logged in user’s organisation
So That data breaches do not occur.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I can only see user emails in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter values from the main dashboard for users belonging to my organisation whether it’s a PB or EB.
* I can only see user emails in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter values from the main dashboard for users belonging to any of the counterparties whereby they have been specified in any of my organisation’s DN’s or 4 Ways agreements.
* I can only see user emails in the ‘Last Updated By’ query filter values from the main dashboard for users belonging to my organisation whether it’s a PB or EB.
* I can only see user emails in the ‘Last Updated By’ query filter values from the main dashboard for users belonging to any of the counterparties whereby they have been specified in any of my organisation’s DN’s or 4 Ways agreements.
* I can see the email of '[app_svc_user@osttra.com](mailto:app_svc_user@osttra.com)' in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter values from the main dashboard.
* I can see the email of '[app_svc_user@osttra.com](mailto:app_svc_user@osttra.com)' in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter values in the query filter values from the main dashboard.
* I can see the email of internal OSTTRA administrative users in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter values from the main dashboard.
* I can see the email of internal OSTTRA administrative users in the ‘Last Updated By’ filter values in the query filter values from the main dashboard.
Assumptions:

DN’s and 4 Ways agreement share common components for the above.

## [602] DMGS-5621: Amendment of approval group review processing

* **Status:** `Dev Backlog`
* **Created At:** `2025-06-02T16:55:34.498+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5621](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5621)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to amend the approval group review of DN and 4 Way agreements from sequential to parallel or vice versa

So That agreements can be reviewed to meet my organisation's review and approval processes.

Acceptance Criteria:

* For my organisation, I can amend the set up from sequential approval group to parallel approval group review of DN agreements across all document actions from the Approval Matrix. Mix 'n' Match of individual document actions is NOT available.
* For my organisation, I can amend the set up from parallel approval group to sequential approval group review of DN agreements across all document actions from the Approval Matrix. Mix 'n' Match of individual document actions is NOT available.
* For my organisation, I can amend the set up from sequential approval group to parallel approval group review of 4 Ways agreements across all document actions from the Approval Matrix. Mix 'n' Match of individual document actions is NOT available.
* For my organisation, I can amend the set up from parallel approval group to sequential approval group review of 4 Ways agreements across all document actions from the Approval Matrix. Mix 'n' Match of individual document actions is NOT available.
* Where it has been amended from sequential approval group to parallel approval group review; a) for documents in an ‘In-approval’ state, any document action approvals already carried out remain against the document version and b) any other outstanding approvals can be applied in a parallel fashion.
* Where it has been amended from parallel approval group review to sequential approval group; a) for documents in an ‘In-approval’ state, the user is informed that any approvals already applied to the document version will be reset to allow for sequential approval review, b) the user can accept this processing in which case sequential approval review can be set up and applied or c) the user can cancel the amendment and the existing parallel approval group review remains.
Assumption:

DN’s and 4 Ways share the same shared technical processing so addressing both document types at the same time.

Design:

UI and UX for end users to set this up are to follow.

## [607] DMGS-5695: Document Framework: Allow user quick selection of all currencies

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-06-08T12:49:42.146+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5695](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5695)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to select, view and manage that all currencies are required when adding authorisation lines to my Document Framework (DF)

So That when I specify the currencies against my chosen products I don’t have to enter every supported currency individually.

Acceptance Criteria:

* When entering the DF authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can select that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable.
* After entering the DF authorisation scope and ahead of submission of the DF, having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each authorisation line for my DF. This is from both the summarised view and from the ‘View Details’ tooltip.
* After submitting the DF, having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each authorisation line for my DF in Preview & Submit mode.
* Having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each authorisation line for my DF in View As PDF mode.
* After submitting the DF, having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each authorisation line for my DF and then I am able to amend the currency selection to a reduced set.
* For a DF where all currencies and currency pairs have not been specified on one or more authorisation lines, I am able to amend the currency selection to all available currencies and currency pairs.
* When downloading a DF in PDF format from the Document Framework report having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each authorisation line for my DF.
* When copying a DF from the Document Framework report having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each authorisation line in the cloned DF.
Technical Design:

Is there shared 4 Ways agreement implementation impact?

---

## [609] DMGS-5713: Designation Notice: User selection of all currencies

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-06-08T13:00:11.326+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5713](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5713)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to view and manage that all currencies are required for authorisation lines on my Document Notices (DN’s)

So That that I can administer my DN’s fully.

Acceptance Criteria:

* When entering the DN authorisation scope and selecting my chosen currencies, I can select that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable where the DF rules allow me.
* After entering the DN authorisation scope and ahead of submission of the DN, having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each applicable authorisation line for my DN. This is from both the summarised view and from the ‘View Details’ tooltip.
* After submitting the DN, having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each applicable authorisation line for my DN in Preview & Submit mode.
* Having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each applicable authorisation line for my DN in View As PDF mode.
* After submitting the DN, having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each applicable authorisation line for my DN and I am able to amend the currency selection to a reduced set.
* For a DN where all currencies and currency pairs have not been specified on one or more authorisation lines, I am able to amend the currency selection to all available currencies and currency pairs where the associated DF rules allow.
* When downloading a DN in PDF format from the Document dashboard having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each applicable authorisation line for my DN.
* When copying a DN from the Document dashboard having selected that all currencies and currency pairs are applicable, I can see this reflected for each applicable authorisation line in the cloned DN.
* The Advance filter and Query Builder filter do not support filtering by ‘all currencies’.
* When performing single or bulk edit currency actions, authorisation lines that have ‘Select All’ currencies specified will not be impacted and users are informed with a message of “Please note authorisation lines where all currencies and/or currency pairs have been specified with the ‘Select All’ flag will not be impacted with this edit action. Required currencies will need to be individually amended“.
Technical Design:

Is there shared 4 Ways agreement implementation impact?

## [615] DMGS-5909: View client funds for 4Way agreements

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-07-07T14:47:51.127+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5909](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5909)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to optionally view the funds specified against the client-2 counterparty on my 4Way agreement

So That I can quickly view them for reference purposes and to be able to filter for 4Way’s with specific funds.

Acceptance Criteria:

From the Documents Report dashboard, users can optionally view the funds specified against the client-2 counterparty for a 4Way agreement when they have been user specified.

The dashboard column value will indicate how many funds have been specified. E.g. “N Funds” where N is the number of funds specified. From the cell, users are able to view all the assigned funds.

Where no funds have been user specified for an agreement then the value will show ‘No Funds’ and there will be no funds to view.

Funds can be searched and filtered for directly on the Documents report column covering partial match (e.g. wildcard search for part of a funds name) and full match if a user specifies the full name of a fund.

Funds can be filtered for using the Query filter builder from the Documents report with partial match operation available. i.e. ‘IS’ operator.

Design Hints

The column name from the dashboard and query builder is to be called ‘Client-2 Funds’.

## [625] DMGS-6274: Manage CreditLink monitoring LEI overrides

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-08-01T17:19:56.455+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-6274](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-6274)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the ODC application

I want to be able to allow overriding CreditLink LEI’s for either a PB, EB or Client counterparty

So That the LEI override is sent to CreditLink in order for credit monitoring to be set up accordingly.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Users can set and then save CreditLink override LEI’s for either a) PB, b) EB or c) Client counterparty on the ODC application.
* Users can amend and then save CreditLink override LEI’s for either a) PB, b) EB or c) Client counterparty on the ODC application.
* Users can remove and then save CreditLink override LEI’s for either a) PB, b) EB or c) Client counterparty on the ODC application.
* Overrides are sent in the specified counterparty party blocks to CreditLink on the following messages a) EDN Update CreditLink - when a new DN is created, b) EDN Update CreditLink - when an existing DN is Amended and c) EDN Update CreditLink - Terminated, when an existing DN is terminated.
* Where no CreditLink overrides have been set up then the standard counterparty is sent to CreditLink on the following messages a) EDN Update CreditLink - when a new DN is created, b) EDN Update CreditLink - when an existing DN is Amended and c) EDN Update CreditLink - Terminated, when an existing DN is terminated.
Design Considerations:

* Do the counterparty party blocks get sent to CreditLink when a DN is terminated?
* Transformer changes > separate Jira capture?
* Sample UI management screen attached. Product UI design to follow after technical design review.
* Example ‘Edit + Save’ visual reference screenshot added below following meeting on 8th Aug.

## [639] DMGS-6576: Readiness and Observability in ODC Inter-Service Dependencies

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-09-01T06:24:52.243+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-6576](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-6576)

### Description:
During initial resilience testing on the Drop2a build of the ODC application, it was observed that multiple internal services (e.g., `dms-document-svc`, `currency-svc`, `product-svc`) do not handle the unavailability or recovery of their internal dependencies gracefully. This behavior is likely to impact upcoming merged services in Drop2b as well if readiness, failure handling, and recovery mechanisms are not incorporated at the service level.

### **Issue Details:**

* When internal services like `currency-svc` or `product-svc` are stopped, the calling service (`dms-document-svc`) logs no errors, warnings, or retries.
* After the dependent services are restored, the system resumes normal functionality, but there are no logs or indicators showing recovery or re-establishment of connectivity.
This suggests missing:

* Readiness/liveness probes
* Retry logic
* Observability and logging for dependency state changes
### **Expected Behaviour:**

* When currency-svc and product-svc are down, dms-document-svc should log errors or warnings and gracefully handle the unavailability (e.g., return meaningful errors or fallback responses).
* When these services restart, dms-document-svc should log their recovery and resume normal operation.
**Impact:**

* This issue severely impacts the resilience and observability of the ODC application. It leads to silent failures, making troubleshooting difficult and potentially resulting in incorrect data.

---

## [640] DMGS-6749: DF: Allow unlimited calendar or business days tenor specification for FX Spot products

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-09-22T19:39:00.099+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-6749](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-6749)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want to be able to specify tenors with unlimited calendar or business days for FX Spot products on creation of authorisation lines for Document Frameworks (DF)

So That the DF’s reflect the applicable scope allowed per the agreement between the prime broker and executing broker as well as supporting the migration of Master Agreements (MA) from DNM to ODC where this applies.

Acceptance Criteria:

* For my DF, I can specify unlimited 'Calendar Days' tenors for FX Spot products when adding authorisation lines.
* For my DF, I can specify unlimited 'Business Days' tenors for FX Spot products when adding authorisation lines.
* For my DF, I can continue to specify ‘Spot-only’ or 'Up-to-spot' tenors for FX Spot products when adding authorisation lines.
* I am able to see the specified ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products on authorisation lines from the 'Preview & Submit’ link tab of the DF.
* I am able to see the specified ‘Calendar Days' or 'Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products on authorisation lines when using the document preview link function from the Document Framework Dashboard post the submission and approval of the DF.
* I am able to successfully migrate MA’s as DF’s into ODC from DNM where ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products have been specified on the authorisation scope.

## [641] DMGS-6758: DN and 4W: Allow unlimited calendar or business days tenor specification for FX Spot products

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-09-22T19:57:47.671+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-6758](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-6758)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an user

I want my Designation Notices (DN) to inherit authorisation scope lines from the associated Document Frameworks (DF) where calendar days or business days tenor’s for FX Spot products have been specified

So That the DN reflects the applicable scope allowed per DN agreement as well as supporting the migration of DN’s from DNM to ODC where this applies.

In addition, 4 Ways agreements will allow for the same tenor specification standalone.

Acceptance Criteria:

* For my DN, it inherits from the associated DF the specified 'Calendar Days' tenors for FX Spot products when adding authorisation lines and allows me to change the number of days up to the inherited calendar days limit.
* For my DN, it inherits from the associated DF the specified 'Business Days' tenors for FX Spot products when adding authorisation lines and allows me to change the of number days up to the inherited business days limit.
* For my DN, it continues to inherit from the associated DF the specified ‘Spot-only’ or 'Up-to-spot' tenors for FX Spot products when adding authorisation lines.
* For 4 Ways agreements, I am able to specify 'Business Days' or 'Calendar Days' tenors for FX Spot products when adding or amending authorisation lines.
* I am able to see the specified ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products on authorisation lines from the 'Preview & Submit’ link tab of the DN or 4 Ways agreement.
* I am able to see the specified ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products on authorisation lines when using the 'View As PDF’ function.
* I am able to see the specified ‘Calendar Days' or 'Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products on authorisation lines when using the document preview link function from the Documents Dashboard.
* Query based filtering from the Documents Dashboard will return DN’s or 4 Ways agreement within the applicable search results when ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products are within the search criteria.
* Advance filtering from the Documents Dashboard will return DN’s or or 4 Ways agreement within the applicable search results when ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products are within the search criteria.
* I am able to successfully migrate DN’s into ODC from DNM where ‘Calendar Days' or ‘Business Days' tenor’s for FX Spot products have been specified on the authorisation scope.

## [662] DMGS-7181: DN inclusion or exclusion specification of cleared FX NDF trades from credit limit calculation

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-11-11T17:24:04.656+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7181](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7181)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a Risk Manager

I Want to be able to define whether to include or exclude cleared FX NDF trades on DN agreements

So That the credit limit utilisation can be optimised to include or exclude these trade positions within the downstream CreditLink application where credit is monitored and managed.

Acceptance Criteria:

* The option to exclude FX NDF cleared trades is only applicable when FX Cash trade population is specified on its own or as part of the credit limits. i.e. Product Family = ‘Cash’.
* The option to exclude FX NDF cleared trades is available and applicable across limits overall.
* On DN’s I am able to specify whether to include or exclude FX NDF cleared trades in the credit limit utilisation calculation for both either DSL and NOP limits.
* By default, FX NDF trades are set to be included when specifying credit limits.
* From the ‘Preview & Submit’ tab on a DN, I am able to view whether FX NDF trades are to be included or excluded across credit limits overall.
* From the ‘View as PDF’ option on a DN, I am able to view whether FX NDF trades are to be included or excluded across credit limits overall.
* After invoking the document hyperlink on the Documents Dashboard, I am able to view whether FX NDF trades are to be included or excluded across credit limits overall.
* After invoking the ‘Compare’ document comparison operation from the Documents Dashboard, I am able to view whether the inclusion or exclusion of FX NDF trades across credit limits overall has changed when amended.
* I am able to filter out DN’s by whether FX NDF trades are to be included or excluded across credit limits overall from the Documents Dashboard using the query builder filter facility.
Design Hints:

* Option given to users to 'Exclude NDF Cleared Trades'. Add as a new value to apply across overall credit limits when creating a credit limits.
* Where 'Exclude NDF Cleared Trades' is not applicable then field should grayed out and disabled from user input.
* Use 'Exclude NDF Cleared Trades' label text.

## [663] DMGS-7190: ODC to CreditLink: DN FX NDF trades exclusion notification

I want to notify CreditLink that my Designation Notices (DN’s) are to include or exclude cleared FX NDF trades from their limit calculations

So That CreditLink is able to optimally report on credit limit utilisation in real-time where required by CreditLink users.

* ODC notifies CreditLink about DN’s on whether to include or exclude cleared FX NDF trades from their limit calculations.
* CreditLink when notified by ODC can process the inclusion or exclusion of cleared FX NDF trades from their limit calculations.
Example of existing DNM to CreditLink interface message:

Technical Design Hints:

* The current CreditLink message interfaces are held at the individual limit level. The business requirement is applies across overall credits limits for a DN.

As an User

So That I save time when performing my job role and can view bulk requests for my organisation only.

## [675] DMGS-7414: Formatting large position limit numbers

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-10T19:44:23.656+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7414](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7414)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I want all large position limit numbers to be formatted

So That I am able to easily and quickly read the position limits that have been applied for a DN or 4 Ways agreement.

Acceptance Criteria:

* On creation or amendment of a DN or 4 Ways agreement, from the ‘Limit Scope’ tab specified position limits (NOP or DSL) are formatted on entry and then addition per limit line.
* From the ‘Preview & Submit’ tab of a DN or 4 Ways agreement, entered position limits (NOP or DSL) are formatted when viewed.
* From the ‘View As PDF’ option of a DN or 4 Ways agreement, entered position limits (NOP or DSL) are formatted when viewed.
* From the Documents dashboard, all old and new position limits (NOP or DSL) columns are formatted (where applicable) for DN agreements.
* From the Documents dashboard, all old and new position limits (NOP or DSL) on the flyout control are formatted (where applicable) for DN agreements.
* From the Documents dashboard, all old and new position limits (NOP or DSL) columns are formatted (where applicable) for 4 Ways agreements.
* From the Documents dashboard, all old and new position limits (NOP or DSL) on the flyout control are formatted (where applicable) for 4 Ways agreements.
* When a DN or 4 Ways agreement are invoked using the hyperlink from the Documents dashboard, entered position limits (NOP or DSL) are formatted.
* From the Select Documents report on invoking the bulk Edit Limit operation, all old and new position limits (NOP or DSL) columns are formatted (where applicable) for DN and 4 Ways agreements.
* From the Select Documents report on invoking the bulk Edit Limit operation, all old and new position limits (NOP or DSL) on the flyout control are formatted (where applicable) for DN and 4 Ways agreements.
* On specification of a position limit value in the advanced filter from the Documents dashboard, the limit value is formatted on user entry.
* On specification of a position limit value from the query builder filter from the Documents dashboard, the limit value is formatted on user entry.
* On the download of a DN and 4 Ways agreement, the entered position limits (NOP or DSL) are formatted.
Design Hints:

* Numbers should use a comma separated delimiter assuming it’s the OSTTRA DS standard.
* Does this impact the download of the position limit values into the CSV files? > Development to inform on.
