## [676] DMGS-7424: Tenor user setting to apply across all specified authorisation scope

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-11T17:58:16.040+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7424](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7424)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I want to be able to enter a tenor value at an overall level which then applies across all specified granular authorisation scope for DF’s, DN’s and 4 Ways agreements

So That I can save time when creating or amending many authorisation lines.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to set an overall tenor value which all the authorisation scope inherit from when creating or amending a DF, DN or 4 Ways agreement.
* I am able to set a product family level tenor value which all the authorisation scope inherit from when creating or amending a DF, DN or 4 Ways agreement.
* I am able to set a product level tenor value which all the authorisation scope inherit from when creating or amending a DF, DN or 4 Ways agreement. Where no product level value is set but a value is set at the associated product family level then this tenor is inherited.
* Product families and Products available for tenor configuration are per as available in ODC as today.
* I am able to set tenors for 1, 2 and 3 above with periods of; a) Calendar Days, b) Business Days, c) Months and d) Years. For Spot products e) Spot Only and f) Up-to-Spot options are available.
* I am able to override the tenor value at the authorisation line level from values specified at 1, 2 and 3 above. The tenor specified at the individual authorisation line level takes priority over values at any preceding levels.
* A ‘Clear All’ function is available on the tenor configuration assistant to empty all tenor values specified by the user where required.
* When tenors are set at an overall, product family or product level and are applied, a confirmation “Tenor changes as specified will be applied to the Authorisation Scope in the document. Please confirm?“ message is presented to the user to inform them that changes will be apply to the document and requesting user confirmation to go ahead.
* Validation of tenors once applied to a document at an overall, product family or product level to DN’s will apply as it does today should they exceed tenor values inherited from the associated DF. DF and 4 Ways documents are not impacted.
Design Hints:

* Technical design should think about having a user entry widget to help this user processing.
* See Option C in UI/UX slide deck referenced.

## [678] DMGS-7443: DN and 4 Ways agreements lookup by search criteria

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-14T22:46:11.864+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7443](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7443)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Can filter my firm’s DN or 4 Ways agreements by a variety of search attribute criteria

So That I am able to quickly search for agreements to apply contractual checks, follow-up on pending approvals and make amendments or terminations.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to specify the next approving entity (valid values are PB or EB) for my firm’s agreements and apply this criteria to then view the applicable agreement results. Agreements which do not have a next approving entity are excluded from the results. E.g. Agreements in an Approved state.
* I am able to specify the next approving group for my firm’s agreements and apply this criteria to then view the applicable agreement results. The valid values available to the user for the next approving group criteria are approval groups which apply to the counterparties involved on the firm’s agreements of the user.
* For (2) above, where agreements have Parallel approval order specified against them then all approval groups defined in approval order would apply to the agreement results.
* For (2) above, where the next approving group is a Lite user(s) then the value of 'Lite participant' applies for the display field and search criteria values.
* I am able to specify the PB or EB's specified office for my firm’s agreements and apply this criteria to then view the applicable agreement results. The valid values available to the user for the specified office's criteria are specified office’s which apply to the counterparties involved on the firm’s agreements of the user.
* All of the above field values are to be available as columns from the Documents Dashboard with column filtering capability. The columns are optionally displayed on the dashboard and ordered as above located before the existing ‘USP Rider Status’ field.

## [680] DMGS-7478: Multiple product group selection on specifying authorisation scope for DF's and 4 Ways

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-15T16:41:33.114+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7478](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7478)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I want to specify multiple predefined product groups created by my firm when adding the authorisation scope to my Document Framework or 4 Ways agreement  

So That it speeds up entry on the creation or amendment of these agreements.

Acceptance Criteria:

* On creation or amendment of a Document Framework, I am able to specify more than 1 product group to the authorisation scope. When added, the authorisation scope contains the products and product attributes as defined in the selected product groups.
* On creation or amendment of a Document Framework, I am able to specify 1 product group to the authorisation scope. When added, the authorisation scope contains the products and product attributes as defined in the selected product groups.
* On creation or amendment of a 4 Ways agreement, I am able to specify more than 1 product group to the authorisation scope. When added, the authorisation scope contains the products and product attributes as defined in the selected product groups.
* On creation or amendment of a 4 Ways agreement, I am able to specify 1 product group to the authorisation scope. When added, the authorisation scope contains the products and product attributes as defined in the selected product groups.
* Where more than 1 product group is specified, the resulting authorisation scope added to the Document Framework or 4 Ways agreement is a merged combination of the products and product attributes as defined in the selected product groups.
**Note**: DN’s inherit the authorisation scope from the Document Framework and therefore product groups are not available for selection.

Design Hints:

The maximum number of product group’s available for user selection is per the current technically supported limit.

## [683] DMGS-7533: Touch direction validation for Exotic Option products

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-22T18:38:16.214+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7533](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7533)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want the Touch Direction to be validated against the Contract Type

So That I can ensure that the attributes have been correctly specified for the selected Exotic Options  products on my authorisation scope in-flight for DF, DN and 4 Ways agreements and on saving or submission.

Acceptance Criteria:

* The following apply when the following Exotic Options products are specified in the authorisation scope: a) Single Barrier Digital, b) Double Barrier Digital and c) One Touch.
* Validate in-flight that the Touch Direction = Down when Contract Type = Put.
* Validate in-flight that the Touch Direction = Up when Contract Type = Call.
* Validate in-flight that the Touch Direction = Up and Down when Contract Type = Call and Put, or no selection has been made i.e. means Call and Put has been specified.
* Where any of the in-flight validation fails, the following is reported as a warning in the exclamation mark tooltip: “The Touch Direction is not valid for the specified Contract Type. Please select the compatible Touch Direction of adjust the Contract Type.“
* Validate on saving or submission of an the agreement that the Touch Direction = Down when Contract Type = Put.
* Validate on saving or submission of an the agreement that the Touch Direction = Up when Contract Type = Call.
* Validate on saving or submission of an the agreement that the Touch Direction = Up and Down when Contract Type = Call and Put, or no selection has been made i.e. means Call and Put has been specified.
* Where any of the validation fails on saving or submission, the following is reported as an error: “There is a mismatch between the specified Touch Direction’s and Contract Type’s.“
* All the above apply to Document Frameworks, DN’s and 4 Ways agreements.

---

## [684] DMGS-7542: Approval Groups audit trail

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-22T19:22:46.202+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7542](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7542)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an Compliance user

I want to view; who created or amended an Approval Group, what details were added or changed, and when

So That I have a full audit of these actions and can meet my compliance requirements.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I can invoke the Approval Group audit trail for an Approval Group from the Audit Approval Group report.
* I am able to see what, when and who added or amended the details for an Approval Group.
* I can see the audit event for each change.
* I can see the date/time for each change.
* I can see which user made each change.

## [686] DMGS-7552: Approval Group deletion

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-12-22T21:04:44.695+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7552](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7552)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to delete previously created Approval Groups belonging to my firm that are no longer required

So That I can keep my approval group data up-to-date.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to view from the Approval Group report whether an Approval group is live or has been deleted.
* I am able to invoke the deletion of live approval groups belonging to my firm only.
* Validation is performed prior to deletion to check if any documents in-flight are currently using this Approval Group via the Approval Matrices and Workflows. If there are, inform the user with an ‘Ok’ message stating 'There are agreements in-flight using this Approval Group and it cannot be deleted currently.' otherwise proceed with the deletion.
* I am presented with an ‘Yes / No' advisory requiring user confirmation of this delete action. The message should say ‘Please confirm you want to delete this Approval Group and update any usage of this group on the system?’.
* Auditing is maintained where the Approval Group was previously used.
Design Hints:

* Internal and external user roles already permissioned to create Approval Groups can also delete Approval Groups.
* Deletions are soft deletes to preserve any auditing traceability where the approval group has been previously used. i.e. mark as Inactive (Active where live) - see Approval Agreements entities as a reference.

## [693] DMGS-7694: PDF DN download for external offline signatory and approval

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-01-14T19:03:23.312+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7694](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7694)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a Prime Broker

I want to receive a downloaded PDF version of a DN

So That I can send onto the Executing Broker offline (and non-lite) for signatory and then apply my firm’s subsequent approval for DN enforcement. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* A nominated email ID can be specified in the DF or DN to receive a downloaded PDF version of a DN.
* An approval group can be set up to allow PB users only to manually approve on behalf of EB’s who are offline. (Use a flag with text of ‘Manual approval’).
* DN approval workflow can optionally be set up to allow an EB to be added for approval where the PB is approving on their behalf. (Use a flag with text 'Prime Broker of behalf of Executing Broker').
* On submission of a DN where the PB is approving on behalf of the EB, validation is performed to ensure that a ‘Manual PDF approval email' has been entered. If not, an error of “The manual PDF approval email ID is missing, please enter in the General Terms of the Designation Notice.“ is presented to the user.
* On DN creation or amendment of a DN and then subsequent initial PB approval as part of the approval workflow, an email is generated with a PDF version of the DN. The DN is in an In-Approval state.
* The nominated email ID where provided receives a downloaded PDF version of a DN (customer bespoke where applicable otherwise product default) on PB approval in an email. The email details are:

* Subject: OSTTRA Documentation Centre: Designation Notice Prime Broker Approved
* Body:
### Dear User,

This email is being sent to you by OSTTRA Documentation Centre (ODC) (you can read about the same in the below section) in reference to a Designation Notice (DN) of which is attached that has been Approved by your organization as the Prime Broker counterparty. 

Document participants are:

* “OSTTRA (To be replaced with actual EB name for DN)” Executing Broker
* “IMMO WATER WEYDE (To be replaced with actual PB name for DN)” Prime Broker


**About OSTTRA Documentation Centre**

ODC provides a comprehensive, digital solution for managing multi-asset agreements, including: - Four-Way Agreements - Prime Broker Agreements - Designation Notices Agreement - Reverse Giveup Agreements and more. Subscribing clients can create, amend, terminate, and negotiate any part of an agreement using a flexible and customizable approval process. ODC subscribers can consolidate and gain approval for all of their agreements even if their counterparts are not yet subscribed to the service through the ODC Lite Access adoption, which allows a non-subscribing party to view, upload Power of Attorney and approve documents as required.

Thank you, OSTTRA team

* Post offline approval between the PB and EB, the PB approves on behalf of the EB online and the DN moves to an Approved then Enforced state.
Overview

See flow (2) for overview of this workflow:

Technical Design Consideration:

* What is the technical impact on 4 Ways agreements?
* Based on a quick scan of DNM, typically only 1 manual approval group exists for PB’s. Validation for this can be handled in a later phase.
* 1 or more PB approvals can be setup before the PB on behalf of EB approval applies.

## [694] DMGS-7703: Agreement (DN & 4 Ways) audit trail

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-01-14T19:17:28.010+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7703](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7703)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an Compliance user

I want to view; who created or amended an agreement (DN or 4 Ways), what summary level details were added or changed, and when

So That I have a full audit of these actions and can meet my compliance requirements.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I can use the Documents Dashboard to see all the versions audit related to the lifecycle of DN or 4 Ways and the Document Actions applied to it. (Existing).
* I can invoke the Track facility for an agreement (DN or 4 Ways) from the Documents Dashboard to see the all Document Actions applied (What), When and where approvals are setup, Who approved or rejected the document by approval group. (Existing).
* From the Track facility, I can see which user from each specified approval group either approved or rejected the document. (New).
* From the Track facility where no approval workflow was defined for the Document Action, the message reported to the user should be changed from ‘No Record Found’ to ‘No Approval workflow was defined for this document action’. (New).
* From the Comparison facility I can identify the full detail changes versus the last enforced version of document where the comparison tool action is only available when the last enforced version of a document pre-dates the currently selected version. (The action availability is New).
Assumptions:

Shared component processing between DN’s and 4 Ways processing.

Design Hint:

There is no requirement to capture all individual transaction updates resulting from the saving of data when switching tabs on the application for a DN or 4 Ways agreement.

---

## [696] DMGS-7724: ODC_CL Sync Utility

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-01-19T09:49:55.012+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7724](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7724)

### Description:
We need to create the utility which will be integrated with Jenkin Pipeline where we can run and sync the document from ODC-CL.

In order to sync the migrated DNs from ODC to CL, one needs to trigger the Jenkins pipeline.This pipeline reads input from a csv file in the form of EDN_IDs or PB_IDs.Then Jenkins calls our ODC api to create a batch process with the required set of IDs, which creates Batch and associated BatchItems.Our scheduler which runs every say 5 mins will pick these Batch and process them which will send the JSON to doc-cl-transformer.Another scheduler will generate the report associated with the Batch.

## [710] DMGS-7937: As an internal OSTTRA user I should be able to bulk amend the customer notification subscriptions

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-02-03T20:42:48.465+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7937](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7937)

### Description:
### Requirement:

User Roles CRUD Operations:  OSTTRA Onboarding, OSTTRA PS User



As an internal OSTTRA user I want to bulk edit the notifications subscribed by client users, from the application. As a user I should be able to apply the same notification preferences for multiple users in one go, rather than doing them individually one by one.

**Go to → User Management Screen**

There should be an action button that will enable the user (with right permissions) to perform bulk action for notifications.

* Once the user clicks on the bulk action button, the user list should get checkboxes next to them, so the user can select the list of users they would like to perform the bulk operation on (filters would continue working and the user should also have an option to do a select All)
* Once the list of users is selected the user should get a set configuration button, clicking on which should present the user with the list of notifications available (similar side panel view)
* The next action is to subscribe/unsubscribe from the list of notifications and click “Apply” button
* The user should get a prompt that gives them a message that once they confirm and existing notification preferences of the user will be overwitten by this action and would they like to proceed with the action.
* Once confirmed the new notification preferences will be subscribed/unsubscribed based on the selection done by the user and completion message should be shown
 



**EDIT - 13/4/26**

Post discussion with the Dev team, we have agreed that once the user selects the Bulk Update option, the screen will be transformed into a lazy-loading screen (as we have challenges in persisting the state across multiple pages), and the Ops user will select the list of users they wish to bulk amend and make the necessary changes thereafter.

Also, for clarity the bulk update is required for DLs as well.

### Acceptance Criteria:

* I can invoke the USP Rider notice audit trail for a USP Rider notice from the USP Rider notice report.
* I am able to see what, when and who added or amended the details for a USP Rider notice.
* I can see the audit event for each change.
* I can see the date/time for each change.
* I can see which user made each change.
* I can clearly see what details have been added or have been changed.
* The audit trail of events is sorted in descending date/time order.
Design Hint:

User roles already user roles permissioned to view USP Rider notice can also view the audit trails.

## [714] DMGS-8021: Restrict EB editing of a DN

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-02-05T19:31:34.815+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8021](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8021)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the ODC application

I Want to only allow users to edit the DN under the following conditions:

* If the PB is online (DN initiator) and the EB is also online for a DN then EB users can only edit the Executing Broker Contact / Specified Offices section details and the EB internal notes section details for the DN.
* If the PB is not online and the EB is online (DN initiator) for a DN then EB users can edit the DN
So That users are restricted from changing the DN terms when not permitted.

Acceptance Criteria:

* EB users can edit the Executing Broker Contact / Specified Offices and the EB internal notes section details a DN only where the PB counterparty on the DN is online and initiates the DN.
* EB users can edit a DN where they initiate the DN and the PB counterparty on the DN is not online.
Background:

EB could create a DF (not always PB’s). This facilitates the use case where EB’s initiate a DN to manage credit within CreditLink and the PB is not online.

## [724] DMGS-8232: Disallow multiple in-flight draft versions of DN's and 4 Ways agreements

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-03-10T21:44:18.797+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8232](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8232)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an User

I Want To have only a single Draft version of a DN or 4 Ways agreement in-flight at any one time 

So That I can track, monitor and manage my agreements easier as well as avoid any mishaps with managing multiple draft versions of a document operationally.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Only a single draft version of a DN can be created at any one time for editing and subsequent approval then enforcement.
* Only a single draft version of a 4 Ways agreement can be created at any one time for editing and subsequent approval then enforcement.
Background Hints:

* No impact to the existing document state model and transitions.
* When the comparison tool is used, the scenario of a draft version having an ID earlier than the enforced version goes away.
Notes:

In terms of potential SocGen 4 Ways impact in Production, in agreement with the Product Owner we have agreed that encountering multiple draft versions is very low risk as SocGen plan to use ODC as a repository only in their initial phases to manage their 4 Ways agreements. The mitigation steps would be to ask SocGen to only maintain their ‘latest draft’ version of an agreement and cancel/delete the remaining draft versions before upgrading Production which includes this change.

## [728] DMGS-8276: Restrict multi-level agreement approval

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-03-12T09:46:53.429+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8276](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8276)

### Description:
Requirement:

As an online user

I Want to be restricted from carry out multiple levels of approval on a DN and 4 Ways agreements during an approval cycle

So That I adhere to my firm’s ‘Maker and Checker’ operational approval processes.

Acceptance Criteria:

* Where a user belongs to multiple approval layers, I am an unable to approve a DN agreement more than once during an approval cycle.
* Where a user belongs to multiple approval layers, I am an unable to approve a 4 Ways agreement more than once during an approval cycle.
* An error message is presented to the user if they attempt to approve a DN or 4 Ways agreement that they have already approved during the approval cycle. The message will say “You have approved this agreement already during this approval cycle and cannot approve it again.”.
Background:

Some firm’s are operationally set up whereby they have multiple layers of approval, e.g. Legal, Risk, etc. Multiple associated approval groups are set up and as a result, users can belong to more than one group.

## [729] DMGS-8289: PDF DN notification email update

* **Status:** `Dev Backlog`
* **Created At:** `2026-03-13T11:34:03.166+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8289](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8289)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a Prime Broker

I Want to receive an email notification with OSTTRA terms defined within when a DN has been approved internally

So That I can then complete the process of approving DN’s on behalf of an Executing Broker.

Acceptance Criteria:

The nominated email ID where provided receives a downloaded PDF version of a DN (customer bespoke where applicable otherwise product default) on PB approval in an email. The email details are:

* Subject: OSTTRA Documentation Centre: Designation Notice Prime Broker Approved
* Body:
### Dear User,

This email is being sent to you by OSTTRA Documentation Centre (ODC) (you can read about the same in the below section) in reference to a Designation Notice (DN) of which is attached that has been Approved by your organization as the Prime Broker counterparty. 

Document participants are:

* “OSTTRA (To be replaced with actual EB name for DN)” Executing Broker
* “IMMO WATER WEYDE (To be replaced with actual PB name for DN)” Prime Broker


**About OSTTRA Documentation Centre**

ODC provides a comprehensive, digital solution for managing multi-asset agreements, including: - Four-Way Agreements - Prime Broker Agreements - Designation Notices Agreement - Reverse Giveup Agreements and more. Subscribing clients can create, amend, terminate, and negotiate any part of an agreement using a flexible and customizable approval process. ODC subscribers can consolidate and gain approval for all of their agreements even if their counterparts are not yet subscribed to the service through the ODC Lite Access adoption, which allows a non-subscribing party to view, upload Power of Attorney and approve documents as required.

Thank you, OSTTRA team

## [732] DMGS-8340: Rename CreditLink Sync Statuses

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-03-20T18:20:50.374+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8340](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8340)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the ODC application

I want to rename the existing statuses that are shown as a result of syncing updates to DN’s from ODC to the downstream CreditLink system

So That they are clearer to users of the ODC application and the users can then act accordingly.

Acceptance Criteria:

The statuses reported under the associated DN update scenarios are as follows: 

**Existing Status**

**New Status**

**Status Description**

Sent

Sync Sent

A DN sync update has been issued from ODC to CreditLink. 

Updated

Sync Successful

A ‘Success’ acknowledgement message was sent and received from CreditLink in response to a DN sync update. 

Updated Rejected

Sync Rejected

A ‘Rejection’ acknowledgement message (NACK) was sent and received from CreditLink in response to a DN sync update.

Error

Credit Deletion Sent

A message was sent to CreditLink to remove authorisation and credit lines associated with the DN that was previously created from DN sync updates. 

Error Acknowledged

Credit Deletion Successful

A ‘Success’ acknowledgement message was sent and received from CreditLink in response to remove authorisation and credit lines associated with the DN.

Error Rejected

Credit Deletion Rejected

A ‘Rejection’ acknowledgement message (NACK) was sent and received from CreditLink in response to remove authorisation and credit lines associated with the DN.

Transformer Failure

Transformer Failure (no change)

A ‘Failure’ acknowledgement message (NACK) was sent and received from the ODC <> CreditLink transformer as a result of a failed attempt to transform a message that it received.

## [737] DMGS-8449: Currency Maker > Checker validation on DF and DN

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-03-30T10:29:05.966+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8449](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8449)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to easily check the currencies specified for the authorisation scope are within a defined scope

So That incorrect currencies have not included or excluded.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to easily identify that the correct currencies via the Currency Group have been included across the authorisation scope in my Document Framework (DF).
* I am able to easily identify that the correct currencies via the Currency Group have been included across the authorisation scope in my Designation Notice (DN).
* The Currency Group where specified in the DF is inherited by the DN.
* The Currency Group across the authorisation scopes in the DF and DN cannot be viewed in the generated PDF for external viewing.
Workflow:

* Supervisory level user manages a firm’s Currency Groups. (Phase 2: Tighter system controls to be implemented).
* Currency Groups are only used to add currencies to authorisation scope on DF and DN.
* Amendment and deletion of currencies individually to authorisation scope on DF and DN also Phase 2.
No impact on migration as currency groups in DNM are coupled with products directly. This is not the case in ODC. Therefore the above is BAU only.

## [744] DMGS-8535: Barclay API integration 

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-04-01T09:39:57.949+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8535](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8535)

### Description:
Barclay API integration : 



As of now, ODC publishes push API data on a fat queue, therefore, all orgs/ PB data is available on the queue which in turn gets published in IC barclays queue and everything is delivered to Barclays which is data security breach. **Strategic solution:** IC will build a layer which will segregate the data and send to the respective clients. 

**Intermittent Solution: **ODC will send only Barclays data on the queue as of now so that no data breach occur. this will be done only for barclays. and for future PBs strategic solution will be opted.

## [751] DMGS-8625: SSO SAML Implementation in ODC

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-04-03T09:23:43.334+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8625](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8625)

### Description:
Hi @allthanks for joining the call. Please find the minutes of the meeting below.

The SSO team is introducing SAML support with a new Auth server component, which requires

* Modern (Non Traina) applications to update their login & logout configuration that includes updating client id, secret, login endpoint, logout endpoint, jwks url etc. as they move away from Entra. Provide sign off on QA once done.
* Traiana applications, however, are not expected to make changes to their login flow but will receive tokens from the new auth server via a platform auth service. They must change their logout URL (if implemented) to point to the new Auth Server logout endpoint, with the expected behavior being that both the application session and the SSO session are logged out upon user action. Provide sign off on QA once done.
* Please note that upon logout IDP session won't be invalidated i.e. user won't be prompted to sign in again on the IDP if they try to login again. This is planned as an enhancement by Q2 end.
* The SAML solution is scheduled to go live on production on April 20th, and application teams were urged to plan their required changes by this deadline.

## [752] DMGS-8635: Add the feature to perform an action of "Add Authorization" on ODC

* **Status:** `Draft`
* **Created At:** `2026-04-06T11:27:23.226+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8635](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8635)

### Description:
We need to add a new Action Type on ODC that says “Add Authorization”. This action will be limited so users can only make the following amendments to the Auth Scope section of the document. All other sections of the document will be blocked from editing.

**Allowed actions on the Auth Scope**

* Add currencies/currency pairs to an existing auth line
* Create a new auth line (any other CRUD operation on this new line should also be allowed)
* If a new bullion-based auth line is being added, the metal transaction should be allowed to be added as well (if the metal transaction location already exists, allow the location to be edited)
**Blocked actions on the Auth Scope**

* Delete an existing auth line
* Amend the product or its attribute for an existing auth line
* Amend the tenor of an existing auth line
*Note: When acting on a DN we need to ensure all validations against the MA and in general correctness of the auth scope should be done before the user is allowed to save the changes*



**Impacted Areas:**

* Approval Matrix
* Approval Workflow (DN/4W)
In the case of DN, the newly added line should conform to all rules as laid out in the parent DF.



**Acceptance Criteria:**

As a user I should be allowed to add a new currency/auth line to the document (DN & 4W) and all other actions should be blocked. After submitting the document for approval, the path followed should be as described in the Approval Workflow section for the Document section that says “Add Authorization” and the Approval Groups should be determined based on the Groups added to the Approval Matrix for the Document Action - “Add Authorization”

---

## [753] DMGS-8640: Add the feature to perform "Add Authorization" in Bulk Action

* **Status:** `Draft`
* **Created At:** `2026-04-06T11:42:37.720+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8640](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8640)

### Description:
We need to add a new Action Type for Bulk Action on ODC that says “Add Authorization”. This action will be limited so users can only add a new auth line to the Auth Scope section of the document. Any other amendment to the document will be blocked.

The user journey would be as follows:

* The user will click on the “Bulk Action” button on the All Document Listing screen and click on “Edit”
* Select the “Doc Type” and “Acting As” from the drop-downs
* Select the option of “Add Authorization” from the “Action Type” dropdown
* The user will be redirected to the list of filtered eligible documents, and the user will select the list of documents they wish to bulk edit and click on “Next”
* Now the user will select the product they wish to add, including the complete auth line, i.e., product, currencies, and tenor.
* The user can also add multiple auth lines if they require, and then click on “Next”
If the document type is 4W move to Step 8 directly; else if the document type is DN move to Step 7

*Before moving to step 7, multiple checks need to be performed this could be time-sensitive, hence we need to ensure on the UI it is properly conveyed to the user with the help of a loader, etc. that some processing is happening in the background, and the next page will load soon once it is finished*

* Here, the user will be presented with a screen that will list all the documents that were selected by the user in Step 4 (if the selected doc type was of type DN) divided into the following three categories:

* If the added auth line is compliant with the MA, they will be in the Complaint sub-section (collapsible), where the user can see the list of compliant documents (with the columns as selected in Step 4)
* If the added auth lines **(one or more)** are partially compliant, the documents should be shown here, with the window-side pop-up option that shows the user the compliant (highlighted in green) and the non-compliant (highlighted in red) parts of the auth line/s

* The user will also have an option to choose, with the help of a drop-down, to either move the doc in “Move As In-Approval” state or “Move As Draft” state or “Ignore” from the bulk action scope, they would need to select this drop-down for each document that is part of this sub-section
* Given that there is a recent change where we are only going to support **only one draft version** of the document going forward on ODC at a given time, the “Move As Draft” option should only be available for those documents where another **“Draft” does not already** exist in the system.
* Once the user does the selection for each document part of this section the document should be handled accordingly and if the user decides to choose either “Move As Draft” or “Move As In-Approval”, a new version should be created with **only the compliant changes done to the document**
* If **ALL** the added auth lines are completely non-compliant, the documents should be shown in this section, these would be auto-removed from the bulk action scope
* Once the user submits, a new batch should be created.
### MockUps (Step 7)

**After clicking on View Details **





### Examples:

**Scenario 1 -**

**Scenario 2 -**

### **Acceptance Criteria:**

As a user, I should be allowed to bulk-add an auth line to the document (DN & 4W), and all other actions should be blocked. After submitting the documents for approval, the path followed should be as described in the Approval Workflow section for each document section that says “Add Authorization”  respectively and the Approval Groups should be determined based on the Groups added to the Approval Matrix for the Document Action - “Add Authorization”

## [763] DMGS-8798: Refinement of 'PB on behalf of EB' workflow' following stakeholder feedback

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-04-27T19:46:45.470+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8798](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8798)

### Description:
Background:

Refinement of the 'PB on behalf of EB' workflows is required following stakeholder feedback from Show & Tell session held 22 Apr '26 and subsequent review.

Points confirmed by DEV team:

* The ‘PB on behalf of EB’ approval applies to all document actions. Confirmed.
* Multiple levels (2+ approval groups) of internal PB approval can be applied before ‘PB on behalf of EB’ approval is processed. Confirmed.
Requirements:

* Manual ‘PB on behalf of EB’ Approval groups is to be limited to a maximum of 1 active approval group at any one time.
* Manual Approval group is not applicable to be setup by users in the Approval Matrix as it is not part of the PB’s internal approvals.
* Users should be able to set Executing Broker as a participant in the Approval Workflow setup from the DF which is then inherited by the DN to indicate that an executing broker approval is required for the agreement.
* The ‘PB on behalf of EB’ approval does not count as an internal multiple approval level instance - see  for reference. i.e. it is the EB approving.
* The Track facility is to reflect that i) a ‘PB on behalf of EB’ approval was applied and ii) the name of the approval group and user email ID of the user who carried the approval.
* Users are able to see whether an approval group is a Manual Approval group or not from the approval group report. Users are also able to filter for manual approval groups or ‘standard’ group.
* In conjunction with related (2) item from Must-Haves list, manual approval groups should not be listed for user selection from the Approval Matrix across all document actions.
* Not seen as a valid business cases today: Initiator, PB or EB are set up at the same approval sequence time for an approval workflow. The same applies for the reverse for PB approval to occur after ‘PB on behalf of EB’ approval.

---

Subscribing clients can create, amend, terminate, and negotiate any part of an agreement using a flexible and customizable approval process. ODC subscribers can consolidate and gain approval for all of their agreements even if their counterparts are not yet subscribed to the service through the ODC Lite Access adoption, which allows a non-subscribing party to view, upload Power of Attorney and approve documents as required.

## [766] DMGS-8866: Edit Limit agreement actions

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-05-06T17:46:07.576+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8866](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8866)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to edit the position limits held on my DN and 4 Ways agreements

So That I can manage my risk exposure accordingly for my counterparty relationships and get them approved.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to increase the position limits for my DN and 4 Ways agreements under the ‘Edit Limit Increase’ action and include a decrease limit if required where multiple limits are amended. (An increase in the limit is higher in risk exposure as per DNM).
* For (1), I am informed if no increase in limits has been applied and submission of the DN or 4 Ways agreement amendment is prevented. The user warning will state “None of the limits have increased, please review and resubmit.“.
* The ‘Edit Limit Increase’ document action is reflected on the Documents Dashboard on successful submission of the agreement amendment.
* The ‘Edit Limit Increase’ document action is reflected on the Track facility on successful submission of the agreement amendment.
* I am able to decrease the position limits for my DN and 4 Ways agreements under the ‘Edit Limit Decrease’ action when amending 1 or more position limits.
* For (3), I am informed if an increase in limits has been applied to 1 or more position limits and submission of the DN or 4 Ways agreement amendment is prevented. The user warning will state “One or more limits have increased, this is not allowed for the ‘Edit Limit Decrease’ document action. Please review“.
* The ‘Edit Limit Decrease’ document action is reflected on the Documents Dashboard on successful submission of the agreement amendment.
* The ‘Edit Limit Decrease’ document action is reflected on the Track facility on successful submission of the agreement amendment.
* The ‘Edit Limit Increase’ and ‘Edit Limit Decrease’ actions apply to the Approval matrix, single document editing and bulk documents editing.
* If use case steps 2 or 6 above are encountered during bulk editing of limits then a) a status of ‘Not-processed’ with b) the same reasons for each step respectively reported in the Bulk Request batch details.
* TBC: Change ‘Edit Limit Increase’ label to indicate that decreases are included?

* The multiple emails should be comma-separated, i.e., abc@xyz.com[,def@xyz.com](mailto:,def@xyz.com)
* If the emails are comma-separated, both the emails should be validated for correctness, i.e., following the standard formatting used by emails

* Example: [abc@xyz.com](mailto:abc@xyz.com),def@xyz should throw an error

## [770] DMGS-8954: Changes to API supported alternate ID's only do NOT trigger DN re-approval or version increment

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-05-15T17:24:44.073+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8954](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8954)

### Description:
Requirement:

As the ODC application

I Must not trigger an approval cycle for an agreement if only the EB and/or the Client alternate ID fields are changed during an DN amendment and submission

So That I don’t invoke unnecessary approval requests.

Acceptance Criteria:

* No approval cycle is triggered when only both or one out of the EB and/or the Client alternate ID fields are changed during an amendment and then submission of a DN. This applies to Enforced, In-Approval and Approved agreement states.
* Approval cycles are triggered when more than just the EB and/or the Client alternate ID fields are changed during an amendment and then submission of a DN.
* The version number for the DN is **NOT** incremented when only both or one out of the EB and/or the Client alternate ID fields are changed during an amendment and then submission of a DN.
* The updated alternate ID field values are sent outbound to subscribed parties on the next triggering event update.

I want to only allow the relevant user (PB or EB) to electronically sign the approval agreement

So That approval agreements are not incorrectly signed by the wrong parties. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* If I am a PB user I am not able to sign the approval agreement on behalf of the executing broker counterparty.
* If I am a EB user I am able to sign the approval agreement on behalf of the executing broker counterparty.

## [794] DMGS-9410: Cannot remove 'On behalf of EB' workflow on Approved Document Framework

* **Status:** `In QA`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-03T17:34:30.516+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9410](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9410)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to remove the 'On behalf of EB' DN workflow on an already approved DF

So That I can meet my DN approval needs.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I can remove the 'On behalf of EB' DN workflow on an already approved DF.
* I can add the 'On behalf of EB' DN workflow on an already approved DF.


Background Reference Tests:

* Create a DF and add DN approval workflow of PB followed by PB on Behalf of EB. Save draft.
* Edit draft, I can choose to remove the PB on Behalf of EB approval if required. No actions applied to DF.
* Submit and Approve DF created in (1).
* Go to edit approved DF. I **cannot** remove the PB on Behalf of EB approval from the workflow. i.e. uncheck the checkbox, can only remove the EB tile.


### Scenario Description:

**Instructions For**

**PB = Online, EB = Lite**

**PB = Online, EB = Online**

**PB = Online, EB = Online**

Approval Agreement 

Cannot be signed as the EB is not live on ODC

Available to Sign but Not Signed (PB & EB are not electronically live on ODC)

Signed (PB & EB are electronically live on ODC)

Before signing both PB & EB should have all the static setup completed(AM, AG, etc)

Document Framework

Can be created 

Can be created 

Can be created 

Approval Path for DF (With EB Approval) 

EB cannot be added as a participant as the Lite Workflow is not supported for DF approvals

***Note: Why PB on behalf of EB cannot be done for DF?***

EB cannot be added as a participant (as there is no PB on behalf of EB option here).

Currently, the EB can be added as a participant and the EB do their own approval, even if no AA is in place (to be checked with Chon)

***Note: Why PB on behalf of EB cannot be done for DF?***

EB can be added as a participant and needs to have approval matrix and group setup completed

Approval Path for DF (Without EB Approval) 

Only PB-specific checks

Only PB-specific checks

Only PB-specific checks

Approval Path for DN (With EB Approval) 

EB can be added as a participant, the workflow to be followed depends on the PB on Behalf of EB flag

PB on behalf of EB - Yes (Manual approver group should be present for the PB)

PB on behalf of EB - No (Email for approval email should be provided)

EB can be added as a participant, but the PB on behalf of EB flag needs to be selected (Manual approver group should be present for the PB)

EB can be added as a participant and needs to have approval matrix and group setup completed

PB on behalf of EB option should not be allowed

Approval Path for DN (Without EB Approval) 

PB on behalf of EB - Yes (Manual approver group should be present for the PB)

PB on behalf of EB - No (No futher checks)

PB on behalf of EB - Yes (Manual approver group should be present for the PB)

PB on behalf of EB - No (No futher checks)

PB on behalf of EB option should not be allowed

### Workflow Automations:

* DNs should always follow the approval path as described in the last approved DF, and not what was described in the last approved DN
* When a new DF version is approved, where the approval workflow for DN has been updated, ODC should automatically do the following:

* Option 1 - Create new versions of existing documents

* Approved/Enforced version - No change, leave the approved version as is, however when a user tries to create a new draft from this approved version, ensure the workflow is copied from the latest approved DF
* In-approval version - create a new in-approval version with the latest workflow and in the same approval stage as it was at that time; the current version should be cancelled, suppress any notifications
* Draft version - Do a backend override for all the draft versions to update the DN workflow through a silent system update
Note: The current understanding is that for a given DN, either a draft version or an in-approval one would exist; both cannot co-exist

* EB becomes Online from Lite, and the AA is not signed 

* DF Workflow for existing documents should not be touched, as EB cannot be added as a participant when the EB is lite, no change is expected on the existing DFs
* Any in-flight DFs pending approval should continue to follow the path as described when the document was submitted for approval (again, since EB cannot be a participant, no impact expected)
* Any DN that has EB as an approver should be blocked from submitting a fresh approval, and an appropriate error message should be displayed so the user is aware they need to go back to the DF and update the Approval Workflow (i.e., either remove EB as an approver or select the PB on Behalf of EB flag to yes)
* Any in-flight DNs pending approval should continue to follow the path as described when the document was submitted for approval
* EB is online, and the AA is signed

* Run validations before the AA can be signed, that both PB & EB have the required static setup in place
* Once the AA is signed, any existing DFs and corresponding DNs should be updated with the PB, with the EB flag unselected; the available options are the same as mentioned above.

## [802] DMGS-9631: UI/UX: Make user selection of currencies clearer

* **Status:** `In Development`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-24T12:00:40.245+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9631](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9631)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want the selection of applicable currencies to be more obvious

So That I can quickly identify which currencies I have a selected and progress with the management of my agreements.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to quickly identify which currencies and currency pairs I have selected when adding authorisation lines when forming the required authorisation scope for my Document Frameworks.
* I am able to quickly identify which currencies and currency pairs I have amended when editing authorisation lines that have been already added when forming the required authorisation scope for my Document Frameworks.
* I am able to quickly identify which currencies and currency pairs I have selected to be applicable (opting in from inherited DF) for the authorisation lines of my Designation Notice.
* I am able to quickly identify which currencies and currency pairs I have selected or amended to be applicable for the authorisation lines of my 4 Ways agreement.
* I am able to quickly identify which currencies and currency pairs I have selected to be applicable when creating or amending currency groups.
Considerations:

* In some cases, user scrolling is required as the available currencies is large so this needs to be taken into account.
* For user ‘Select All’ processing there is specific processing in particular when interfacing with CreditLink - this will require technical verification. In addition, the user gets informed when any currencies in DNM are not supported in CreditLink - out of scope for now but PM will verify this point for ODC <> CreditLink.
Assumptions:

Assumption made that the underlying components are shared and hence 4 Ways agreements behaviour is included in scope above.

---

## [803] DMGS-9636: UI/UX: Allow users to clear their currencies selection in a single action

* **Status:** `In Development`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-24T12:52:05.958+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9636](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9636)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to clear my selected currencies in a single action

So That I quickly amend my selections especially when I have a selected a large number of currencies.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to quickly clear my selected currencies and currency pairs I have selected when adding authorisation lines when forming the required authorisation scope for my Document Frameworks.
* I am able to quickly clear my selected currencies and currency pairs I have amended when editing authorisation lines that have been already added when forming the required authorisation scope for my Document Frameworks.
* I am able to quickly clear my selected currencies and currency pairs I have selected to be applicable (opting in from inherited DF) for the authorisation lines of my Designation Notice.
* I am able to quickly identify which currencies and currency pairs I have selected or amended to be applicable for the authorisation lines of my 4 Ways agreement.
* I am able to quickly clear my selected currencies and currency pairs I have selected to be applicable when creating or amending currency groups.

---

## [804] DMGS-9641: UI/UX: Authorisation scope grouping and presentation

* **Status:** `In Development`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-24T13:14:23.161+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9641](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9641)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to view my specified authorisation lines grouped by Product Families on my Document Frameworks, Designation Notices and 4 Ways agreements

So That I easily review my authorisation lines based on product families.

Acceptance Criteria:

* By default, when viewing the authorisation scope on invoking any agreement, all category groupings are collapsed. i.e. not showing constituent number of authorisation lines.
* I am able to view authorisation lines grouped by product families where they have been specified on Document Frameworks, Designation Notices and 4 Ways agreements.
* I am able to expand and collapse all category groupings to show or hide the constituent authorisation lines respectively in a single action.
* Each categorisation grouping states the number of constituent authorisation lines within that group.
* Each categorisation grouping indicates if there is an issue to any of the constituent authorisation lines within that group. e.g. incorrect currencies specified versus the settlement type selected.
* I am able to view authorisation lines grouped by product families on the PDF of Document Frameworks, Designation Notices and 4 Ways agreements. By default, the groups are expanded on the PDF’s.
Further Considerations (Both out of initial scope):

* Should we add grouping by Product (primary or secondary level) at this stage? E.g. this would handle scenarios where authorisation lines may still be large in number to view despite grouping at the product family level. We’ll review once above is in place.
* Should we add ordering of the lines within the groupings at this stage? E.g. alphabetic based off product names within the families: For Cash: a) Forwards, b) Future, c) Spot then d) Swap. Ordering would be applicable but based on binary versus non-binary product ordering basis.

---

## [805] DMGS-9647: UI/UX: Identification of most recently added authorisation line

* **Status:** `In Development`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-24T13:28:11.845+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9647](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9647)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to easily see and identify an authorisation line that I have added to my Document Framework, Designation Notice or 4 Ways agreement

So That I can quickly review the addition especially when I have a large number of authorisation lines.

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to **easily and quickly** review an authorisation line that I have added to a Document Framework, Designation Notice or 4 Ways agreement.
* The newly added authorisation line is highlighted at the top row (where multiple lines exist) within the product family category grouping showing as expanded for the product that it belongs to.
* The user view is anchored at the product family category group where the new authorisation line has been added.
**Note**: Product Design (Pankaj D) have recommended reducing the vertical padding from 24 to 16 pixels.

Consideration Point:

Solutioning needs to be thought about in conjunction with how we group and present authorisation scopes overall.

---

* **Status:** `Dev Backlog`

* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9654](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9654)

The current process requires 3 steps; edit mode to be invoked, limit entered and then saved. This applies per limit specified.

## [809] DMGS-9741: Identification and Excel download of electronically live relationships

* **Status:** `Code Review`
* **Created At:** `2026-08-05T19:45:16.527+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9741](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9741)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a Customer user or internal OSTTRA user

I Want to identify whether a PB and EB relationship on ODC is electronically live or not

So That I can determine if the executing broker is permitted contractually to approve DN’s electronically using the system. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to determine if a PB and EB relation is electronically live or not from the Documents dashboard.
* The data column is to be labelled ‘EB Acceptance’ and is an optional column for display on the Documents dashboard. Valid values are; a) Electronic (Electronic Signature from Approval Agreement), b) Externally (Agreement Signed Externally from Approval Agreement) and c) N/A (where an Approval Agreement does not exist or has not been signed all parties).
* The data column can be filtered via the simple column filter from the dashboard and via the query builder filter.
* The data column can be user sorted.
* I am able to download via an Excel csv the column and values that indicate if a PB and EB relation is electronically live or not against associated DN from the Documents dashboard.

---

## [810] DMGS-9759: Streamline usage where a user belongs to both PB and EB arm of a firm

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2026-08-07T18:07:20.484+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9759](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9759)

### Description:
Requirement:

As both an PB and EB user of a firm

I Want to manage my workflows seamlessly and easily on the ODC application

So That it is less chaotic compared to the current state where components, entities management and agreements across the arms of a firm are combined together. 

Acceptance Criteria:

* I am able to manage all my workflows available easily between my PB versus EB arm of my organisation when both are subscribed to the ODC service.
Possible Considerations:

* Can we possibly allow the user to flip between operating in PB and EB user mode?
* Don’t want users to login separately (PB or EB user mode) where possible. i.e. as per DNM.
* Confirmation required on how many customers are on the service under both modes.
* Not all ODC workflows support a PB / EB division within an organisation. E.g. Currency and Product groups.

---

## [811] DMGS-9764: Reduce complexity / clutter on display of product attributes

* **Status:** `Analysis`
* **Created At:** `2026-08-07T18:37:08.668+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9764](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9764)

### Description:
Requirement:

As a User

I Want to only see product attributes that are explicitly selected in the DF to be available for selection on the DN agreement when inherited

So That it reduces complexity and clutter.

Acceptance Criteria:

* By default, I am able to view product attributes only on my DN’s where they have been explicitly selected from the associated DF.
* From a DF, I am able to specify if I want associated DN agreements to show product attributes only where they have explicitly selected (default) or show all product attributes irrespective (current system state).

## [140] DMGS-1069: Bulk / Batch processing indication of why something has failed to process

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-02-28T10:48:46.828+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1069](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1069)

### Description:
<p>When performing a bulk request there needs to be a clear view of which docs are in what state, in the case where something has failed to process there needs to be a clear reason for why it failed to process</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>For each of the numbers representing a processing status it should be possible to click on the number and have view of the docs in that state. It also should be possible to click directly on a hyper link for each document in that state that will take you directly to the document in question.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Where a doc has <b>failed </b>to process or is in a <b>not-processed</b> state there needs to be a clear reason for each document as to why it has failed to process. Failure to provide this inform will likely result in the customers calling OSTTRA support to ask for clarity on why something didn't process as expected.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><span class="image-wrap" style=""><img src="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202302282776012740098736336&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202302282776012740098736336&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png)" alt="" class="je-pasted-image" width="553" height="176" style="border: 0px solid black;"></span></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>Priority to be determined by <a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="197062" data-mention="sF3EKNjo" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=jackje](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=jackje)" rel="jackje" data-wiki="">Jack Jeffreys</a>&nbsp;<a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="197062" data-mention="T1enaa1Q" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=haim](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=haim)" rel="haim" data-wiki="">Haim Levy</a>&nbsp;based on how likely it is customers will use this functionality.</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>As a minimum OSTTRA Ops need a way to know exactly why a set of messages are in a given state, if this means running DB queries&nbsp;then we need to educate L2 on how to run these queries <a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="197753" data-mention="t3YzE6d0" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=kush.jain](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=kush.jain)" rel="kush.jain" data-wiki="">Kush Jain (IHS Markit)</a>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

### Description:

## [182] DMGS-1324: Tidy up naming conventions across screens for consistency

* **Status:** `Dev On Hold`
* **Created At:** `2023-05-03T10:30:25.840+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1324](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1324)

### Description:
<p dir="auto"><a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="199828" data-mention="UvhhRMHF" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=haim](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=haim)" rel="haim" data-wiki="">Haim Levy</a>&nbsp;<a class="user-hover" data-context="" data-issue="199828" data-mention="xy3fO4Bs" href="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=jackje](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?name=jackje)" rel="jackje" data-wiki="">Jack Jeffreys</a>&nbsp;FYI, in case you have differing views</p>

<p dir="auto">A number of items across the UI should be tidied up to ensure consistency and to scan correctly when reading</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">Examples "use of mixed capitals varies"</p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>"Document templates"</li><li>"Approval Groups"</li><li>""Currencies &amp; Currencies-pair groups"</li></ul>

<p dir="auto">Either we should drop the capital letters after the initial capital letter, or we capitalise</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">I would recommend dropping the capitalisation on subsequent words, it appears to be the more common approach across docs and CSM</p>

<p dir="auto">Ones to look into&nbsp;</p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>"Create new document"</li><li>"Currencies and currency-pair groups"</li><li>"Approval groups"</li><li>"Product groups"</li><li>"Approval matrix"</li><li>"Document templates"</li></ul>

<p dir="auto"><span class="image-wrap" style=""><img src="[https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202305038704248270892853474&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png](https://jira.traiana.luminatesec.com/plugins/servlet/jeditor_file_provider?imgId=ckupload202305038704248270892853474&amp;fileName=pastedImage.png)" alt="" class="je-pasted-image" width="290" height="231" style="border: 0px solid black;"></span></p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;"User management" in the side bar becomes "User onboarding" on the screen. They both should say "User management"</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">In the side menu / side bar, the naming should probably be changed to be more consistent with the screens</p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>"Currencies Group"&nbsp; to&nbsp; "Currency Groups"</li><li>"Product Group" to "Product Groups"</li><li>"Approval Group" to "Approval Groups"</li><li>"Document Template" to "Document Templates"</li></ul>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

## [218] DMGS-1471: Expired password emails don't provide a view on how to correct

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-07-14T09:52:28.131+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1471](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1471)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">If a user has a password reset email sent to them, the email then expires after some time (not sure what that is..), but it is then not clear on how the customer should proceed</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">2 issues</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">1. If there is an expiry time on the reset link then it should say what the expiry limit is</p>

<p dir="auto">2. It should be clear for the customer on how to reset their password</p>

<ul dir="auto"><li>Is it contact support</li><li>Is it try and login and follow the password reset link</li><li>Should their be a link that allows them to request a new password?</li></ul>

<p dir="auto">The answer to the above depends on how the system was designed</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

### Description:

## [221] DMGS-1476: Change users permissions don't seem to take effect until cache is cleared

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-07-14T16:26:14.282+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1476](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1476)

### Description:
<p dir="auto">Steps&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">1. created a new user using admin user in chrome</p>

<p dir="auto">2. didn't assign any roles</p>

<p dir="auto">3. tried to login using MS edge&nbsp;- failed with error message of no roles assigned</p>

<p dir="auto">4. went to admin user in chrome, assigned some permissions&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">5. attempted to login with created user in edge, still didn't work</p>

<p dir="auto">6. cleared cache in edge</p>

<p dir="auto">7. was successfully able to login</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">tired with simply changing roles and that worked okay<br>&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">Did a repeat by removing roles, was able to repeat behaviour<br>Removed all roles&nbsp;<br>Attempted to login<br>Failed to login because no roles assigned<br>Added roles back in Failed to login still because of no roles assigned<br>Cleared cache<br>Attempted to login worked</p>

<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>

<p dir="auto">Raising as critical as scenario of user having no roles in first place is unlikely.</p>

---

## [226] DMGS-1530: Total record count displayed - Documents

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-08-09T16:46:54.822+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1530](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1530)

### Description:
Current behaviour:

The ‘Current record count’ field is only showing the number of records displayed on the page of the report.

Expected behaviour:

It should show the total number of records returned for a given search. The associated text label should also be updated to display ‘Total record count:’ from ‘Current record count:’.

Test steps:



Navigate to the Documentsdashboard report or via the ‘All documents’ menu option.

Perform a search that returns less or more than the set number of records to be displayed per report page.

Refer to the bottom right hand corner of the report.

---

## [260] DMGS-1771: Incorrect Login Link in Email Notification

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-19T07:43:35.486+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1771](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1771)

### Description:
When we dispatch an email to users prompting them to log in to the application, the email currently contains a link directing to the UAT  environment. As a result, any user attempting to log in through this email will mistakenly be navigated to the UAT platform, not the live production environment.

Steps to Reproduce:Trigger an email notification that prompts a user to loginOpen the email and click on the provided login link.Observe that the URL navigates to the UAT environment.

Expected Result:Users should be directed to the production login page when clicking on the login link from the email.

Actual Result:Users are being redirected to the UAT login page.

---

## [261] DMGS-1772: Missing JWT Protection in Notification Microservice

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2023-10-19T07:53:51.649+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-1772](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-1772)

### Description:
<p class="p1" dir="auto">Our notification microservice currently does not validate the JWT tokens sent with requests. Initial investigations indicate that neither token validation nor role-based checks are in place for this microservice. This is a significant security risk, leaving the service vulnerable to unauthorized access and potentially compromising sensitive data.</p>

<p class="p1" dir="auto"><b>Steps to Reproduce</b>:</p>

<ul class="ul1" dir="auto"><li class="li1">Send a request to the notification microservice without a valid JWT token or with a tampered token.</li><li class="li1">Observe that the service processes the request without validating the JWT token or performing role-based checks.</li></ul>

<p class="p1" dir="auto"><b>Expected Result</b>:</p>

<p class="p1" dir="auto">The notification microservice should validate JWT tokens sent with every request and perform role-based checks before processing. Invalid or unauthorized requests should be rejected.</p>

<p class="p1" dir="auto"><b>Actual Result</b>:</p>

<p class="p1" dir="auto">The notification microservice currently processes requests without JWT validation and role-based checks.</p>

---

## [635] DMGS-2742: Scheduler Microservice Processes Jobs Sequentially Instead of Concurrently

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2024-05-01T10:29:35.503+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-2742](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-2742)

### Description:
The current implementation of our scheduler microservice processes scheduled jobs in a single-threaded manner. This behavior causes delays for users when multiple jobs are queued, as the jobs are processed one at a time. For example, if User 1 submits 5 scheduled jobs and immediately afterward User 2 submits 5 jobs, User 2's jobs will not begin processing until all of User 1's jobs have completed. This sequential processing model leads to inefficient handling of jobs and increases wait times unnecessarily.

Expected Behavior:The scheduler microservice should be capable of processing multiple jobs concurrently, allowing different users' jobs to be processed in parallel. This would reduce waiting times and improve the efficiency of job processing.

---

## [1053] DMGS-4200: The DF Framework Approval logic fails when attempting to perform actions simultaneously on two different tabs.

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2025-01-17T09:15:35.949+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4200](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4200)

### Description:
The DF Framework logic fails when actions are performed simultaneously on two different tabs.

Steps to reproduce:

* Create a DF and set it to "In-Approval" status.
* In parallel, create a DN and set it to "In-Approval" status.
* Attempt to approve the DN (with the pre-requisite that the DF is in "In-Approval" status).
**Actual Behavior**: The DN is approved, and when attempting to approve the DF, an error occurs.

**Expected Behavior**: The DN should not be approved, as the DF is in "In-Approval" status (all DNs should be frozen). The user should be able to approve the DF successfully, as the DF approval flow is independent of the DN flow.

---

## [1146] DMGS-4625: Performance Degradation and Slowness When Loading 100 Documents

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-02-11T14:00:09.898+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4625](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4625)

### Description:
Observed performance issues when loading documents in the UI. The response time increases significantly as the number of documents increases, and loading 100 documents results in a 504 Gateway Timeout error.

**Observations:**

* Load **10 documents** → Takes **~8 seconds** to display.
* Load **50 documents** → Takes **~20 seconds** to display.
* Load **100 documents** → UI displays **"No records found"**, but the underlying REST API call fails after **30 seconds** with a **504 Gateway Timeout error**.
**Underlying REST API** - api/document/graphql

The application should load documents efficiently, scaling well with an increasing number of records.

I will attach more findings.

---

## [1193] DMGS-4776: Bulk Approval – Loading 15 documents takes 12-15 seconds on "In-approval Documents" screen

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-03-04T22:10:57.769+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4776](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4776)

### Description:
The **Bulk Approval** feature is designed to enable users to approve multiple documents at once. When the user clicks on **Bulk Approval**, the screen titled **"In-approval Documents"** is displayed, listing documents eligible for bulk approval. However, it has been observed that the system consistently takes **12-15 seconds** to load each batch of **15 documents**, including the initial set. This delay severely impacts the user experience, especially for users handling large document volumes. Ideally, the system should load documents within **2-3 seconds** to maintain efficiency and responsiveness.

**Underlying REST API** - [https://odc-nft.docs.osttra.com/api/document/graphql](https://odc-nft.docs.osttra.com/api/document/graphql)

---

## [1194] DMGS-4777: Slow Loading of Document Frameworks

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-03-05T00:32:42.281+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4777](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4777)

### Description:
**Issue:** During NFT testing, it was observed that the **Document Framework** screen takes **6-10 seconds** to load **100 document frameworks**, which is slower than expected.

**Expected Behavior:** The screen should load **100 document frameworks within 1-2 seconds** to meet performance requirements.

**Underlying REST API**: api/document/v1/document-framework-list

**Impact:** The slow loading time affects user experience and may lead to delays in document-related actions.

**Next Steps:** Performance optimization is needed to reduce load time and ensure it aligns with the expected NFR, which is 2 Seconds

---

## [1203] DMGS-4862: Potential OOM Risk: JVM Heap Limit Exceeds Pod Memory in Multiple Services

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-03-12T19:09:01.660+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-4862](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-4862)

### Description:
During a configuration review, we identified a mismatch between the **JVM heap settings** and the **pod resource limits** in multiple services:

> **Pod Resource Limits & Requests:**
> 
> * Limits: CPU: 700m, **Memory: 2Gi**
> * Requests: CPU: 250m, Memory: 1Gi
> JAVA_ARGS - -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseCGroupMemoryLimitForHeap -Xmx3800m -Xms3800m
> 
>

**Issue: **The JVM max heap** (**`-Xmx3800m`**)** is larger than the pod memory limit (2Gi), which could potentially lead to OOMKilled scenarios.

**Affected Services:** authorization, currency, document,financial,legal-term,notification-svc,org-svc,product-svc,scheduler-svc

#### **Impact:**

* Potential risk of OOMKilled errors if memory usage spikes.
* JVM might be under memory pressure, leading to excessive GC cycles and performance degradation.
* Inconsistent configuration can make memory behavior unpredictable.
**Recommendation**:

* Reduce `-Xmx` to align with pod limits (e.g., `-Xmx1500m` for safety).

---

## [1327] DMGS-5518: Missing Readiness and Observability in ODC Inter-Service Dependencies

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-05-22T20:45:20.559+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-5518](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-5518)

### Description:
During initial resilience testing on the Drop2a build of the ODC application, it was observed that multiple internal services (e.g., `dms-document-svc`, `currency-svc`, `product-svc`) do not handle the unavailability or recovery of their internal dependencies gracefully. This behavior is likely to impact upcoming merged services in Drop2b as well if readiness, failure handling, and recovery mechanisms are not incorporated at the service level.

### **Issue Details:**

* When internal services like `currency-svc` or `product-svc` are stopped, the calling service (`dms-document-svc`) logs no errors, warnings, or retries.
* After the dependent services are restored, the system resumes normal functionality, but there are no logs or indicators showing recovery or re-establishment of connectivity.
This suggests missing:

* Readiness/liveness probes
* Retry logic
* Observability and logging for dependency state changes
### **Expected Behaviour:**

* When currency-svc and product-svc are down, dms-document-svc should log errors or warnings and gracefully handle the unavailability (e.g., return meaningful errors or fallback responses).
* When these services restart, dms-document-svc should log their recovery and resume normal operation.
**Impact:**

* This issue severely impacts the resilience and observability of the ODC application. It leads to silent failures, making troubleshooting difficult and potentially resulting in incorrect data.

---

**Steps to Reproduce:**

* Open the ODC Org screen
* Select entity type as **"4 Way"**.

* Switch the entity type to **"DN"**.
* Observe: LEIs appear correctly for DN.
* Switch the entity type back to **"4 Way"**.

## [1452] DMGS-6081: ODC NFT : API Timeout During Document Creation with 10 Users (Total 10 Documents Only)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-07-21T13:53:40.032+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-6081](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-6081)

### Description:
API (POST) : /api/document/v1/document?versionId=&isRestrictionDocument=falseObserved HTTP-504 (Gateway Timeout) in this API while creating bulk documents (more than **10 documents**)

**Steps to Reproduce:**

* Ramp up 10 users within 1-2 minutes.
* Each user logs in and starts creating single document
**Observed Result:**

* Application becomes unresponsive.
* API `/api/document/v1/document?versionId=&isRestrictionDocument=false` returns **HTTP-504 (Gateway Timeout)** during document creation.
**Expected Result:**

* Application should handle ramp-up load and concurrent document creation without timeouts.
