## [1778] DMGS-6821: Bulk Request List: filter fails on partial and full text search queries

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-09-26T07:27:44.250+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-6821](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-6821)

### Description:
### **Scenario 1: Partial Keyword Search Fails**

**Steps to Reproduce:**

* Navigate to the Bulk Request list page.
* Click on the "`Select Document Initiator by Lei`" filter dropdown. A list of Leis appears.
* In the search input field within the dropdown, type a partial, common keyword that exists in multiple status names, such as `"client"`.
* Observe the list of suggestions.
**Expected Result:** The dropdown list should dynamically filter to show all status options that contain the word "client" (e.g., "Bank BTB Updated - Client").

**Actual Result:** The dropdown immediately shows "No options" and does not display any matching results, even though statuses containing the word "client" exist.



### **Scenario 2: Full Text Search Fails After Initial Filtering**

**Steps to Reproduce:**

* Navigate to the Bulk Request list page.
* Click on the "`Select Document Initiator by Lei`" filter dropdown.
* In the search input field, type a full, existing status name like `"Bank BTB Updated - Client"`. The dropdown correctly filters to show this option.
* Now, add `- EB` to the filter text so the full search term is `"Bank BTB Updated - EB"`.
* Click the search/filter action.
**Expected Result:** The main list should filter to display “No record found“ if any record containing "Bank BTB Updated - EB" status is not present

**Actual Result:** The page incorrectly displays "Bank BTB Updated - PB" data

---

## [1859] DMGS-7066: Document Terms Field is acting as mandatory if user tries to remove the data and save again

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-11-07T05:15:11.737+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7066](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7066)

### Description:
Steps:

* Create a DN/4W document
* Go to Document Terms tab
* Enter something in Document terms and click next
* Go back to Document Terms again and remove the entire entered data
* Click on Next
Actual Result: “Body is required“ error appears on screen which prevents user to move ahead

Expected Result: Document Terms should be saved without data.

## [1911] DMGS-7340: Memory Configuration Mismatch in dms-org-svc

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2025-11-27T15:27:13.660+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-7340](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-7340)

### Description:
During analysis of the DMS ODC NFT Kubernetes environment, it was identified that the dms-org-svc pod is running with a JVM heap configuration that exceeds its allocated memory request.

**Current configuration:**

* **JVM Heap (Xmx/Xms):** 3072m
* **Pod Memory Request:** 2Gi
* **Pod Memory Limit:** 4Gi
* **Fargate Capacity:** 0.5 vCPU / 3GB
Because Xmx = 3GB but the memory request is only 2GB, Fargate allocates only 2GB at scheduling time. This leads to memory pressure and caused at least one restart.

This misalignment may create instability under load, increased GC pressure, and potential pod eviction or throttling.

**Impact:**

* Unexpected restarts under moderate traffic
* Potential performance degradation
* Risk of service unavailability during NFT load scenarios
**Required Fix**

* Option A (recommended): Increase memory request to match JVM heap
* Option B: Reduce JVM heap to fit into 2Gi request

* There is a functionality to remove the user [xyz@abc.com](mailto:xyz@abc.com) from AG1 when user-lei org type mapping is removed from user.
* No audit entries are present in for approval group in this case.
**Tech Reference:** `dms-org-svc: UserService.processApprovalGroupCleanup`

## [2111] DMGS-8425: UI Amendments - Suggestion (Raised by Ops to improve daily BAU)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-03-26T11:26:38.897+0100`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8425](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8425)

### Description:
**Suggestion 1 :- ****User Story:** As a user, I want to remain on the same page with my selected DNs after performing a Bulk Sync to CreditLink, so that I don't lose my place or have to navigate back from the home Documents screen.

(**Comments from Ops - **Once you sync several DNs using Bulk Action > Sync to CreditLink, those same DNs should remain on the page upon refresh, rather than going back to the home Documents screen)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

* **Given** a user has selected several DNs and clicked "Bulk Action > Sync to CreditLink"
* **When** the sync action completes and the page refreshes
* **Then** the user remains on the current page viewing the same DNs, rather than being routed to the home Documents screen.
**Suggestion 2:- **

**User Story:** As a user, I want a quick way to select items and a direct "Sync to CreditLink" button on the main (DN) Documents screen, so that I can process documents faster without having to dig into the Bulk Action dropdown.

(**Comments from Ops **- Request: Can there be a "Select" button and a quick "sync to CreditLink" from the Documents screen without using bulk action? Is this coming in the CreditLink Management Release?)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

* **Given** a user is on the main Documents screen
* **When** they need to sync items to CreditLink
* **Then** they can easily select items and click a visible, top-level "Sync to CreditLink" button.
* **And** the sync processes exactly as it does currently via the Bulk Action menu.
**Suggestion 3:- **

As a user, I want a "Select All" checkbox that applies only to my filtered search results, so that I can quickly perform bulk actions on specific subsets of data (like all "Goldman" entities) without clicking them one by one.

(**Comments from Ops **- Ability to "select all" when you filter by one word (ie. when I search for "Goldman" in EB1 - Legal Entity Name and 6 results appear, can there also be a "select all" checkbox that will select the 6?)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

* **Given** a user has applied a text filter to a column (e.g., "EB1 - Legal Entity Name") and a subset of results is displayed on the screen.
* **When** the user clicks the "Select All" checkbox.
* **Then** all currently visible (filtered) items are selected.
**Suggestion 4:- **

As a user, I want the "**Document ID**" and "**Document Version ID**" columns to remain frozen on the left side of the Documents screen, so that I can maintain context of which document I am reviewing when scrolling horizontally to view additional data columns.

(**Comments from Ops** - In Documents screen, Can we freeze Document ID and Document version ID columns upon scrolling to the right to view more columns)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

* **Given** a user is viewing the data table on the Documents screen
* **When** the table has more columns than can fit on the screen and the user scrolls horizontally to the right
* **Then** the "Document ID" and "Document version ID" columns remain fixed in place on the left side of the view.
* **And** the rest of the columns scroll horizontally as normal.

---

## [2196] DMGS-8842: Incorrect "Update" action button displayed for logged-in user in User Management

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-05-05T09:27:48.296+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-8842](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-8842)

### Description:
In the **User Management** module, a logged-in user is currently presented with an **"Update"** button when searching for their own profile. Expected behavior is that a user should only have a **"View"** button for their own record, as self-updates are restricted through this interface.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Log in to the application.
* Navigate to the **Users & notifications management** screen.
* In the search bar, enter the **email address** or **name** of the currently logged-in user.
* Observe the **Action** column for the search result.
### **Actual Result**

The system displays an **"Update"** button for the user’s own record. If clicked, the user is redirected to the "User Information" and "User Access" edit screens, even though they should not be able to modify their own permissions or details from this view.

### **Expected Result**

The system should detect if the search result matches the logged-in user. If it does, the **"Update"** button should be replaced with a **"View"** button (read-only access).

---

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-05-22T12:37:42.350+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9008](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9008)

### Description:
i was doing a bulk edit limit action for some documents, For below document i saw, that a limitline with 0 limit value is appearing which i can edit as much as i like.

On looking pf preview of that document it shows that the limitline is not part of the enforced version, thus a disabled limit line.

I believe edit limit action shouldn't allow users to add more limit lines thus we need to fix this issue.

P.S: for a single document Edit action, we are allowing the user to enable new limit lines and enter values as neccessary. Should a similar mechanism exist there? or is it out of scope for bulk action

Update 2: Some more findings.1. Even if you enter a value for a limit line which has 0 limitvalue, it doesnt get added to the new created version. <To be fixed in the release version>2. If you enter 0 as a value fo existing limit line it fails the batch action for that document **'This has failed. Reason : Unable to delete the item from the document, please perform the action again'. This should get resolved with **.

## [2290] DMGS-9042: Performance Degradation Observed for build 26.4.1.0

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2026-05-28T08:14:35.282+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9042](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9042)

### Description:
#### **Overview**

During recent load testing, a major performance regression was observed in the latest build. The number of APIs with response times higher than 2 seconds has increased significantly from 17 endpoints to 27 endpoints. Overall SLA compliance dropped from 82.8% to 72.7%.

* **Baseline Build:** v3.0.3.0 (Tested 03/05/2026)
* **Target/Current Build:** v26.4.1.0 (Tested 25/05/2026)
* **Total Endpoints Tested:** 99
#### **Critical Performance Regressions (>100% Increase)**

The following endpoints showed severe latency spikes, more than doubling their average response times:

**Request Name**

**Action Invoked**

**Avg (v3.0.3.0)**

**Avg (v26.4.1.0)**

**% Change**

HTTP Request Final Submit

DocCreation-4Way

1.034s

4.137s

**+299.90%**

HTTP Request Final Submit

DocCreation-DN

1.861s

4.735s

**+154.48%**

HTTP Request Legal Term

DocCreation-DN

0.887s

1.969s

**+121.98%**

HTTP Request Enforcement Rules

DocCreation-4Way

0.958s

2.075s

**+116.60%**

HTTP Request Enforcement Rules

DocCreation-DN

0.962s

2.051s

**+113.20%**

HTTP Request Legal Term

DocCreation-4Way

0.917s

1.927s

**+110.14%**

#### **Key Observations & Patterns**

* **Document Creation Bottlenecks:** The `DocCreation-4Way` and `DocCreation-DN` workflows across multiple endpoints (Final Submit, Legal Term, Enforcement Rules, Document Create) are heavily degraded.
* **Bulk Operation Latency:** Consistent performance drops of 20%–30% were noted across all `Bulk Edit`, `Bulk Terminate`, and `Bulk Approve` actions, suggesting potential database locking or indexing issues introduced between these builds.
#### **Steps to Reproduce / Test Environment**

* Run the standard load test suite against the target environment using build `26.4.1.0`.
* Observe the average response times under peak load for the endpoints listed above.
* Compare telemetry/database query logs against the `3.0.3.0` baseline.
#### **Expected Result**

Average API response times should remain under the 2-second, matching or improving upon the `3.0.3.0` baseline.

#### **Actual Result**

27 APIs fail the SLA, with response times spiking up to 4.7 seconds on business-critical creation endpoints.

---

## [2340] DMGS-9228: User is not redirected to the login screen when deactivated by an admin; system hangs with an error toast.

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2026-06-16T09:10:19.764+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9228](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9228)

### Description:
When an administrator deactivates a user account, the expected behavior is that the deactivated user is seamlessly redirected back to the login screen without errors. However, the system currently hangs on an infinite "Please Wait..." loading spinner, and a red toast notification is displayed at the top right corner stating: *"User is inactive or associated org is not online"*.

**Pre-requisites:**

* A standard user account is currently logged into the OSTTRA Documentation Centre.
* An admin account with privileges to deactivate users is available.
**Steps to Reproduce:**

* Log into the application as a standard user.
* Using an Admin account (in a separate browser/session), deactivate the logged-in standard user's account.
* Observe the standard user's active session.
**Expected Result:** The standard user's session should terminate gracefully, and the user should be immediately redirected to the login screen without encountering any errors or stuck loading states.

**Actual Result:** The user remains on the ODC screen. The page is blocked by a continuous "Please Wait..." loading spinner, and a red error notification appears in the top right corner: *"User is inactive or associated org is not online"*.

---

## [2392] DMGS-9424: Executing Broker (EB) Name Missing in Grid and Filter Failure for Approved Document Framework

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-06T13:41:28.656+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9424](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9424)

### Description:
### **Summary**

When a Document Framework is created and successfully approved, the **Executing Broker (EB) Name** is blank/missing in the main dashboard grid. Furthermore, applying filters for both the respective **Prime Broker (PB) Name** and **Executing Broker (EB) Name** results in a `"No Record Found"` message, despite the document clearly existing and containing both entities in its preview layout.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the **Create Document Framework** portal.
* Select **Document type** as `DN` and **Acting as** `PB`.
* Under **Select parties**, choose:

* **Prime Broker - 1:** `Osttra India Services Private Limited`
* **Executing Broker - 1:** `codestar Solutions AG`
* Progress through the workflow tabs (**Enforcement Rules**, **Auth Scope**, **Limit Scope**) configuring required lines and click **Next**.
* On the **Preview & Submit** tab, click **Submit For Approval**.
* Once the green notification toast `"Document is Approved"` appears, observe the main **Document Framework (DF)** dashboard grid.
* Click on the newly created **DF Version ID** link (`DF-094499-A-001`) to verify the Document Preview (Notice both LEIs are correctly visible here).
* Close the preview and apply the multi-column filters on the dashboard grid:

* Filter **PB Name** by selecting `Osttra India Services Private Limited`.
* Filter **EB Name** by selecting `codestar Solutions AG`.
### **Actual Result**

* **Grid Display:** The newly generated row shows the correct `PB Name` but leaves the `EB Name` column completely empty/blank.
* **Filter Behavior:** Applying filters for both the specific PB and EB names removes the record from view and displays a `"No Record Found"` message.
### **Expected Result**

* The **EB Name** (`codestar Solutions AG`) should correctly display alongside the **PB Name** within the dashboard grid layout.
* Filtering by the respective PB and EB entities should successfully populate and display the associated framework record in the results row.
### **Associated Framework Details**

* **DF ID:** `DF-094499-A`
* **DF Version ID:** `DF-094499-A-001`
* **Status:** Approved

## [2394] DMGS-9427: 500 Internal Server Error on 'product-group-list' API in Auth Scope Tab

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-06T14:37:03.818+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9427](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9427)

### Description:
### **Summary**

When navigating to or loading the **Auth Scope** tab while creating a Document Framework, the system throws a generic `"Something went wrong"` UI error. This is caused by a backend failure (`500 Internal Server Error`) on the `product-group-list` GET API request, which prevents the **Auth Products** dropdown selections from populating.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the Document Framework section and open an existing framework for editing (e.g., Document ID: `DF-721375-A-001`).
* Progress through the creation/editing wizard until you reach the **Auth Scope** tab.
* Observe the top-right corner for toast notifications and check the network tab in the developer console.
### **Actual Result**

* **UI Behavior:** A red error toast notification appears stating: `"Something went wrong"`. Under the **Auth Products** section, the dropdown configurations (like *Select Product Group*) fail to load/populate data.
* **Network Log Failure:** The following API call fails:

* **Request URL:** `https://odc-qa.docs.osttra.com/api/document/v1/product-group-list?searchValue=`
* **Request Method:** `GET`
* **Status Code:** `500 Internal Server Error`
### **Expected Result**

* The `product-group-list` API should successfully return a `200 OK` response with the relevant product group data.
* The **Select Auth Scope Data** dropdown should populate correctly without triggering any error flags or toast alerts.
traceId":"e07ea4b0-ce28-44bc-9cf6-58e099014157

## [2402] DMGS-9446: UI Selection Lock and Inability to Multi-Select Product Families When 'Cash -> Spot' is Selected

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-09T10:18:58.689+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9446](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9446)

### Description:
### **Summary**

During the creation of a Product Group, selecting **Cash** as the *Product Family* and checking **Spot** inside the *Select Product* dropdown causes an issue with the multi-select component. The interface fails to properly retain or allow simultaneous selection of other product families and product combinations, forcing the user to clear out fields or work around the lockout behavior to add multiple lines.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the **Create Product Group** page.
* Enter a **Product group name** (e.g., `Akshita7July`) and select an **Organisation** (e.g., `BARCLAYS BANK PLC`).
* Under the **Auth products** section, select `FX` from the first dropdown.
* Click on the **Select Product Family** dropdown and choose `Cash`.
* Open the **Select Product** dropdown and check the box for `Spot` (along with `Future` or `Forward`).
* Attempt to select and add other product families (such as `Exotic Options`, `Vanilla Options`, or `Volatility`) concurrently without clearing the entire form block.
### **Actual Result**

Once `Cash` and its product `Spot` are picked, the UI components do not smoothly allow multi-selection across other product families. The dropdown interaction restricts the user from effectively blending multiple distinct groups together in one flow, leading to selections being dropped or requiring a manual clear (`X`) of the product family field to reset the input behavior.

### **Expected Result**

The system should fully support multi-selection across all available fields. Selecting `Cash -> Spot` should not restrict or lock out the choice of other product families or products. The user should be able to seamlessly select multiple groups and click **Add Product Line** to populate the configuration matrix below the input selectors.

---

## [2403] DMGS-9447: Missing Auto-Save and Data Loss on Tab Navigation within Document Templates

* **Status:** `Open`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-09T10:32:28.948+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9447](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9447)

### Description:
### **Summary**

When creating or updating a Document Template, navigating away from the current tab (e.g., moving from **Approval Workflow** to **Enforcement Rules**) does not auto-save user input. Instead, the application displays a confirmation prompt warning that changes will be lost, resulting in total data deletion if the user proceeds.

This behavior is completely inconsistent with other workflows across the platform—such as **Document Framework (DF)** and **Document (DN)**—where switching tabs seamlessly triggers an automatic background save.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the **Document Templates** screen and click **Create New Template** (or edit an existing template like `Akshita7July4W`).
* On the initial **Approval Workflow** tab, assign participants (e.g., drag and drop `Prime Broker - 1` into the Approval Sequence grid layout).
* Without clicking any manual save buttons, click on the adjacent **Enforcement Rules** tab or the **Next** button.
* Observe the warning popup modal. Click **Yes** to proceed.
* Click back onto the **Approval Workflow** tab to verify the state of the configuration data.
### **Actual Result**

* A blockquote/confirmation modal interrupts the user journey stating:

**Confirmation**

All unsaved changes to this section will be lost. Are you sure you want to proceed?
* Upon selecting **Yes**, all recently modified structural sequences are erased and reset to empty states.
### **Expected Result**

* The system should automatically commit modifications when a user switches tabs or moves forward in the wizard sequence.
* It should follow the established architecture implemented in the **Document Framework (DF)** wizard, where navigating between tabs displays a success toast (e.g., `"Enforcement rules updated successfully"` or `"Auth scope saved successfully"`) and safely preserves all structural data without prompting a warning modal.

---

## [2406] DMGS-9450: UI Layout Container Inconsistency (Left/Right Margins Shift) on Product Groups Screen

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-09T13:23:34.731+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9450](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9450)

### Description:
### **Summary**

The **Product groups** page does not adhere to the global grid container styling used by sibling screens within the same module. When navigating to this screen, the left and right horizontal paddings/margins shift outward, causing layout alignment issues relative to the rest of the web application.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Access the QA application and expand the main navigation drawer.
* Click on **Currencies & currencies-pair groups** under the *Groups & template* section and note the structural alignment (left and right border spacing of the page content wrapper).
* Now, click on **Product Group** from the navigation menu. Observe the change in page wrapper alignment.
* Switch to **Approval Group** and note how the layout snaps back to the initial, correct margins.
### **Actual Result**

The **Product groups** screen uses a unique or unaligned wrapper layout where the left and right page padding is significantly narrower/different. This pushes the content container closer to the edge of the viewport compared to pages like *Currencies* or *Approval groups*, causing an unpleasant UI shifting behavior during navigation.

### **Expected Result**

Every page under the Documentation Centre platform should utilize a standardized, reusable global container wrapper component. The left and right structural spacing on the **Product groups** screen should match the exact pixel/rem layout specifications applied to the *Currencies* and *Approval groups* pages.

---

## [2407] DMGS-9451: Naming Inconsistency — Singular "Group" Used Instead of Plural "Groups" on Currencies-Pair Group Layout

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-09T13:30:07.579+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9451](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9451)

### Description:
### **Summary**

The sub-tab and the table section title for currency pairs incorrectly use the singular word **"Group"**, which is inconsistent with the main page header ("Currencies & currencies-pair groups") and the sibling tab ("Currencies Groups") that correctly use the plural form.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the **Groups & template** section in the side menu.
* Click on the **Currencies & currencies-pair groups** option to load the dashboard.
* Observe the labels on the two tabs near the top left.
* Click on the second tab (**Currencies-Pair Group**) and observe the table subtitle header on the left.
### **Actual Result**

* **Tab Header:** The second tab is incorrectly labeled as `Currencies-Pair Group` (Singular).
* **Table Section Title:** When the tab is active, the section description text reads `Currencies-pair group` (Singular).
### **Expected Result**

To maintain grammatical consistency across the entire module, all related labels should use the plural standard:

* The second tab should be renamed to **Currencies-Pair Groups**.
* The corresponding table subtitle header should be updated to **Currencies-pair groups**.

## [2430] DMGS-9549: "Something went wrong" Error on Groups and Templates section (500 Internal Server Error)

* **Status:** `Done`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-17T10:42:02.005+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9549](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9549)

### Description:
### **Description**

After successfully creating a new Product Group, the application redirects to the Product Groups listing page (`/group/product/list`). While a success toast notification is displayed, it is immediately followed by a red error toast notification stating **"Something went wrong, please try again later."** The product group table fails to load any data and displays "No Record Found" due to a `500 Internal Server Error` on the listing API endpoint.

### **Environment Details**

* **Environment:** QA
### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the **Create Product Group** page.
* Enter a valid **Product group name** (e.g., `abc12345`).
* Select an **Organisation** (e.g., `OSTTRA INDIA SERV...`).
* Select valid **Auth products** criteria (e.g., Asset Class: `FX`, Product Family: `Cash`, Product: `Future`).
* Click the **Add Product Line** button.
* Click the **Submit/Save (+)** button to create the group.
* Observe the redirection to the Product Groups listing page.
### **Expected Result**

* The page should smoothly display the listing table.
* A success message ("Product Group created successfully") should appear.
* The newly created product group should be visible in the list without any console or API errors.
### **Actual Result**

* The success toast ("Product Group created successfully") appears, but is instantly followed by a **"Something went wrong, please try again later"** error toast.
* The table fails to populate, showing **"No Record Found"**.
* The network tab reveals a failing backend dependency throwing a server-side crash.
NOTE: Approval groups and approval matrix are working fine

---

## [2474] DMGS-9672: Unrestricted Legal Entity (LEI) Names Visible in Filter Dropdown for Barclays User on Approval Group and USP Rider Screen

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-28T10:11:28.693+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9672](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9672)

### Description:
### **Description**

When logged in as a Barclays user, opening the **Select Legal Entity Name** dropdown displays third-party legal entities (e.g., `000000H HOLDING ApS`, `07 GALOIS`, `10019038 Canada Ltd.`etc.) alongside Barclays entities. Users should only be restricted to view legal entities associated with their logged-in organization (**BARCLAYS PLC**).

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Log in to the application as a Barclays user (`BARCLAYS PLC`).
* Navigate to **Approval Groups** (`/group/approval`).
* Click on the **Select Legal Entity Name** filter dropdown.
* Scroll through the populated list of legal entities.
### **Expected Result**

* The dropdown should only display Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) names associated with **BARCLAYS PLC**.
* Data isolation/multi-tenancy controls should prevent third-party organization names from being exposed.
### **Actual Result**

* The dropdown displays external/unrestricted legal entities across multiple non-Barclays organizations (e.g., `000000H HOLDING ApS`, `07 GALOIS`, etc.).

## [2476] DMGS-9674: Bug Report: Document Template History Displays Default Yellow Marker Color Regardless of Actual Text Marker Color Applied

* **Status:** `Open`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-28T10:31:10.845+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9674](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9674)

### Description:
### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to **Document Templates** (`/group/template`).
* Edit or Create a document template and enter text into the **Document Terms** rich text editor.
* Apply a non-yellow text marker color (e.g., **Green** highlight) to a section of text.
* Save / Submit the template changes.
* Click on the **History** icon for the updated template to open the **Document Template History** audit modal.
* Expand **View Added Content** under **Event changes** for the audit record.
* Compare the highlighted text color in the History modal against the actual editor.
### **Expected Result**

* The text highlight/marker color rendered in the **Document Template History** modal should reflect the exact color selected during editing (e.g., Green).
### **Actual Result**

* The **Document Template History** modal renders all highlighted text using a **Yellow** background color, ignoring the saved CSS styles or HTML attributes for green highlight.

## [2477] DMGS-9675: Cross-Browser Layout & Rendering Discrepancies between Chrome and Microsoft Edge

* **Status:** `Open`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-28T10:42:34.994+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9675](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9675)

### Description:
### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Open **Microsoft Edge** and **Google Chrome** side-by-side.
* Log in to the QA environment on both browsers.
* Create or navigate to an existing Document Framework record (`/document/edit/<id>`).
* **Observe (Edge):** Check if the page body renders immediately after creation or stays blank.
* Navigate to the **Auth Scope** tab.
* **Compare:** Observe the alignment of the `Add Auth Line` button, filter dropdowns, and product list cards between Chrome and Edge.
### **Expected Result**

* Page content should load and render reliably across all supported browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).
* UI components, buttons, grid/flexbox layouts, and typography should maintain consistent dimensions, alignment, and padding across Chrome and Edge.
### **Actual Result**

* Edge suffers from initial blank screen rendering glitches and severe flexbox/grid layout squashing (notably on the `Add Auth Line` button and filter section).

---

## [2478] DMGS-9676: Inconsistent Font Scaling in PDF Downloaded from Document Dashboard vs. Document Framework

* **Status:** `Open`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-28T10:46:12.012+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9676](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9676)

### Description:
When exporting a Document PDF via the **Document Dashboard**, the PDF rendering engine applies improper zoom/scaling rules. As a result, text labels, table headers, approval matrix elements, and legal terms render in an unnaturally small font size with excessive surrounding whitespace, creating a stark visual contrast with PDFs generated from the **Document Framework**.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Open the **Document Dashboard**.
* Locate document `DN-903305-A-001` and click the **Download PDF** option.
* Open the downloaded PDF in Edge/Chrome PDF viewer.
* Open a PDF generated for the same document directly from the **Document Framework** view.
* Compare the visual text scaling, table typography, and margin distribution between both files.
### **Expected Result**

* The PDF layout, font sizing, line height, and element scaling should remain **100% consistent** regardless of whether the download action was initiated from the **Document Dashboard** or the **Document Framework**.
### **Actual Result**

* Dashboard-generated PDF text is scaled down drastically, causing poor legibility across tables, section headers, and fine print legal terms.

---

## [2502] DMGS-9718: Search Functionality Fails on "Associated Documents" Modal (Returns "No Record Found" for Existing Documents)

* **Status:** `Canceled`
* **Created At:** `2026-07-31T11:17:42.054+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9718](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9718)

### Description:
### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Navigate to the **Document Framework** list page.
* Open the **Associated Documents** section/modal for a framework (e.g., `DF-682443-A-003`).
* Note the listed documents (e.g., `DN-116308-A` with Version ID `DN-116308-A-001`).
* Type or paste `DN-116308-A` into the **Search with document ID** input field.
* Observe the table result.
* Clear the search bar and paste `DN-604610-A-001` into the **Search with document version ID** input field.
* Observe the table result.
### **Expected Result**

* The search filter should dynamically filter and display the matching document(s) corresponding to the entered Document ID or Document Version ID.
### **Actual Result**

* Both search filters fail to match existing records and display **"No Record Found"**.

## [2570] DMGS-9894: Unassigned/Unmapped LEIs for Selected Doc Type Displayed in LEI Dropdown

* **Status:** `Open`
* **Created At:** `2026-08-18T09:47:23.943+0200`
* **JIRA Reference:** [DMGS-9894](https://osttra.atlassian.net/browse/DMGS-9894)

### Description:
### **Description**

In the user profile settings (`/profile-details`), LEI `205BKIC2C86PRJH1W31` (**BARCLAYS BANK IRELAND PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY**) is mapped **only** for Doc Type **DN**.

However, when creating a new Approval Group with Organisation `BARCLAYS PLC` and Doc Type **4 Way**, `205BKIC2C86PRJH1W31` incorrectly appears as an option in the **LEIs** dropdown. The system fails to cross-reference the user's assigned Doc Type permissions when populating the LEI list.

### **Steps to Reproduce**

* Log in as a user with specific LEI/Doc Type mappings (e.g., `Akshita Barclay`).
* Navigate to **Profile Details** (`/profile-details`) and verify that LEI `205BKIC2C86PRJH1W31` is mapped **only** to Doc Type **DN**.
* Navigate to **Groups & template** -> **Approval Group**.
* Click **+ Create Approval Group**.
* Select Organisation: `BARCLAYS PLC`.
* Select Doc Type: `4 Way`.
* Click the **LEIs** dropdown field to view available options.
### **Expected Result**

* The **LEIs** dropdown should strictly filter and display only LEIs mapped to the logged-in user for the selected **Doc Type** (`4 Way`).
* LEI `205BKIC2C86PRJH1W31` should be hidden when `4 Way` is selected.
### **Actual Result**

* The **LEIs** dropdown displays LEIs assigned to other Doc Types (`DN`), allowing users to create approval groups with LEIs for which they lack Doc Type permissions.
### **Note: However its blocking the user to create approval group and select org type, if lei mapping is not there.**

---
